paragraphs: In a certain demon realm, the sky was covered with a dark shade and the air seemed to have a bloody smell.
Strange noises emanated from all around, and screams of humans, demons, or other creatures continued to ring out.
This realm was called the Voromir Kingdom. The realm was given by the demon lord Skum Bo to help the subjects of his close friend, Voromir Zuke, after his death.
All the buildings here were rather shabby; the ground was painted with blood and the sight of corpses was quite normal.
Most demons were going on with their daily life; unlike what most would imagine, there were many demon families that were no different from humans.
There weren’t many demons left here since most had left after the demon lord’s death, but since some time ago the condition had started to become better.
The three demon generals, Thaddeus, Silquor, and Morvik were the only generals and close aides of the demon generals, the only ones he trusted the most.
After meeting with Vritra, the three had returned to the Voromir Kingdom to help the realm grow and keep it safe, while also awaiting the return of their lord.
They hadn’t told anyone that the revered lord had actually been revived.
"We just need to wait a little longer. Once our lord returns, then everyone will come back to their senses and remember his terror.
This place has changed completely; even the madam no longer seems to be waiting for him." Silquor spoke, his old and short form pacing across an empty hall.
After Voromir’s death, his wife was supposedly in depression or some other mental illness; some even said she was just pretending to not take on any sort of responsibility or blame.
But she had been bedridden ever since; her body has turned as fat as two rooms, she just consumes the flesh of creatures while sitting there and ordering everyone.
"Yes—huh, is that young lord? Why does he look so injured?" Morvik, always covered by shadows, was about to speak when he saw a badly injured figure walking into the kingdom with a big smile.
The condition and the expression didn’t match at all.
"Heh Did he get beaten up like a dog once again? Does he ever learn? He is shitting on our lord’s name.
Once Voromir was a name that made most lords tremble, but now because of them it had just become a joke." Thaddeus cursed; if only he had the strength he would beat this bastard’s ass.
But being the loyal subjects they were, the three rushed towards the young demon lord and asked: "Young Lord Raelion, did you fall from the stairs once again?"
"WHISTLEHuh? Oh no, I was attacked by the emperor and his other lap dogs keke" Raelion replied truthfully this time, but with a wide grin on his face.
"Oh, you truly live up to the reputation of our lord, such a devilish act you performed with such fervour, truly splendid.
Look how proud our young lord is of his achievement." Silquor said sarcastically, with a twisted smile.
"Shut up! It was a trap and there were many against whom I fought—" Raelion instantly became angry and embarrassed, but was interrupted.
"Pfft—Fought? More like, our young lord bravely ran for his life while getting his ass—cough—his back whipped." Thaddeus said, before shutting his mouth tight.

"You imbeciles, if only my father didn’t favour you so much at that time, I would have ripped you to pieces already." Raelion took a deep breath to calm himself, before once again becoming happy and speaking:
"Haha haven’t you heard the news? Yennefer is no longer engaged to the emperor; the announcements she made blasted the entire continent.
Heh I knew that wedding was fake." Raelion didn’t mind the beating he received; he finally had a shot at courting Yennefer.
"Tsk what a simp." Morvik shook his head; certainly he got more of his mother side’s genes.
Just then the four of them saw a group of demons flying across the sky, there was even a newly promoted female general among them who served under the second demon lord of this realm.
"Where are you going?" Raelion spoke, wiping the blood from his forehead and standing proudly.
"..." The group paused, seeing that it was Raelion; they clicked their tongue but replied respectfully and truthfully.
"Young lord, we have just gotten a message from our Queen; she is asking for our help." The female demon general replied.
All of them had already transformed into human appearances to make their trip easy.
"Tch She didn’t die, what a pity. Anyway, why don’t you abandon that fox and come serve under me? I will definitely keep you happy." Raelion spoke, licking the blood off his lips.
"...Thank you for your kind words, but I have dedicated my loyalty to our Queen."
She very much wanted to reply with a snarky comment, but her position here wasn’t as high as those three generals, so she couldn’t do anything.
"Sigh Leave leave, I am in a good mood, go and bring the good news that my dear sister had died outside." Raelion spoke, as he turned and began to walk away.

Just then, a loud strange noise came from the distance, grabbing the attention of the group.
As the group turned collectively to look, they saw a fatty pig demon bouncing towards them; he seemed to have tripped and was now rolling like a ball.
"Ugh H- Have you gotten oink oink any news of my Maeve?" the piggy came to a stop with his face skidding across the land; after coughing the dirty sand he stood up.

This pig demon was Ziggy, the son of a powerful lord family; previously this family used to serve under the Voromir Zuke. But now, Ziggy’s family was one of the strongest demon families with several lords in their family.
"Uh No—" the female general named Xi was about to refuse but Raelion hurriedly spoke.
"Brother-in-law! You are here at just the perfect time, these people were just about to head out to rescue your bride; shouldn’t you go along and prove your manliness?
I am sure my sister will be head over heels for you." Raelion stifled his chuckle and spoke, giving Ziggy a thumbs up.

"Oink Oink Thank you, little Rae; I will remember your help. I will even put in a good word for you to my father," Ziggy spoke, dragging his heavy body close and patting Raelion’s cheek and leaving a dirty squishy gel-like fluid.
The young lord almost vomited as he spoke few words before running away in haste: "Yeah go ahead, brother ugh in law, cough my sister is waiting for you."
"Oink What a good lad, let’s go and save Maeve; I will beat—cough—I will ask my father to beat whoever dared to hurt her."
Ziggy said as he stomped his feet on the ground, his belly fat moved up and down, even touching the ground for a moment as he shot up and floated in the air.

"Uh..." Xi bit her lip; this was exactly why they were rushing out in a hurry, to not get this pig’s attention. And who knows what condition Maeve is in right now, what if he tries to take advantage of her?
’Haa I am trouble, what should I do, Queen?’ Xi thought.

sentences.text: In a certain demon realm, the sky was covered with a dark shade and the air seemed to have a bloody smell.
Strange noises emanated from all around, and screams of humans, demons, or other creatures continued to ring out.
This realm was called the Voromir Kingdom.
The realm was given by the demon lord Skum Bo to help the subjects of his close friend, Voromir Zuke, after his death.
All the buildings here were rather shabby; the ground was painted with blood and the sight of corpses was quite normal.
Most demons were going on with their daily life; unlike what most would imagine, there were many demon families that were no different from humans.
There weren’t many demons left here since most had left after the demon lord’s death, but since some time ago the condition had started to become better.
The three demon generals, Thaddeus, Silquor, and Morvik were the only generals and close aides of the demon generals, the only ones he trusted the most.
After meeting with Vritra, the three had returned to the Voromir Kingdom to help the realm grow and keep it safe, while also awaiting the return of their lord.
They hadn’t told anyone that the revered lord had actually been revived.
"We just need to wait a little longer.
Once our lord returns, then everyone will come back to their senses and remember his terror.
This place has changed completely; even the madam no longer seems to be waiting for him." Silquor spoke, his old and short form pacing across an empty hall.
After Voromir’s death, his wife was supposedly in depression or some other mental illness; some even said she was just pretending to not take on any sort of responsibility or blame.
But she had been bedridden ever since; her body has turned as fat as two rooms, she just consumes the flesh of creatures while sitting there and ordering everyone.
"Yes—huh, is that young lord?
Why does he look so injured?" Morvik, always covered by shadows, was about to speak when he saw a badly injured figure walking into the kingdom with a big smile.
The condition and the expression didn’t match at all.
"Heh Did he get beaten up like a dog once again?
Does he ever learn?
He is shitting on our lord’s name.
Once Voromir was a name that made most lords tremble, but now because of them it had just become a joke." Thaddeus cursed; if only he had the strength he would beat this bastard’s ass.
But being the loyal subjects they were, the three rushed towards the young demon lord and asked: "Young Lord Raelion, did you fall from the stairs once again?"
"WHISTLEHuh?
Oh no, I was attacked by the emperor and his other lap dogs keke" Raelion replied truthfully this time, but with a wide grin on his face.
"Oh, you truly live up to the reputation of our lord, such a devilish act you performed with such fervour, truly splendid.
Look how proud our young lord is of his achievement." Silquor said sarcastically, with a twisted smile.
"Shut up!
It was a trap and there were many against whom I fought—" Raelion instantly became angry and embarrassed, but was interrupted.
"Pfft—Fought?
More like, our young lord bravely ran for his life while getting his ass—cough—his back whipped." Thaddeus said, before shutting his mouth tight.

"You imbeciles, if only my father didn’t favour you so much at that time, I would have ripped you to pieces already." Raelion took a deep breath to calm himself, before once again becoming happy and speaking:
"Haha haven’t you heard the news?
Yennefer is no longer engaged to the emperor; the announcements she made blasted the entire continent.
Heh I knew that wedding was fake." Raelion didn’t mind the beating he received; he finally had a shot at courting Yennefer.
"Tsk what a simp." Morvik shook his head; certainly he got more of his mother side’s genes.
Just then the four of them saw a group of demons flying across the sky, there was even a newly promoted female general among them who served under the second demon lord of this realm.
"Where are you going?" Raelion spoke, wiping the blood from his forehead and standing proudly.
"..." The group paused, seeing that it was Raelion; they clicked their tongue but replied respectfully and truthfully.
"Young lord, we have just gotten a message from our Queen; she is asking for our help." The female demon general replied.
All of them had already transformed into human appearances to make their trip easy.
"Tch She didn’t die, what a pity.
Anyway, why don’t you abandon that fox and come serve under me?
I will definitely keep you happy." Raelion spoke, licking the blood off his lips.
"...Thank you for your kind words, but I have dedicated my loyalty to our Queen."
She very much wanted to reply with a snarky comment, but her position here wasn’t as high as those three generals, so she couldn’t do anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 404: Another Temple
paragraphs: [D-Day 15]
Vritra spent two days with Fiona and Diana. The three stopped all their other work and just enjoyed each other’s company.
Diana even stopped her experiments and gave all her time to Vritra. Though unaware of the reason, she could tell something was troubling him.
So both Diana and Fiona stayed close to him and gave all the love they could, being his pillars of support emotionally.
"Didn’t I tell you, two beautiful wives are all you need to heal? Hubby, have you thought of a way to earn the sin points?" Yasmine asked. She was in her human form.
Sitting on the bed, she gazed at Vritra as he wore his clothes after the bath.
"No, didn’t you tell me to just throw all thoughts away and rest?" Vritra replied, smiling faintly.
Rolling her eyes, Yasmine stood up. She helped him with dressing, then placed her chin over his shoulder, her hands wrapping around him.
"About Yennefer, I think she knows her mistake now and even tried to make things right as we heard in that World Information Centre.
Maybe you should have a talk with her," she suggested, aware that if things got better between them, he would certainly improve.
"Sigh, let’s talk about that later..." Vritra said. It was part anger and jealousy which made him so mad at her.
"Mhmm." Yasmine didn’t continue on the matter. Smelling the sweet scent of food, the two walked towards the kitchen.
Both Diana and Fiona were busy cooking in the kitchen, preparing several dishes. In cooking, Diana seemed even better than Fiona, maybe because of her talent for potion brewing.
"Here you go, Darling, I have prepared all the dishes, extra spicy just how you like it." Fiona set the plates on the table before serving him food.
Then the two of them joined him to eat. Sadly, Yasmine could only watch them even though she could smell the food too.
"So, you will be leaving now?" Diana questioned. She really loved the two days they spent together.
They had already toured nearly a quarter of the city, though there were still many things they hadn’t seen.
"Yeah, but don’t worry I will be back soon. Tell me if you need anything from the outside," he replied.
After thinking for a while, the two ladies produced a list of items they wanted from outside.
Although a few succubi go out to purchase various things, the population of the city was not small so only the most essential items could be brought.
"Okay, I will get them as soon as possible." Vritra scanned the list and put it away. He could buy them all easily and in a short time.
"And if possible, can you get the next batch of ingredients from the temple? I am going to run out of them soon," Diana added, touching his arm as a faint mark appeared there before disappearing.
Vritra nodded. After a little chat, he kissed them goodbye and headed out of the city.
First of all, he bought the materials and then headed towards the temple.
"I wonder if the temple here is going to be safe. I don’t have a good experience with the temples in this world," he spoke while flying towards the distant large building.
From the Dunshire kingdom to Blue Kingdom where Grieves had taken control of the temple, the relation between the two had been bad.
"It should be fine. Grieves won’t be able to gain that much power here. Though Nine Pacts or other organisations could indeed infiltrate it," Yasmine said, hoping nothing happens.
After getting close to the temple, he landed and walked towards the entrance. He had once again taken on a random appearance.
"Hello, where is the pope?" Stopping one of the men in a white robe, Vritra questioned.
"You can meet him inside near the confession booth. Amitabha, are you here to pray?" the other man spoke politely.
Vritra just shook his head and headed inside.
There were a lot of similarities in this world and Earth because of the people who had already been summoned.
Pausing at the entrance, he took in the sight of the temple. It was quite vast with a lot of valuable treasures and paintings.
This temple alone was a lot more luxurious than even the royal palace in White Kingdom, with many people guarding it.
"Are you here to pray or confess?" one of the guards stopped him at the doors and questioned.
"... " Instead of wasting time chatting, he headed inside directly with the use of Misty Essence mythic halo.
The guards just stood there in a dazed state.
After getting inside, Vritra looked around and soon saw the confession booths on the left side; the pope was inside one of the booths.

They were made in such a way that no one from outside would be able to hear anything, but after getting closer to the booth, Yasmine changed the glyphs just a bit and Vritra was able to hear everything.
"A- And then what huff huff happened?" the strange voice of the pope sounded.
"Like I said, my husband was on duty so I was home alone. When his friend arrived I allowed him inside the house, not knowing what animalistic desires he had for me.
When I brought him some water, he suddenly..." a middle-aged woman’s voice sounded from the other side.
"Suddenly what? S- So, what did he do after that huff? Hurry up, don’t stop." the pope asked, in full imagination mode.
Vritra rolled his eyes; these were supposed to be the messengers of the gods, and here he was, enjoying a porn script.
Shaking his head, Vritra held the handle and with a gentle pull, he broke the lock, opening the door.
"Hey there, if you are done with the confession, then can I get the materials goddess Diana asked for?" Vritra spoke.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Interrupted +1}
"H- Huh? Who are you? How did you open this? Guards, arrest him! He is a terrorist, criminal of the highest degree, he dares to interrupt such a holy process."
The pope was shocked at first but then he roared in rage.
Thankfully no one else could hear the shouts. Vritra just raised his right hand and showed the mark that Diana had left on his arm. Only then did the pope calm down.
"Ah, forgive me, the goddess sent you here? I- I will bring all the materials to you immediately."
The pope rushed off towards the workers and began to order them around, but not before asking the woman to wait for a while.
’Wifey, don’t you think the voice of this woman sounds a bit familiar?’ Vritra asked, but didn’t think too much about it.
"Hmm, I think so, but I can’t seem to remember," Yasmine said with a shrug.
It wasn’t long before the pope arrived back with all the materials. After handing them to Vritra, he rushed back into the booth.
But it seemed the woman there had waited enough already.
She just walked out of there, and as Vritra saw who it was, his eyes widened with surprise.
"Pfft... Shit- Sonia? When did you join this industry?" Vritra almost laughed out loud upon seeing the blonde woman.
"P- Pitiful one?!! Sob Save meeeee..." She instantly began to cry with tears and snot.

chapters.title: Chapter 405: Intruders
paragraphs: "P- Pitiful one?!! Sob Save meeeee..." Monk Shitless jumped up to hug Vritra, but ended up jumping into the arms of the pope, wiping off his tears and snot.
"Cough Let’s go out and talk." Vritra barely held back his laugh seeing the monk leave sticky water over the pope’s robe.
"Sob O- Okay..." he nodded and followed after him silently, attracting quite a few glances from the people around.
Arriving at a stall nearby, they sat outside and ordered some tea, then Vritra asked: "So what trouble did you cause this time?"

"I d- didn’t do anything this time, it was Onest. He kidnapped my Bullo with some food and blackmailed me to keep the pope busy for a while since he was going to steal something from the temple," Shitless explained.
As the tea arrived, he drank the entire glass in one gulp only to regret it.
"And you know what he is stealing?" Vritra questioned, passing on some water.
"Yes, it hoo hoo was the statue of the god they all pray to. I heard it is very, very expensive and p- precious to them. They won’t even let anyone see it," Shitless answered.
’Hmm. Stealing...’ A couple of thoughts did appear in Vritra’s mind but it still won’t be enough to get a lot of Sin points.
"Had he succeeded yet?" he questioned.
"No, today he was just going to make a mental map of the entire place, and see what sort of barriers and traps are used there." Sonia secretly picked Vritra’s glass of tea and began to sip it slowly.
"Okay, tell him to finish stealing by tomorrow or I will personally throw him back in that prison," Vritra said seriously.
"W- What? You want him to continue with the robbery, t- then what about me...?" Shitless put the glass down and asked with a pitiful look.
"Keep doing what you are doing, you are talented at this." Vritra patted his shoulder then he paid the money and stood up.
This was one of the biggest temples in the entire continent and even the emperor often went there. If their greatest treasure is stolen then it is bound to attract a whole lot of attention.
Though it will still be dangerous, there would be no gains without any risks.
Shitless sighed and just continued to drink.
He wondered when his life went wrong. From the great demon monk he was now just a woman, trying to grab an old man’s attention.
"It’ll be fine. I will rise one day definitely. All demon lords would be praying to me at that time," Shitless comforted himself.
But just as Vritra had left, several guards charged towards him. The curfew was still going on; it was only because of Misty Essence that no one saw them.
Vritra flew away. He decided to go and meet Maeve and continue with the training; he still needed to fill up the Charged Fist bar after all.
As he neared the building, Vritra sensed that the demoness’s room was covered by a barrier that made it impossible for anyone to see or sense her.
But he could clearly see her. Maeve sat near the window, staring at the sky with an emotionless face, her chin resting over her hand.
It looked like such a beautiful painting; the demoness was truly so gorgeous.
Shaking his head, Vritra directly teleported inside the room.
"Foxie..." Vritra called out from behind. Her body trembled as surprise ran across her mind, then she turned and her expression instantly turned happy.
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Overjoyed +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Adorned +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Loved +1}
Seeing the messages, Vritra sighed. It seemed the fox demon had already developed feelings for him.
"Masterrr~" With her eyes closed and lips forming a big smile, she jumped into his arms, joy shooting through her heart.
"I almost thought you wouldn’t return again, hehe I am so happy," Maeve spoke before pulling her head back and looking at his face, a strange glint passing through her eyes.
"Shall we go out for practice?" Vritra asked directly, he clearly knew what that intense look in her eyes meant.

"Yesss! And don’t you worry, I will hit you a lot today. I won’t run out of energy like the previous time. Have you brought the costume I gave last time?" The way she spoke it, the fox made it sound quite strange.
"Yeah, let’s go." Taking her hand, the two flew out.
With the curfew still in effect, the streets were completely empty and only guards could be seen around.
After reaching near the entrance of the Ghazi city, Vritra paused and spoke: "Wait here a bit for me, I will be back in a couple of minutes."
"Okay master, but hurry up." Maeve nodded as she sat over one of the tree’s branches.
Vritra returned to the city of Charms and delivered all the things they had asked for. He didn’t spend too much time and left quickly.
Maeve was happy when Vritra really returned so quickly. After traveling further away, the two stopped and got ready.
"Master, should I go all out?" she questioned. The demoness enjoyed even fighting him, at least that way she could get really close to him.
"Yeah, don’t hold back." Vritra nodded as he readied himself.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
In the next moment, her fist landed over his chest, creating a very loud explosive sound as Vritra’s body shot back like a rocket.
BANG BANG
He broke one tree after another, creating a large crater in the ground and getting thrown several kilometres away.
Once Vritra stopped, he looked above and the demoness was already there, staring at his body with a strange look.
And so Vritra remembered he had forgotten to change into the suit she had given him.
Like before, the clothes on his upper body had been torn away.
"GULP Thank you master..." Maeve mumbled, wiping the imaginary drool.
Vritra rolled his eyes as he put on the bodysuit and again they got into training.
Though slowly, the Charged Fist percentage was increasing, making Vritra wonder just how much power it would hold at full.
Thankfully he possessed the Divine Physique otherwise this skill won’t be as effective at his current level.
Time passed rather quickly. Maeve barely took any rests as she kept launching full powered attacks one after another.
Soon more than four hours had passed and by now, the demoness was getting slightly tired.
"Let’s take a rest." Vritra said as he pulled a table and chairs. He sat down on one and pulled one beside him for her.
"Thank you master, sigh this training is really draining, I am so tired." Acting weak, she stumbled and ended up sitting over his lap. She weakly put her head onto his shoulder and panted.
"..." Vritra couldn’t help but chuckle at her overacting, but just as he was about to speak, the two sensed several presences rushing from the distance.
He frowned while Maeve’s expression changed as well. She seemed to recognise that faint aura.
In the next moment, a group of ten popped in front of them. It was almost like they had teleported to their location from nearby, leaving Vritra surprised.
There was a woman leading the group and nine men.

"Keep doing what you are doing, you are talented at this." Vritra patted his shoulder then he paid the money and stood up.
This was one of the biggest temples in the entire continent and even the emperor often went there.
If their greatest treasure is stolen then it is bound to attract a whole lot of attention.
Though it will still be dangerous, there would be no gains without any risks.
Shitless sighed and just continued to drink.
He wondered when his life went wrong.
From the great demon monk he was now just a woman, trying to grab an old man’s attention.
"It’ll be fine.
I will rise one day definitely.
All demon lords would be praying to me at that time," Shitless comforted himself.
But just as Vritra had left, several guards charged towards him.
The curfew was still going on; it was only because of Misty Essence that no one saw them.
Vritra flew away.
He decided to go and meet Maeve and continue with the training; he still needed to fill up the Charged Fist bar after all.
As he neared the building, Vritra sensed that the demoness’s room was covered by a barrier that made it impossible for anyone to see or sense her.
But he could clearly see her.
Maeve sat near the window, staring at the sky with an emotionless face, her chin resting over her hand.
It looked like such a beautiful painting; the demoness was truly so gorgeous.
Shaking his head, Vritra directly teleported inside the room.
"Foxie..." Vritra called out from behind.
Her body trembled as surprise ran across her mind, then she turned and her expression instantly turned happy.
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Overjoyed +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Adorned +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Loved +1}
Seeing the messages, Vritra sighed.
It seemed the fox demon had already developed feelings for him.
"Masterrr~" With her eyes closed and lips forming a big smile, she jumped into his arms, joy shooting through her heart.
"I almost thought you wouldn’t return again, hehe I am so happy," Maeve spoke before pulling her head back and looking at his face, a strange glint passing through her eyes.
"Shall we go out for practice?" Vritra asked directly, he clearly knew what that intense look in her eyes meant.
"Yesss!
And don’t you worry, I will hit you a lot today.
I won’t run out of energy like the previous time.
Have you brought the costume I gave last time?" The way she spoke it, the fox made it sound quite strange.
"Yeah, let’s go." Taking her hand, the two flew out.
With the curfew still in effect, the streets were completely empty and only guards could be seen around.
After reaching near the entrance of the Ghazi city, Vritra paused and spoke: "Wait here a bit for me, I will be back in a couple of minutes."
"Okay master, but hurry up." Maeve nodded as she sat over one of the tree’s branches.
Vritra returned to the city of Charms and delivered all the things they had asked for.
He didn’t spend too much time and left quickly.
Maeve was happy when Vritra really returned so quickly.
After traveling further away, the two stopped and got ready.
"Master, should I go all out?" she questioned.
The demoness enjoyed even fighting him, at least that way she could get really close to him.
"Yeah, don’t hold back." Vritra nodded as he readied himself.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
In the next moment, her fist landed over his chest, creating a very loud explosive sound as Vritra’s body shot back like a rocket.
BANG BANG
He broke one tree after another, creating a large crater in the ground and getting thrown several kilometres away.
Once Vritra stopped, he looked above and the demoness was already there, staring at his body with a strange look.
And so Vritra remembered he had forgotten to change into the suit she had given him.
Like before, the clothes on his upper body had been torn away.
"GULP Thank you master..." Maeve mumbled, wiping the imaginary drool.
Vritra rolled his eyes as he put on the bodysuit and again they got into training.
Though slowly, the Charged Fist percentage was increasing, making Vritra wonder just how much power it would hold at full.
Thankfully he possessed the Divine Physique otherwise this skill won’t be as effective at his current level.
Time passed rather quickly.
Maeve barely took any rests as she kept launching full powered attacks one after another.
Soon more than four hours had passed and by now, the demoness was getting slightly tired.
"Let’s take a rest." Vritra said as he pulled a table and chairs.
He sat down on one and pulled one beside him for her.
"Thank you master, sigh this training is really draining, I am so tired." Acting weak, she stumbled and ended up sitting over his lap.
She weakly put her head onto his shoulder and panted.
"..." Vritra couldn’t help but chuckle at her overacting, but just as he was about to speak, the two sensed several presences rushing from the distance.
He frowned while Maeve’s expression changed as well.
She seemed to recognise that faint aura.
In the next moment, a group of ten popped in front of them.
It was almost like they had teleported to their location from nearby, leaving Vritra surprised.
There was a woman leading the group and nine men.

chapters.title: Chapter 406: Acceptance
paragraphs: Xi and her underlings looked around and soon saw their Queen sitting on the lap of a man. The group was shocked at first.
Then anger flashed in Xi’s eyes as she shouted: "You beast, how dare you put your dirty hands on our Queen’s body! Get away from her now."
For a moment Vritra remained confused but then understanding flashed through his eyes.
His face turned expressionless as he observed the newly arrived group and asked a few questions.
Xi’s strength was just at the General rank while the people behind her were even weaker. Despite their disguise, Vritra could tell they were all demons.
"By your Queen, you are referring to Maeve?"
"Yes!" Xi answered. Since Maeve was still in his hands and who knows what he had done in her time of weakness, Xi didn’t make any rash move.
She was sure Vritra was somehow controlling or blackmailing her. There was no way their queen would sit on the lap of a man on her own accord.
"And it doesn’t seem like you accidentally found our location, did she call for help?" Vritra asked the second question.
Maeve gulped nervously. She had completely forgotten about the help message she had sent while being in the Zihong’s inheritance.
At that time they had just met, so how could she have trusted him? But now there was no need for any of it.
Even if someone forced her to, she wouldn’t leave his side.
"Of course, I can’t even imagine how you must have tortured our Queen. She had sent this message to us herself. In any case, get away from her before we kill you.
If you cooperate, the punishment might be reduced." Xi spoke, ready to launch an attack at any time.
"Ah, is that so? Right, so why don’t you leave already, Maeve?" Maeve spoke, finally glancing at the fox seated on his lap.
It was just as he thought—it wasn’t good to trust any woman.
Though it was good that he had just started to open up to her so it wouldn’t really hurt him as much as with Yennefer.
"W- Wait Master, it’s not like that I was—" Maeve tried to explain but Xi’s shocked voice interrupted her.

"M- Master? Queen, why are you calling him your master? What has he done to you? Forgive us, we weren’t able to come to your rescue fast enough even though you had personally sent us that message just recently."
’Damnit!’ Maeve cursed, wanting to strangle her general. She was just making the situation worse.
Hearing the word recently, Vritra’s expression turned even colder.
"Just! Leave!" he spoke, his brows creasing slightly.
"..." Yasmine sighed seeing this drama, wondering why it is always Vritra. Though this time even she was fooled by the fox’s acting.
No wonder she is considered one of the most cunning demon lords.
"Queen, what’s wrong? Had he tied you with some sort of barrier, pact or something?" Xi asked worriedly.
"SHUT UP!" Maeve first shouted at her stupid general then turned her attention to Vritra.
She tightened her arms around his neck and wouldn’t let go.
"No wait, at least listen to me or I won’t let go even if you cut off my arms." Maeve hugged him with all her strength.
Though she wanted to fly up and give a hard slap to everyone in the group, she felt that if she let go then Vritra would just disappear.
"Are you trying to strangle me now?" Vritra asked. He tried to get himself free but it was impossible without the use of his abilities.
"I had sent that message right after we entered the Zihong inheritance. Why would I need their help to leave otherwise?
I know you must be angry at this misunderstanding but please think calmly, would those fools be of any help to me in my current condition?"
Maeve said in a single breath, worried that Vritra would disappear from her arms.
Hearing her words, Vritra took a deep breath and calmed himself.
There was logic in her words but ever since the incident with Yennefer he had been on edge and for some reason expected her to stab him in the back.

"Right, if I wanted to leave, I would have left long ago. Don’t believe those idiots’ words. I didn’t lie when I said I do love you. Ugh, how do I prove it?" Maeve spoke in frustration, then her gaze moved to the confused demons in the sky.
"..." Vritra remained silent, though his body visibly relaxed. Yennefer’s incident had a big impact on him but it’s not like every woman is the same.
Maeve slowly loosened her arms, making sure that he wouldn’t push her away. Then she gently cupped his cheek and whispered softly:

"Master, I swear over my mother, the only person who cared for me. I really, really love you. If you want I can pretend to be a human for my entire life and stay with you, so please don’t abandon me..."
Then her face moved forward slowly. Seeing that Vritra didn’t reject her, her heart leapt in joy. A shiver ran across her body as her moist lips came into contact with his.
The fiery and soft sensation spread over their lips as the seconds seemed to have turned into hours.
When Maeve pulled back, her face was red and felt like burning. The fox demon seemed a bit shy; the sensation was still present on her lips.
"K- K- K- Kiss?!! Q- Queen? Uwaah W- What’s going on?" Xi’s brain seemed to have short-circuited. She didn’t know what to do or think.
"What the hell are you still doing here? Shoo shoo! Leave right away and don’t appear anywhere near us. I will return to that realm when and if I want.
Also inform those shitty family members of mine, I have chosen the most wonderful man for myself so I won’t be marrying that lump of fat—"
But before she could finish, strange noises sounded from the distance.
OINK OINK
"Ugh, why the fuck did you bring him along?" Maeve really felt like murdering her general now. She would never want to see the face of a pig, a literal pig.

"..." Vritra finally got a hold of his emotions, and finally he felt that he could really trust this demoness. Though their relationship needed more time, he couldn’t deny that he also enjoyed her company.
"Master, let’s hurry, we need to leave." Maeve said hurriedly, trying to leave but Vritra held her in place, as his arms wrapped around her waist.
"Stop, no one can take you away from here. First tell me, who is coming?" He asked. Vritra certainly won’t let anything happen to her now; he had started to accept her.
"Haa..." Maeve let out a long sigh. Feeling his strong arm, she felt protected and relaxed. Leaning onto his chest, she began to explain.
"After my father’s death, our kingdom was nearly at the verge of destruction but thankfully a close friend of his allowed us to escape to a different realm.
But we were still quite weak. You know my brother is Raelion, right?" Maeve paused and asked.
Vritra nodded. He knew some basic information about her by now from Yasmine, of course.
But first he asked: "Your father must be a strong demon lord, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 407: Breakup?
paragraphs: "Your father must have been a very strong demon lord, right?" Vritra asked, sensing something bouncing closer by the second.
"Yeah, he surely was. When he was alive, our family was one of the strongest among all the demon lords, despite there being only one lord unlike many others."
Maeve spoke, her head resting over his shoulder as she remembered distant memories.
After a moment’s silence, she added: "He died in a God’s war by one of the mythic halos."
"..." Vritra lingered on that detail, finding it somewhat familiar. With a doubt in his mind, he asked further: "Uhm... Who was your father?"
"Voromir Zuke," Maeve answered, her tone possessing no emotion as she spoke that name after such a long time.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Shocked +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Got Baffled +1}

"...Oh." Vritra was certainly familiar with that name, after all, it was him who extinguished the demon lord’s last hope of revival and absorbed his core, while his soul wraiths absorbed pieces of his soul.
"But didn’t you use Hale as your last name? He... wasn’t your real father or anything, right?"
Vritra asked, hoping to avoid the worst-case scenario. How could there be such a coincidence?
But with his luck, anything was possible.
"Yeah, that was my mother’s family name, but didn’t you know my half brother is Raelion Zuke? And he was indeed my real father, is something wrong?" Maeve asked in confusion.
Vritra scratched his forehead. The two had just started to get closer and such a big problem had already popped up.
Using the Misty Essence, Vritra busied the ball of fat that was approaching rapidly into a puzzle for a while.
"..." Seeing that Vritra had turned silent, Maeve continued with her story.
"So we are staying in the Voromir kingdom currently, and Raelion’s mother, well—the current ruler of our realm, wanted to use the strength of a strong demonic family to stabilize our realm.
And so, she arranged a fat pig to marry me from that family.
I refused, but escaping wasn’t an option so she gave me a task to steal the Aven family’s heirloom to cancel this marriage and prove myself." The demoness sighed.
She knew how much of a bitch Raelion’s mother is, yet she had no other choice.
"Ah, okay, I understand." Vritra nodded, maybe staying together really wasn’t in their fate.
He wondered if they would break up even before their relationship properly started.
After thinking for a minute, he decided to tell her about it. He didn’t want to lie about such a big thing to her.
"There is something I have to tell you." Vritra looked solemnly at Maeve and spoke.
"Yes, master, tell me." Maeve nodded. She was still happy over the fact that Vritra seemed to finally be accepting her.
"Well, some time ago, I met three demon generals—Thaddeus, Silquor, and Morvik." He decided to open the secret, layer by layer.
"Oh, you have met them? They were the only generals left from my father’s army," Maeve added before going silent, as she waited for him to continue, looking at his face with a tender look.
"Oof Hubby, I think the person who wrote your fate might have had some personal grudge with you, anyway good luck with this."
Yasmine began to eat her imaginary popcorn, watching a new drama unfold in her husband’s life.

"So, as you might already know about me, I was summoned inside the Dunshire kingdom from a different universe by a goddess. It was there that I met them," Vritra spoke, wondering how to break the news.
"Just say whatever you want, why are you hesitating?" Maeve spoke, tilting her head.
"Haa... So I accidentally ended up devouring the core those three demon generals were carrying around, that was supposedly prepared by your father for his revival.
And I am also partly responsible for destroying the few fragments of his soul; well, I just made the process quick—he would have disappeared anyway." Vritra finally said.
He felt that she might end up hating him; if not for him, her father would be alive now.
"Wait wait, s- so you mean to say, it is exactly because of you that my father wasn’t able to come back to life?!!" Maeve was quite shocked upon hearing those words.
She repeated the same thing in bewilderment.
"...Yeah, you can say that. I am sorry—" Vritra spoke. Maybe if her father was revived, her family would be in a much better condition.
Though Vritra didn’t regret any of his actions.
"Hoo..." Maeve let out a long breath, her expression unreadable as she registered his words.
Then she fixed her gaze on him, as her face broke into a big smile. The demoness wrapped her arms around him and spoke hurriedly:
"Thank you, master, I love you so much!! I am very happy that you killed that bastard, I can almost imagine his struggle as his soul got destroyed hahaha."
Vritra: "... "
It would be an understatement to say that he was surprised by her reaction. He was ready for her to get angry and leave immediately, but it was the opposite.
"Wait, did you hear me wrong?" Vritra asked, the sweet fragrance of the fox wrapping around him.

"Of course not, I heard you clearly, and I am really thankful that you stopped that son of a bitch from coming back to life," Maeve said as she pulled back and looked at him with a more obsessed gaze.
She had heard rumours about the three generals plotting something in secret but she hadn’t paid them much attention, so they were trying to revive the demon lord, her father.
"Oh, so you two didn’t have a good relation, huh." Vritra finally relaxed, once again wrapping his arms around her waist.
"Yeah, he put me through hell when I was younger and beat up my mother very often right in front of me, just for reasons I don’t even remember.
If he was still alive then he would have already sold me off to some other family or used me for his schemes. That’s why, I’m really thankful towards you, Mmm~ master~" Maeve explained.
Although she wasn’t able to kill him herself, knowing that Vritra had put him through so much despair and even stole his last chance—she couldn’t be happier.
"I see." Vritra nodded, though it wasn’t a surprise, since most demons have no morals or any bottom line.
"Anyway, so the person who is coming is chosen by your family to marry you?" he asked, finally stopping the misty essence.
"Yes, sigh, if only my life flame wasn’t in her control, then I would have left that realm long ago," Maeve said, her expression becoming sour.
"Life flame?" Vritra raised an eyebrow.
"Yeah, it is something similar to how I formed a life pact with you. When I was younger, my father had connected my life to a certain flame so that he could control me and my other siblings easily.
And somehow it ended up in Raelion’s mother’s possession," the demoness answered.
"Looks like killing this piggy might bring you trouble for now, but don’t worry, I just have something perfect in mind." Vritra looked into the distance, his lips curving into a twisted smile.
"!!!" Although Maeve was seeing that look for the first time, she could tell that he was brewing something very evil, and she completely supported him.
"Yes master~ let’s do it!"

"Of course not, I heard you clearly, and I am really thankful that you stopped that son of a bitch from coming back to life," Maeve said as she pulled back and looked at him with a more obsessed gaze.
She had heard rumours about the three generals plotting something in secret but she hadn’t paid them much attention, so they were trying to revive the demon lord, her father.
"Oh, so you two didn’t have a good relation, huh." Vritra finally relaxed, once again wrapping his arms around her waist.
"Yeah, he put me through hell when I was younger and beat up my mother very often right in front of me, just for reasons I don’t even remember.
If he was still alive then he would have already sold me off to some other family or used me for his schemes.
That’s why, I’m really thankful towards you, Mmm~ master~" Maeve explained.
Although she wasn’t able to kill him herself, knowing that Vritra had put him through so much despair and even stole his last chance—she couldn’t be happier.
"I see." Vritra nodded, though it wasn’t a surprise, since most demons have no morals or any bottom line.
"Anyway, so the person who is coming is chosen by your family to marry you?" he asked, finally stopping the misty essence.
"Yes, sigh, if only my life flame wasn’t in her control, then I would have left that realm long ago," Maeve said, her expression becoming sour.
"Life flame?" Vritra raised an eyebrow.
"Yeah, it is something similar to how I formed a life pact with you.
When I was younger, my father had connected my life to a certain flame so that he could control me and my other siblings easily.
And somehow it ended up in Raelion’s mother’s possession," the demoness answered.
"Looks like killing this piggy might bring you trouble for now, but don’t worry, I just have something perfect in mind." Vritra looked into the distance, his lips curving into a twisted smile.
"!!!" Although Maeve was seeing that look for the first time, she could tell that he was brewing something very evil, and she completely supported him.
"Yes master~ let’s do it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 408: Greatest Treasure
paragraphs: An old man sat slumped on a chair with a tired look on his face. He sprinkled some water on his wrinkled skin and coughed out blood.
"No need for overacting, tell me whatever you have found." Beside him sat a burly, corpse-like Red, the leader of the Bone Blood Cult.
"Let me finish my drink first." Saying so, the old man, who was Pink in disguise, picked a glass and gulped the contents in one gulp.
"Hoo, how refreshing. Anyway, take this map. I have marked the general location where Vritra’s family must be present.
But I don’t understand one thing: if catching them is impossible, then why would you make me waste my time finding this?" Pink questioned, leaning back.
"It is certainly not to pull him out. You know how my organisation does its work. I am going to prepare a nice gift for him very soon," Red said, his ripped face breaking into a twisted smile.
Just then, a man completely covered in bandages arrived beside Red. He bowed respectfully and sat down on the ground.
"Did you get the task done?" Red questioned, picking up a glass and filling it up with some sort of wine before passing it to him.
"Yes." The man took the glass and splashed the wine onto his head, and in the next moment, all the wine got absorbed.
"Hmm. What strange characters you have gathered, I think this is the first time I am seeing him," Pink spoke, looking curiously at the bandaged man.
"Yeah, he is one of my biggest treasures. I have kept him hidden but I think he is ready now to make his debut in the world; a fucking spectacular debut!" Red said, giving him more wine.
"Hmm, what’s his talent? Does he possess some very rare Field or something?" Pink questioned, becoming even more curious.
After all, this leader of the Bone Blood Cult wasn’t one to praise someone this much so easily.
"Should I tell you?" Red tapped over his chin as if deep in thought, then said:
"No, let’s keep it a surprise. Once the time comes you will understand just how great of a treasure this boy is. With just him, I can easily destroy kingdoms if I just wished so."
"Aye. Why are you keeping me in suspense? Sigh. Fine, if you have nothing else for me to do then I will be taking my leave."
Pink shook his head pitifully, his knees making cracking sounds as he stood up.
"Be careful on your way out, I heard there is a curfew going on outside." Red chuckled while speaking, excited as he thought of the future.
"..." Clicking his tongue, Pink jumped off the building and disappeared.
Just as Pink had left, the bandaged man stood up in a hurry and grabbed nearly ten glasses from the table in his hands as several arms grew out of him.
Then his body broke into several, each clone exactly similar to the previous one.
Red smiled seeing this scene.
With a snap of his finger, he destroyed three of the bodies, not caring which was supposed to be the original, and only two remained now.
"Go and become that old man.
He has been acting shady recently. Find out everything you could about him." Red ordered.
One of the bodies continued to drink the wine while the other reluctantly stood up and nodded, then his bandages began to rip as his flesh twisted and torn.
The sound of bones breaking rang out and his body looked like a bloody mess.
This transformation continued for a few minutes and finally, an old man looking exactly like Pink stood there.
"Ugh, my old knees. I can’t believe you made me come here at this age." The new old man said.
Red laughed loudly upon seeing this scene.
This ability was truly broken. Although it had its flaws, it was a complete cheat if used properly.
"Do you have any other identities?" Red questioned. Despite seeing it countless times before, it always baffled him.
"Huh? What identities? Red, are you doubting me right now?" The old man said, his brows furrowing.
This was one of the flaws of the bandaged man’s skill. Upon transforming into another person through his means that even Red wasn’t aware of, he would completely transform into him.
Even gaining a part of the memory, though very faint.
Even the abilities to some extent and many other things. But after countless experiments, Red had already found the way to control them.
"..." Without saying a word, he pulled a bottle filled with the bandaged man’s blood then drew a drop of blood from the old man’s body instantly.
Without wasting a moment, he drank it.
"Now, show me what other identities you have." Red said, and waited.
Under his gaze, the old man nodded like a puppet and then transformed into Pink’s appearance, one of the six seats. Then taking other appearances, the ones he used in other organisations.
And finally, he revealed his true appearance of a demon.
"Hahahaha, so he is a demon, how fabulous, so truly fabulous. And to think he had already infiltrated into so many organizations." Red muttered.
After thinking for a while, he ordered,
"Go and get as much details from the other organisations as you can while using the disguises."
"Yes." The old man nodded, and just like the original one, he jumped down the building and disappeared.
Red gazed at the bandaged man with shining eyes. This was really such a treasure, and he was going to exploit him to his death.
"Someone come here and clean this mess." Red ordered, pointing towards the three corpses.
After running and running for several minutes, Ziggy could still not reach his destination.
Originally he was following behind Xi and the others but their speed was so fast that they went ahead, even though he asked them to slow down.
"Huff Huff I- I am Oink going to huff get them huff p- punished by my huff oink father." Ziggy said, feeling the burning sensation in his chest from running for so long.
If it wasn’t for protecting Maeve and becoming cool in her eyes, then who would dare make him run so much?
’It is fine, to get a bride as beautiful as her, I am even ready to sacrifice a little of my fat.
I am sure seeing me covered in sweat and the worry in my eyes, her heart will melt and she would agree to marry me.’ Ziggy thought, and finally he saw several figures not too far away.
Xi and the other nine were floating in the air.
There were two people on the ground. Wiping the sweat from his eyes, Ziggy focused and was shocked to see Maeve seated on the lap of another man, his body froze for a moment.
Before anger flooded his mind, veins almost bulged out but were hidden under the fat. Even in human disguise, he had chosen a rather fat man, with weight more than 200 kgs.
"You bastard, Oink oink oink get away from my bride, huff huff I- I am going to kill- cough my father is going to huff huff kill you! Get away from her." Ziggy shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 409: Greatest Actors
paragraphs: "You bastard, Oink get away from my bride."
Ziggy finally arrived beside Xi and the other demons, and felt his blood boil at the sight of another man holding Maeve so closely.
"..." Vritra observed the fat man and found out that his strength wasn’t even at the General rank, even though his father was a demon lord and there were other lords in his family.
It was clear how much his family loved him.
He had just the perfect plan to use this piggy to get some sin points.
"Oh, and who are you?" Vritra questioned, his body covered by a purple aura and two horns on his head.
"Hahaha, I was the one to claim her when she was weak, so she certainly will be mine." After speaking, he held Maeve’s chin and kissed her cheek, almost giving a heart attack to the piggy.
"Uwaaaaaah OINK OINK Get your filthy lips away from my bride, h- how dare you kiss her.
Maeve, don’t worry I am going to save you." Piggy went mad, seeing the kiss while Vritra just laughed.
"What the hell are you doing just standing there? Help me save my bride!!" Ziggy shouted at the demons who floated there with helpless expressions.
But before Piggy could approach, Vritra held Maeve’s throat gently, though it didn’t look like it.
"Come closer and I will kill her." Vritra spoke, madness appearing in his eyes.
"Ooh, choke me master~" Maeve whispered, secretly giving him a naughty look.
Rolling his eyes, Vritra whispered back: "Don’t break the character now, this piggy will be of great use to us."
Maeve smiled before getting into character:
"Z- Ziggy, save me! When I was weak, he somehow got a hold of my life flame and now my life and death is in his hands. Sob help me!"

Ziggy’s heart trembled with joy, anger, and pain at the same time. He was really happy since this was the first time Maeve had talked to him or even said his name correctly while his anger was towards Vritra.
"Stop it! What do you want?" Ziggy shouted. He was ready to do anything to save Maeve.
"I don’t talk to pigs who can’t even show their real appearance." Vritra said, keeping his hand on Maeve’s throat, he kissed her cheek again.
Ziggy almost went mad. The demoness was supposed to be his future bride, so how could he just watch some other man do as he pleased with her?
He quickly came into his real appearance, becoming even fatter and looking as if he had come out of a sewer.
’Oh, he really is a pig. Foxie, how much your family must hate you to tie you up with someone like him.’ Vritra shook his head.
He just wanted to blow the head off that pig but there was an even greater fate ahead of that pig demon so he would be able to live a bit longer.
’Looks like before I save wifey, I have to get Foxie’s life flame from that Voromir realm.’ Vritra thought but that could be dealt with later, for now, he focused on Ziggy.
"Now we are talking, there is something I want you to steal from the temple in Ghazi city." Vritra spoke.
The overwhelming presence kept Ziggy on edge, otherwise he would have already attacked.
"What?!! Are you trying to blackmail me too? Maeve, did he do something to you?" Ziggy asked as he remembered something.
His fists clenched and his fat pig face looking pale.
"N- No, not yet. He knew that someone would be coming to save me very soon and when I mentioned you, he was afraid of your family name so he didn’t do anything to me." Maeve said.
She loved his perfect evil act.
"Sigh that’s oink good." He heaved a sigh of relief and felt a lot better.
"Don’t worry I am going to save you no matter what." Ziggy said.
"Yes I am blackmailing you, if you don’t get that something from the temple for me then you would never be able to see her."
Vritra said, pretending to increase the force in his grip and Maeve acted out her part.
"Stop it, don’t hurt her. I will think of something." Ziggy shouted. If Vritra hurt or broke her body then wouldn’t Maeve’s value be lower? Then there won’t be a point in getting her.
"Don’t you know about my family? If I complain to my father then he will rip you to shreds—" Ziggy spoke but he was interrupted by Vritra’s loud laughter.
"Try it, see if you can even contact our father."
Ziggy took out several treasures but for some reason nothing worked.
His face filled with horror as he understood that his own life might be in danger right now.
"I- If Oink you dare to hurt me, m- my father won’t let you oink be..." Ziggy said in a trembling voice.
"Oh don’t worry about that, I am not planning to hurt you." Vritra said, as if stating a fact.
’Sigh, that’s good then, I will just escape and then call my father—’ Ziggy thought.
"Try to call your father by leaving this place, just think what I can do to her in the meantime?" Vritra spoke, giving the pig demon an evil look and then biting Maeve’s earlobe.
"Ahh~ Don’t hurt me, please..." Maeve almost laughed while speaking her lines. She was even happier to see that Vritra seemed better and was returning to his original self.
Happy that she might have helped him even a little.
"Ugh fine, tell me what I need to steal. I will Oink Oink do it damnit." Ziggy finally agreed. Maeve was still of great value, how could he give up so easily?
"There is a statue of the Real God in the temple, steal it." Vritra said simply, moving his hand away from Maeve’s throat, though the fox demon wanted him to continue.
"What? That’s impossible!!" Ziggy shuddered at the thought.
"You mean to say, for the great Ziggy, the sole heir of such a powerful family, just stealing a puny statue is impossible?
I had heard many great things about you. Looks like you actually didn’t want to marry her." Vritra sighed, saying one good thing about the piggy after another.
"Fine I will do it, tomorrow I will steal the statue and save her from your grasp—wait, but what’s the guarantee you will be true to your word?"
Ziggy felt proud at his intelligence, to be able to think that far, he was truly one of a kind.
"Who would dare to lie to the great Ziggy? You know how afraid of your family I am, surely I can’t deceive you, right?
Now leave and arrive here tomorrow with the statue and Maeve will be free." Vritra said, shooing the demons away.
"I will have you pay the price for this, just wait Maeve, I will save you." Ziggy shouted as he turned and flew away.
Vritra had used the natural hypnosis to slowly change his mind, now he won’t even think about telling anyone else this matter.
But just in case, he even sent Psyche to follow the pig.
"What are you still dawdling here for? Get lost already!!" Maeve shouted at the dazed demons.

chapters.title: Chapter 410: Continental Crisis
paragraphs: "What are you still dawdling here for? Get lost already!!" Maeve shouted. This bunch of idiots almost ended her relationship with Vritra after all.
Maeve gave further orders: "Also, just return home and don’t tell anyone about my current situation or anything you saw here."
"Y- Yes Queen, we will be careful." Xi spoke in a daze and finally the group left.
"Master, what have you planned for Ziggy? Do you want him to get arrested while stealing the statue?" Maeve was really curious about Vritra’s plan.
She knew very little about him so she wasn’t sure of how he handled things.
"No, it is time for Ringmaster Daddy V to return." Vritra replied, smiling faintly as he gazed into the distance.
"Hmm?" The demoness tilted her head in confusion. Only after Vritra explained his plan did she finally understand how evil of a man she had chosen for herself.
"Hehe. That’s so wonderful, master. Mmm~ I love you..." Maeve wondered how many times this man was going to make her fall for him. She gave a hard kiss on his cheek and then licked her lips.
Being so close to him, she finally focused on the smell that she had been ignoring for so long.
GULP
"M- Master, if you don’t mind, can I eat you?" Maeve asked. She really wanted to have a taste of his blood again.
"...Okay, but you-" Before Vritra could say, Maeve pulled his cloth to expose more of his neck then she pressed her lips against his warm smooth skin, giving a sweet kiss.
Fangs grew in her mouth and finally she bit, though she used an ability of hers to bypass his defenses, and then the warm and delicious blood of her master flooded into her mouth.
GULP GULP
She sucked harder, savoring each drop of the tasty treat while hugging him tightly. Previously she had only gotten a sip but this was thousands of times better than she expected.
The demoness couldn’t stop herself from drinking.
But with his eternal vitality, the draining of so much blood had no effect on him.
He allowed her to drink the blood for a while then tapping over her head he spoke:
"That’s enough."
Maeve’s lips separated from his neck in reluctance. She licked his skin one last time before stepping back and enjoying the aftertaste.
"I am so full of energy, are we going to continue with the training?" she asked, licking her lips, her gaze even more obsessed.
"Yeah, we still have some time." Vritra nodded and once again, the fox demon began to strike him with all her might.
There were no further disturbances. Ziggy began to contact his father’s hidden forces to obtain more information about this treasure.
Remembering how Maeve asked for his help, the piggy wanted to steal it himself and become her hero.
After freeing her, he would definitely let his father kill Vritra for putting his hand on her.
Xi and other demons returned to the Voromir kingdom, and didn’t let any news about Maeve out.
Even though Raelion and a few others tried asking about her, they just made up random excuses like they weren’t able to find her.
Whether it was the queen, Raelion or most of the other demons in that realm, none of them really cared for her.
Though the three demon generals wanted to go search for her, they preferred to rather serve Maeve than the current sloth queen or idiotic Raelion.
The three were also worried about Vritra. They had seen that announcement as well and knew how much trouble he must be in.
But since he didn’t try to contact them, it was impossible for them to find his location. The three prayed that both Maeve and her supposed father should be alright.
Even inside the Quartz continent, things were only becoming more chaotic. Kryn, the leader of the Grieves, had started to make appearances all over the place.
Demons and other dark organisations were doing the same, each with their own hidden motives, which was putting all the people of the continent in terror.
Even with the curfew, it was becoming exceedingly difficult to control the crowd, even though Darius is a strict ruler but even he couldn’t just beat or kill so many of his own subjects.
The emperor was already depressed by the fact that Yennefer had cancelled that arrangement and made those choices.
She even abandoned her family so now there was no way to control her.
Darius felt he was too impatient, he regretted the whole fake marriage setup, it had brought all his progress to zero.
But it was too late. First he had to take back the control of the continent and then take care of his love life.
His own brother was killed in such a manner, every matter gave him intense headache.
He hadn’t even been able to see Yennefer ever since that night. The emperor couldn’t understand what could have changed her so much.
Her attachment with her family, her obsession with strength and demons were the only things he could use to get closer to her but now it was all useless.
Sitting over his throne, he rubbed his forehead and tried to think of a solution to at least calm the people of his kingdom.
Everything seemed to be out of control and order.
A long distance away inside the continent, high up in the sky, Yennefer flew at a normal pace.
She wanted to find Vritra but he seemed to have completely disappeared. With each passing day, the pain in her heart increased.
She yearned for his warmth, to hear his voice and to hide in his arms and to once again get what she had accidentally pushed away, Yennefer was ready to do anything.
She was also trying her best to get him out of his whole predicament, but even her strength wasn’t enough to contend against so many opponents.
Yennefer wasn’t even able to control the Null ability properly yet, but remembering the night they had separated, she could clearly tell that he had teleported away.
So his control and comprehension of Null was definitely a lot better than hers. He truly is too exceptional.
Just as she was passing by an area of old broken buildings, she caught the sight of a familiar person.
It was Pink but before she could have called out, his appearance changed right in front of her and he transformed into a high ranked member of the Nine Pacts.
Yennefer was shocked, but without raising an alarm she decided to secretly follow him. Unknown to her, it was the clone sent by the Bone Blood Cult to gather information.
Several hours passed just like that. It was already evening. Finally, Vritra decided to end the training session.
[Charged Fist: 26.16%]
"Well this is increasing steadily, I guess we will have to train for a few more days to raise it to a hundred." Vritra mumbled as he saw the system panel.
"Uwaah I am so sleepy, master, can we go back already?" Maeve asked rubbing her eye, her tail appearing just as lazy.
"Yeah, let’s go. We need to be well rested for tomorrow’s event." Vritra spoke, but Maeve seemed too tired after exhausting nearly all her energy.
"...Foxie come here." Vritra turned his back to her and called out. Maeve sleepily got closer and slumped onto his back.
Her arms circled around his neck while he held her thighs. Within moments the demoness fell asleep, feeling comfortable and safe.
Vritra glanced back, finding the demoness way too cute. After having his fill he flew up.
With Psyche following Ziggy around, he was keeping a constant eye on that pig demon, even getting to see their various hideouts.
It was just around 6 in the evening and the place seemed so quiet, but this quietness didn’t represent peace.
Unseen by anyone, the two quickly arrived at their hotel and teleported directly inside the room.
He gently put Maeve on the bed and laid down beside her. The fox had a habit of rolling around on the bed in her sleep.
Her leg moved to rest on top of his while she hugged Vritra. Even in her sleep, she seemed to try to bite his neck.
Vritra shook his head and closed his eyes. Even though getting beaten for the entire day wasn’t painful, it was a bit tiring.
Feeling Maeve’s soft body pressing against him, he fell asleep in a few minutes, drowning into the dream world.
Nearly seven hours had passed, and it was an hour past midnight.
Vritra’s eyes opened in alarm as he sat up, almost throwing Maeve away. Getting untangled from the demoness’s tight bindings he got off the bed.
Rage flashed across his eyes, and in the next moment he disappeared from the room.
Just now, he received a danger signal from Hellmancer. While patrolling the land around Charm city, the soul wraith had captured a shady man.
And after a short interrogation with the help of mind manipulation spells, Hellmancer found that it was someone from the Bone Blood Cult.
Vritra flew at full speed, his anger bursting out of his body in the form of demonic aura, suddenly turning the temperature of the entire Ghazi city colder.
Within moments, he arrived outside the continent where the captured man had been dragged by Hellmancer.
Landing on the ground with an explosive sound, Vritra looked at Hellmancer and questioned: "Where is he?!"
"Master," the sorcerer bowed and with a tap of his staff on the ground, a man tied by black shadows submerged out of the ground, even his mouth was shut tight.
Terror could be seen in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 411: The Great Ritual
paragraphs: "Alright, return and make sure to protect the city of Charms at all times." Vritra ordered.
The sorcerer covered in darkness bowed before disappearing like smoke.
Now, present under the starry sky, only Vritra and the captive lying on the ground remained.
"Mmmph! Ughhh Oooo!" The man from Bone Blood Cult kept trying to shout but with his mouth covered he wasn’t able to do anything.
He had also tried to commit suicide but Hellmancer made sure nothing of that sort happened.
"Now, tell me everything you know." Vritra muttered. With a thought, a knife of dust appeared and cut off the binding of his mouth.
"Huff huff I- I really don’t know anything, please spare me..." All of his teeth had been broken and energy sealed. Hellmancer left him no way to commit suicide.
"Well I am the one to decide that, let’s see if you are lying or not." Vritra spoke and instead of using the Nihil anima, he just used the elegy parasite.
[Elegy Parasite Activated.]
A bug appeared on the captive’s body and within moments, thin threads like roots spread across his body and soon all his movements stopped.
Vritra waited for the process to complete then he asked the same question again. "Tell me what you know, what exactly were you doing there?"
"Ughh..." The man seemed to be struggling but that only lasted for a second.
With the difference in level of the both, the parasite was already quite strong.
Soon, he was completely in Vritra’s control.
"W- We were ordered by our leader to spread some sort of powder around that place." The man finally answered.
Even though his mind was filled with horror, after all, his original consciousness hadn’t been erased, it was still there.
"Oh, and what sort of powder was it? Was it poisonous? How many of you were with you?" Vritra asked, a frown appearing over his face.
"I- I don’t know what its function was b- but it didn’t seem to be poisonous, w- we were around twenty." His body was shivering as he kept answering all questions.
"Hmm, what are you guys planning now?" Vritra muttered to himself.
Such a low level could only be used as cannon fodder; there was no way he would have much information.
"Alright, now you can return to your base, act like usual and when I give you the signal, make your body explode." Vritra spoke as he broke the restriction on the man’s energy.
All the wounds soon began to heal.
Before leaving Vritra questioned: "Tell me about your leader and base, how strong are the forces there?"
"T- There- Ughhhh Uwaaaaaah-" Just as the man was about to speak, he felt immense pain in his head and fell to the ground.
"Sigh, forget it, just return to your base." Vritra said. It was obvious that some sort of seal was placed on him to stop him from leaking any sort of information in any scenario.
He might just die here if Vritra continued to force him, so it was better to stop and get whatever info he could get.
"Y- Yes." He stood up and nodded, then turned around and flew away.
"Hubby, be careful, if he is heading to the main base of the Bone Blood Cult then I would suggest you not do anything for now.
The leader called Red isn’t someone we can take on right now; we can use some more time to grow before meeting him." Yasmine spoke in a worried tone.
"Yeah I know, don’t worry, I won’t be rash. If I sense danger I can’t handle." Vritra replied as his body began to float and then disappeared.
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]
’Damnit damnit, why am I the one with the worst luck? Out of all, why am I the only one who got caught?
Sigh but seems like everyone is going to meet the same fate soon, at least knowing that is comforting.’ The captive was going wild in his head as he flew back towards his secret base.
In the night he couldn’t see who Vritra was. His body seemed to be covered by some sort of darkness just like the one who captured him.
But it was obvious, his strength was at or near the Lord rank.
Flying at a fast pace, the man soon landed on the ground and walked into a narrow empty alley.
There was a big hole in the ground that seemed to be filled with dirty water, but he just jumped inside. The water was not real.
A shadow from behind continued to follow him, staying far enough but also close enough.
Passing by that hole, the man appeared in a cave that seemed to have been made underground with the passage of time.
There were several intersections.
Choosing one of them, he continued to walk, taking various turns and passing through strange entrances.
There were many illusions and barriers. After nearly twenty minutes, he had finally arrived in what seemed to be the real base.
It was a well-built building, with an enormous hall and countless rooms.
There were thousands of people going on with their work.
All of them were the members of the Bone Blood Cult. The stench of blood was heavy in the entire place.
"What are you still doing here? Did you complete the mission?"
Just as the captive had walked into the hall, one of the men walking in hurry, stopped and questioned?
"Yes, I d- did." His eyes seemed red, but the other guy didn’t think too much. Many of them did drugs and other strange activities so it was pretty normal.
"Then why are you just standing here? The great Ritual is about to start, did you forget?" The other man tapped over his shoulder and gestured to come.
"Yes, I was about to h- head there, let’s go to- together." The captive nodded.
Of course, he too was in a hurry to return because of this ritual, and in this hurry, he ended up getting caught.
’Sigh if he comes here, the ritual would be the last of our worries.’
Vritra walked into the large hall and looked around. It seemed the people here loved the colour red too much; everything was painted in red here.
Even the walls were covered with the smell of blood.
"Ritual?" Vritra mumbled, but it wasn’t a surprise since these lunatics often performed such rituals.

But after hearing the conversation from the people around him, he got to know that this ritual was a little special and only happened once every few years in one of the branch bases of the Bone Blood Cult.
Which meant this wasn’t the real base.
The leader wasn’t here either but he was supposed to come here by the end of the ritual.
Vritra followed along the group, no one here could sense him.
The strongest people here were at the general rank, so the danger was pretty low.
"These pests, even the stench of their body is so ugly, I wish I could have eradicated every single one of them." Yasmine cursed.
She really hated this organisation.
’Don’t worry, they will be gone very soon, all of them.’ Vritra replied.
Walking out of the hall through one of the large doors, he found himself in a forest.
