chapters.title: Chapter 412: Suffering
paragraphs: Thousands of men in red robes were standing there. At the forefront was a large altar.
Hundreds of people were lying on the altar. There were children, men, women, old, demons, and many others.
Using Misty Essence, Vritra’s body changed and he came out of the disappearing state.
He touched the shoulder of one of the men beside him and questioned: "Uh... I am newly recruited here, what sort of ritual is this?"
"Newly recruited? Have you been living under a rock?" The other guy shook his head and continued:
"In this ritual, we have to offer more than one hundred families to our God and he would grant us with a creature of myth, though even after so many years, we have not been able to get one."
Vritra glanced at the altar. Those people were conscious but couldn’t move, tears kept rolling from their eyes.
They hadn’t just captured individuals, they had captured entire families.
The sorrow, pain, helplessness, despair of seeing their children, their parents die such horrible death was the energy they needed.
The mothers on the altars looked at their children with pain and fear, continuously begging for anyone, anyone to come and save them.
Vritra’s frown deepened. How were these humans not worse than the demons? And they had been doing this for many years.
Laughter of the men from Bone Blood Cult was ringing.
They all seemed excited that their base was selected to carry on this special ritual.
Originally, the ritual was supposed to happen sooner but their leader delayed it for some reason.
Their leader, Red, was supposed to be here already but he was busy with some tasks and would come here soon.
Under the watchful eyes of the thousands of men, one of the men wearing a large robe that didn’t look right for his size walked onto the altar.
He was holding a knife in his hand.
"My loyal brothers, today we have gathered here to call upon our god and take the form of the Myth, the Rubble!"
The leader of the base shouted, his voice filling them all with even more excitement.
"Rubble is a creature consisting of rotten flesh and bones. It is said to be thousands of meters tall and as large as a city. It could destroy kingdoms and bring plague.
It is the most disgusting form a god could descend to this mortal world in."
Yasmine explained in a solemn tone, shocked that these crazy bastards were doing something so mindless.
Although the god couldn’t come or interfere with the mortals directly, they could do a lot indirectly.
They could even take some mortal forms to descend.
"O God, grace us with your presence and accept this small offering, with the blood, flesh, bones, love, despair, fear, sadness, please take the form of The Rubble!!"
The leader shouted again, his strength was a little above that of an average general.
"Hubby, we have to stop this, immediately!" Yasmine spoke, barely holding back from rushing out and burning them all to a crisp.
’Don’t worry, leave it all to me.’ Vritra replied, not like he was going to let them live anyway for targeting his family.
He might be a demon, not a very good person but he had a bottom line and still wouldn’t just let those people die.
The righteous sometimes are more rotten than the evil. So many families had disappeared. There is no way no one had noticed such a big change.
Yet there has been no news of this and no investigations.
The emperor even started a curfew to stop the flow of news to save his image and control chaos.
’This place is just as rotten as Earth, there none of us could do anything as politicians, rich ate away everything.
But here, with enough strength, anything is possible.’ Vritra thought, his eyes glowing with a red light.

"Now, I invite someone from among you, the lucky one to come and make the first sacrifice! We, the Bone Blood Cult, shall dominate and destroy the world! Everything will end, and we will be the cause!"
The leader shouted as everyone in the crowd screamed.
"Tell me which of you want to be the first, the first to kill a family here. We need to make them cry more, our God needs it, our God demands it!"
The leader gazed at the thousands of people and looked for someone who looked special in the crowd.
Vritra directly disappeared from his position and reappeared at the front of the crowd. His clothes changed and became a bit larger for his body.
Using the natural hypnosis, he pulled the leader’s attention towards himself.
"YOU! YES YOU, COME UP HERE!" At the first sight the leader knew that he was the one, the one to get the title of first slaughterer.
"Yessss!" Vritra let out an excited shout as he hurriedly climbed onto the altar. The other people looked at him with jealousy.
"Take this knife and cut open their blood vessels, let them bleed and watch their family members struggle in vain, as they feel pain." The leader gave Vritra the knife and instructed.
He really wanted to do it himself but as the leader, he couldn’t.
Though he would soon be killing a lot of families.
"Yes, I will." Vritra held the knife tightly. The people cheered him on and kept shouting for the kill.
The sobs and groans of the people lying on the altar were drowned in the screams.
They looked at Vritra in fear, pleading to the god to at least let their family members survive.
"Hmm. Now, prove me your worth by selecting the best family out of them, we are all waiting for you." The leader said.
Vritra gazed around at all the families.
He could feel their despair, their silent pleading, the fear as they looked at their children.
There were even newborns lying on the altar, crying out, but their parents could do nothing.
One of the women was suddenly able to speak though her body remained paralyzed.
"COUGH P- Please spare my daughter sob sob I am begging you, kill me if y- you want and let her g- go, she is just t- two sob HELPPPP!"
"Oh, looks like we have got just the perfect target. Now go on and start. After ten minutes of bleeding, we will set the entire family on fire."
The leader said, taking a deep breath of the suffering.
"Yes." Vritra nodded as he and the leader walked closer to the woman, her daughter and her husband.
"DO IT! DO IT! DO IT!"
"Hurry up, if you can’t then let me be the one!"
All the people were shouting from the crowd.
Vritra silently teleported the whole place into his Dimensional book.
A big part of forest was shifted without anyone noticing.
Then he raised the knife, looking into the eyes of the woman who was constantly pleading and crying and finally he brought the knife down in a swift slash.
WHOOSH
Two arms were cut off clean and flew in the air.
At this moment everyone had turned silent, and then heart wrenching screams of the leader filled the whole place.
Vritra didn’t stop.

chapters.title: Chapter 413: Trap?
paragraphs: Pulling his hand back, Vritra stabbed the knife into the leader’s eye, tightly clutching his hair before pulling it down very slowly.
"AAAAAAAAAH!" His head was split in two, but this was just the beginning.
All the others just stood there frozen on the ground, wondering if the instructions weren’t clear enough.
But as the act on the stage got more cruel and brutal, they all shivered.
Their bodies trembled at every scream, every cut and stab of the knife. It became so bloody that even these lunatics began to vomit.
Being at that level, the leader’s body was healing quite fast, plus he seemed to possess some strange skill that burned his blood to heal.
So Vritra could continue without a care. His right hand plunged into the leader’s torso, as he gripped the leader’s heart.
"Krrkkkhhh cough cough s- stop please ughhh cough" he coughed blood as both his eyes healed back, a terrified expression appearing on his face.
Even more shocked were the people lying on the altar.
Just a moment ago they were begging for mercy and all of a sudden they were watching such a nice show.
Suddenly Vritra paused and glanced at the men who were just frozen and watching everything happen, their bodies wouldn’t move an inch.
"Are you just going to watch? Why don’t you all join in on the fun?" As Vritra spoke, his left hand got covered by the root-like thin fibers of the parasite.
[Elegy Parasite Activated.]
And in the next moment, countless tiny parasites spread across the air, flying at a really fast speed but invisible to the naked eye.
Within just moments, almost all of the people got at least one of those parasites on their bodies and then Vritra commanded.
"Don’t stand idle, start eating one another, will you?" As they all heard, the expressions of the people turned horrified.
At first, they tried to escape but to their horror, they seemed to have lost control of their bodies.
Not all of them were affected by this order and they were even more terrified; their brothers in arms seemed to have become zombies.
In the next moment, an even bloody show began.
The members of the Bone Blood Cult began to bite and tear off one another, ripping off flesh and bones.
To stop the people on the stage from seeing this all, he even covered the whole altar with a layer.
While the people were tearing off one another, Vritra once again focused on torturing the leader.
But he felt that this was all too strange; from that man getting caught to this ritual and his perfect timing.
Vritra’s hands paused in the midst of tearing off his limbs. He attached another parasite to the leader’s body and questioned:
"When did you plan this whole ritual?"
"W- We- ughhhh aaaaah" Just as he was about to answer, the leader felt intense pain in his head.
Surely it was similar to the captive, and Vritra finally understood that this was certainly a trap by the Bone Blood Cult.
Leaving the group of survivors and the Bone Blood Cult inside the dimensional book, Vritra teleported directly outside.
Since everyone had been teleported, the whole forest seemed empty and quiet, but Vritra could faintly sense a presence.
"Hubby, you are right, I think this is a trap. We should leave." Yasmine spoke in alarm.
But when Vritra tried to teleport he found that the whole place had been sealed and it wasn’t just to seal the space, all sorts of seals had been placed there.
Vritra could no longer even use his mana.
"Well, you are a lot better than I expected." Suddenly a rough voice sounded from the entrance of the place.
Vritra turned and saw the man wearing a robe, but there was no skin on his body and killing intent around his body was several times stronger than even his own.
"This is Red! The leader of Bone Blood Cult." Yasmine spoke in surprise.
"Red..." Vritra mumbled to himself. He didn’t panic but looked calmly at the leader of the whole organisation.
"Interesting, you shifted them all to a different self-built dimension. So space is your Field. How rare, you are quite talented and a lot stronger than I heard."
Red spoke in an intrigued tone, walking closer and then pausing nearly ten meters from Vritra.
"You want to capture me?" Vritra questioned, showing no signs of fear.
"Hmm I planned to, but I think it would be better to recruit someone like you. So would you like to join Bone Blood Cult?
If you do, I can take care of your problem in a single day and then no one would be hunting you." Red said, quite confident in his offer.
"Okay, and what else will I get by joining Bone Blood Cult? To be honest, I don’t have a good impression of you guys, no motive and no goal, just pure bloodshed.
What’s even the point of destruction if you don’t have a path ahead?" Vritra questioned, crossing his arms over his chest.
Red fell into deep thoughts and then answered: "Of course we have a goal, it’s just the world is too blind to see it.
And if you join us, you will get whatever you want. Tell me what demands you have. To get a talent such as you, I... can be a bit lenient." Red said.
Vritra was the next Divine, so if he could really join Bone Blood Cult then it would definitely be the strongest organisation given time.
"Alright, first make me the leader of Bone Blood Cult. Second, you will personally be serving my slave, Shitless.
Third, I need to slap your parents for bringing this ugly thing to this world. Fourth... Twenty-eighth, you have to personally clean shoes on the street from 9 to 11 in the morning. Twen-"
Vritra continued with his reasonable demands.
"Enough, I have heard enough of your jokes. Now just give me your answers, will you join Bone Blood Cult or not?" Red barely held back his anger. Who would dare to be so arrogant in front of him?
"Well an old friend of mine told me that Bone Blood Cult is for those with small dicks so no thanks." Vritra rejected.
He knew his only choice was to escape but he wanted to test Red’s strength a bit first.
’Dimensional book can surely hide me for a while but it won’t be hard for Red to find and destroy that dimension, so hiding there is not an option.’
Vritra thought, and there were absolutely no other ways to run.
"Haa what a pity, it would really have been great if you could have joined our organisation, but it is fine to capture you too."
Red said while shaking his head, the air around him becoming dangerously sharp.
Vritra didn’t use the demonic energy. He took a step forward, wanting to test if Red would be able to get through his physical defenses.
"..." Without saying a word further, Red raised his hand and made a gripping gesture towards Vritra as a hand of blood suddenly formed and tried to catch him.
"Tsk tsk too slow, is this the limit of the leader of Bone Blood Cult? Sigh thank god I didn’t join." Vritra said, his body flashing away as he put all his divine skills to use.

chapters.title: Chapter 414: {Sin Point Gained: Mocked +1}
paragraphs: Red didn’t get angry. He knew that Vritra had no way to escape and using his limited strength he could get to see more of Vritra’s secrets.
Suddenly, Red’s body broke apart and several figures just like him spread throughout the place, trying to attack Vritra.
’He isn’t going all out, wifey, you know something that will make him really angry?’ Vritra questioned while dodging all the attacks. Red wasn’t trying to hurt him but capture him.
"Hm..." Yasmine pondered and soon gave an answer: "Yeah, his peeled-off skin is his honor, that’s why he doesn’t even let it heal. Mock it and he will hit you with all his might."
"Hey, no wonder you are called BBC, did you enjoy as your leader peeled you off? Haha look at that, rotting away like a gutter bug, a mistake left behind in the world by two fools.
Did your parents look as ugly as you? Tell me, what do you say every morning when you see that face of yours in the mirror?
I almost feel pity for you pffttt—" With his constant mocking, Vritra had successfully angered him.
{Sin Point Gained: Mocked +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged+1}
{Sin Point Gained: Blood Thirsty +1}
"DO YOU WANT TO DIE THAT BADLY?" Red’s eyes had turned bloodshot, his body shivering with rage.
It had taken hundreds of years for him to be able to control his emotions and not always act like a bloodthirsty beast, but all that hard work seemed to be for naught at this moment.
"Hah. As if your peeled ass could do anything. Tell me, how deep your master entered you to peel you from the insid—"
Vritra was speaking but this seemed to be the breaking point of the leader as he finally went berserk.
Forgetting everything, he lost his sanity as he began to launch full power attack at Vritra.
Normally, just a little of that would have obliterated someone of general rank.
An enormous pillar of blood appeared in front of Vritra and Red’s body began to grow in a twisted manner, really looking like a crazy beast at this moment.
After growing over twenty meters, he gathered a vast amount of energy, turning even the air red as his fist descended towards Vritra at extreme speed.

Even before the punch had landed, the ground under his feet sank. Vritra felt extreme pressure on his body as his clothes got shredded in an instant. But thankfully, he wore the clothes Maeve had given.
The strength Red was displaying was definitely above that of Maeve.
First, Maeve never went all out, and her strength was lower than Red.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!
The forest several kilometres around the whole place was destroyed instantly and Vritra’s body sank deep into the ground.
The red blood energy continued to try to destroy his body, even seeping into his skin but was unable to do any damage.
Vritra kicked the ground and rushed out of the deep crater as he floated at the same height as the beast in front of him.
"Try again!"
With a mocking look, he spoke. Whatever sanity was left instantly disappeared and only the thought of killing Vritra remained now, at any cost.
Red even used his special technique to burn his blood, life force and mana as his strength increased even further.
Waves of bloody hands appeared on his back and at lightning speed, countless attacks hit Vritra’s body, creating extremely loud noises.
At that strength, destroying a single city could be done in a few seconds if no one tries to stop him.
This was a different realm, quite vast, spanning over hundreds of kilometres.
But at this moment, under the attacks of the large creature, everything began to break apart. The space trembled and the ground was torn.
Vritra was shocked at the full power of a Lord.
Even destroying entire kingdoms wouldn’t be too difficult for them, and Red was only growing strong as Vritra continued to mock him.
Yet he failed to kill him no matter what sort of attack he used.
If he was sane and could freely use all his skills then like Maeve he might have found a way to get past his defence but in this state, Red was going full-on brute force.
’Even with the full power of Demonic energy, it would be very difficult to kill Red right now. Looks like I need to get past that limit, at least the charged fist is charging right now.’
Vritra thought, glancing at the meter that was rising faster than before.
"GRAAAAAAAAAAAH" Red continued to let out inhumane noises, his body growing stronger and stronger.
Several minutes passed but he failed to kill this weak ant which made him even angrier.
Vritra just allowed his body to be thrashed around, getting beaten by the large creature. It didn’t hurt but it was quite bad to be a part of this one-sided fight.
’Looks like this realm won’t be able to hold on for too long.’ Vritra thought. He could already see the space cracking up.
ROAAAAAARRRRRRRRRR
BAANNNGGGGGG!
With an explosive noise, Vritra’s body got thrown dozens of kilometres away. He was really turning into a ball at this moment.
The strange fight continued for nearly thirty minutes, but soon, as Red began to feel a bit exhausted, his sanity once again started to return.
Nearly forty minutes had passed. The large monster was now panting and had stopped attacking. In his wild eyes, some sort of intelligence could be seen.
"Sigh looks like it is over." Vritra pulled himself out of the ground and dusted off his clothes, as they regenerated on their own.
Red glanced around at the space and understood Vritra’s plan. If the realm really ended up getting destroyed then he would easily be able to escape.
’B- But how is this possible? How did his body take so much damage and still look perfectly fine? Is this the ability of the Divine?’
Red was utterly shocked at this regeneration and he wanted Vritra to be a part of his organisation even more.
’It’s alright if only I can capture him then getting him on my side won’t be a problem.’
Red made up his mind as he took a deep breath and returned to his original size, taking out a robe and putting it over his body.
"Enough of your games, you have greatly impressed me despite your foul mouth. Now no matter what, I am going to make you join Bone Blood Cult." Red said and began to chant something.
Vritra sensed that things were turning dangerous now and staying here any longer would be not good. Red really might be able to capture him.
"Sure, try it if you can." Vritra smiled and showed him middle fingers.
Then his body fell back freely and right before he would hit the ground a strange portal opened behind him, swallowing him instantly.
"!!!" Red couldn’t believe that a portal could still be opened.
It was just impossible. He rushed forward but it was already too late.
"Damnit, how did he do that? He is a lot more special than even my treasure it seems." Red felt rage and an intense desire to acquire those abilities, but for now, his plan had failed utterly.

{Sin Point Gained: Enraged+1}
{Sin Point Gained: Blood Thirsty +1}
"DO YOU WANT TO DIE THAT BADLY?" Red’s eyes had turned bloodshot, his body shivering with rage.
It had taken hundreds of years for him to be able to control his emotions and not always act like a bloodthirsty beast, but all that hard work seemed to be for naught at this moment.
"Hah.
As if your peeled ass could do anything.
Tell me, how deep your master entered you to peel you from the insid—"
Vritra was speaking but this seemed to be the breaking point of the leader as he finally went berserk.
Forgetting everything, he lost his sanity as he began to launch full power attack at Vritra.
Normally, just a little of that would have obliterated someone of general rank.
An enormous pillar of blood appeared in front of Vritra and Red’s body began to grow in a twisted manner, really looking like a crazy beast at this moment.
After growing over twenty meters, he gathered a vast amount of energy, turning even the air red as his fist descended towards Vritra at extreme speed.
Even before the punch had landed, the ground under his feet sank.
Vritra felt extreme pressure on his body as his clothes got shredded in an instant.
But thankfully, he wore the clothes Maeve had given.
The strength Red was displaying was definitely above that of Maeve.
First, Maeve never went all out, and her strength was lower than Red.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!
The forest several kilometres around the whole place was destroyed instantly and Vritra’s body sank deep into the ground.
The red blood energy continued to try to destroy his body, even seeping into his skin but was unable to do any damage.
Vritra kicked the ground and rushed out of the deep crater as he floated at the same height as the beast in front of him.
"Try again!"
With a mocking look, he spoke.
Whatever sanity was left instantly disappeared and only the thought of killing Vritra remained now, at any cost.
Red even used his special technique to burn his blood, life force and mana as his strength increased even further.
Waves of bloody hands appeared on his back and at lightning speed, countless attacks hit Vritra’s body, creating extremely loud noises.
At that strength, destroying a single city could be done in a few seconds if no one tries to stop him.
This was a different realm, quite vast, spanning over hundreds of kilometres.
But at this moment, under the attacks of the large creature, everything began to break apart.
The space trembled and the ground was torn.
Vritra was shocked at the full power of a Lord.
Even destroying entire kingdoms wouldn’t be too difficult for them, and Red was only growing strong as Vritra continued to mock him.
Yet he failed to kill him no matter what sort of attack he used.
If he was sane and could freely use all his skills then like Maeve he might have found a way to get past his defence but in this state, Red was going full-on brute force.
’Even with the full power of Demonic energy, it would be very difficult to kill Red right now.
Looks like I need to get past that limit, at least the charged fist is charging right now.’
Vritra thought, glancing at the meter that was rising faster than before.
"GRAAAAAAAAAAAH" Red continued to let out inhumane noises, his body growing stronger and stronger.
Several minutes passed but he failed to kill this weak ant which made him even angrier.
Vritra just allowed his body to be thrashed around, getting beaten by the large creature.
It didn’t hurt but it was quite bad to be a part of this one-sided fight.
’Looks like this realm won’t be able to hold on for too long.’ Vritra thought.
He could already see the space cracking up.
ROAAAAAARRRRRRRRRR
BAANNNGGGGGG!
With an explosive noise, Vritra’s body got thrown dozens of kilometres away.
He was really turning into a ball at this moment.
The strange fight continued for nearly thirty minutes, but soon, as Red began to feel a bit exhausted, his sanity once again started to return.
Nearly forty minutes had passed.
The large monster was now panting and had stopped attacking.
In his wild eyes, some sort of intelligence could be seen.
"Sigh looks like it is over." Vritra pulled himself out of the ground and dusted off his clothes, as they regenerated on their own.
Red glanced around at the space and understood Vritra’s plan.
If the realm really ended up getting destroyed then he would easily be able to escape.
’B- But how is this possible?
How did his body take so much damage and still look perfectly fine?
Is this the ability of the Divine?’
Red was utterly shocked at this regeneration and he wanted Vritra to be a part of his organisation even more.
’It’s alright if only I can capture him then getting him on my side won’t be a problem.’
Red made up his mind as he took a deep breath and returned to his original size, taking out a robe and putting it over his body.
"Enough of your games, you have greatly impressed me despite your foul mouth.
Now no matter what, I am going to make you join Bone Blood Cult." Red said and began to chant something.
Vritra sensed that things were turning dangerous now and staying here any longer would be not good.
Red really might be able to capture him.
"Sure, try it if you can." Vritra smiled and showed him middle fingers.
Then his body fell back freely and right before he would hit the ground a strange portal opened behind him, swallowing him instantly.
"!!!" Red couldn’t believe that a portal could still be opened.
It was just impossible.
He rushed forward but it was already too late.
"Damnit, how did he do that?
He is a lot more special than even my treasure it seems." Red felt rage and an intense desire to acquire those abilities, but for now, his plan had failed utterly.

chapters.title: Chapter 415: Thieves in the Temple
paragraphs: Turning around, Red flew away in disappointment and anger. He really wanted to destroy the whole city but held back on his urges.
"Patience is the key; I need to be virtuous." Red mumbled to himself as he left, but not before killing a few of his Bone Blood Cult’s members.
At this base, almost all of the members had disappeared since lots were trapped in the dimensional book and many were killed by Red, leaving only a few behind.
The forest realm had barely survived the full power attacks of a lord, and it slowly began to heal back.
There was complete silence for a while, and Vritra seemed to have disappeared completely from the entire continent.
After an hour or so had passed, a small portal opened and Vritra peeked out of it.
After making sure that Red had left he heaved a sigh of relief and walked out.
Just now he had escaped into the abandoned realm, not even Red would be able to find him there.
If he pulled Red into that realm then there is a chance that Vritra might have succeeded in killing him, but it was not wise to expose his trump cards without full surety.
"Hoo, well that was some nice action..." Vritra mumbled while stretching his body, then he glanced at his status panel.
[Charged Fist: 39.06%]
In such a short time, the charge had gone quite high, though Red had lost quite a lot of his life force, energy and blood for this.
"First let’s get out of here." Vritra left the realm and once again found himself inside the Bone Blood Cult base, then he flew up and tore through the ceiling.
Getting out, he found himself in a rather desolate area, the houses seemed built recently and no one was inside. Clearly this whole area belonged to Bone Blood Cult.
"..." Before leaving, Vritra began to gather the purple demon god energy over his finger. It was extremely concentrated and destructive, just by using a little energy.
"Well that wasn’t so bad after all." Vritra mumbled as he dropped the tiny sphere of energy and disappeared into the dimensional book.
In the next moment...
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Just as the whole base exploded, killing the few people left behind, another loud explosion sounded from far away.
Vritra glanced there and saw a cloud of flames rising high up in the sky, the explosion there seemed even more deadly.
"I wonder if some dark organisation is behind that. Anyway, let’s deal with the trapped bugs first." Vritra turned and left.
Far away, Yennefer flew into the sky after creating a bloody massacre on the ground. She had killed all the members of the Nine Pact’s branch base and even that Pink’s clone.
Although there were things that confused her, from the information she had gotten, Yennefer was filled with worry.
"Husband, I need to meet him asap and tell him all about this, he needs to leave this place immediately." She mumbled to herself.
She had only heard a little of the plans of different organizations but if things continued like this then Vritra would have no chance of survival.
Her eyes filled with panic as she flew away, not caring about the bloody scene she had left behind.
’Why is it so difficult to find you again, where are you?’ Yennefer thought before disappearing in search of Vritra.
Returning to the hotel room, Vritra found Maeve still sleeping soundly.
Without disturbing her, he returned to the book of dimensions and saw the gruesome scene of cannibalism.
Those members of Bone Blood Cult were still tearing off each other’s flesh and eating organs; the leader wasn’t spared either but they were all still alive.

"Bobby, just devour their souls and kill the ones that are close to death, otherwise let them eat each other." Vritra commanded. Even though their bodies were moving with brutality, the terror was clearly visible in their eyes.
After giving the order, he glanced at the survivors—humans and other species, there were even some demons.
"Hmm, should I just let them out?" he wondered, and after a moment decided to give this task to someone trustworthy later on.
Coming out of the book, he first went to take a bath, since his body had the faint smell of blood.
After getting out of the bathroom and getting dressed, he climbed onto the bed and laid back, though it would be quite difficult to sleep now.
Just as he laid down on the bed, the fox demon rolled over and once again tangled with his body, clinging to him tightly.
Vritra turned to face her and embraced her back, pulling Maeve into his arms and closed his eyes.
’Tomorrow is going to be quite chaotic, if things fail then it might get dangerous, otherwise I will be earning a lot of sin points.’ He missed the messages of large amounts of points so much.
If not for that damned Divine, he would be peacefully farming sin points in the White Kingdom and would only move on after maxing everything up.
Surrounded by the softness of Maeve’s body, her warmth and scent quickly calmed him down and it wasn’t long before Vritra fell asleep.
As the sun rose, the news about the two explosions spread—even the curfew could no longer hold back the panicked crowd.
And it had become almost impossible for Darius to control everything now. With all the mess he was in, he couldn’t even find a solution.
In the temple, inside the confession booth, the pope was standing on one side while a blonde woman was on the other.
The pope had kept the gate open just a bit.
And outside the confession booth, several workers and guards were standing to hear of the story of lust.
’Sob, why am I getting punished like this? I hate the stench of horny men, it feels like they would come inside at any moment and do something.’ Shitless cried internally.
The booth was surrounded by so many men.
Most of them were middle-aged fat men, the stench of their horny sweat almost made him puke.
’I won’t be reckless from now on, sob so please rescue me someone.’ Shitless begged while he spoke in a sexy and hesitant tone.
"T- Then he pulled my robe from haa, from behind; I thought it was my husband so I..." Shitless read the script given to him by Onest, feeling disgusted at the content.
"A- And? What huff huff What did he do then?" The pope’s labored breath sounded, along with the quick breathing of several other men.
While this was happening in the hall of the temple, three men entered the temple through secret passages wearing black clothes.
Two of the men were thin and tall while one was very fat and short; the three thieves were extremely careful to not raise any alarms.
Onest was here to steal the statue under Vritra’s order. As he entered from the right side, he was already finished with his research.
Ziggy was also here to steal the statue under Vritra’s demand. He got all the information from his father’s underling, who had been spies in the continent for a long time.
And the third thief entered from behind the temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 416: The Successful Pig
paragraphs: While the show of lust was going on in the temple, the three thieves made their way inside through different passages.
’This is going to be the ultimate test of my skill, I have to get the statue within twenty minutes.’ Onest thought, he was crawling through a very narrow path.
Carefully observing his surroundings and making full use of Thievery skills, even putting the guards to sleep if they were in the way.
He had noticed that since he started following Vritra, he had been facing too much danger. But it was all fun and even gave him opportunity to grow.
It was Onest’s goal to become the best thief in the world and finally settle down, starting the most famous family of thieves.
His body moved through even the paths that seemed impossible for a grown man like him.
His bones and flesh twisted and almost became something like an octopus.
After crawling through the thin path for over ten minutes, he cut open a circle below him, in the ceiling.
Then he jumped down, immediately throwing a needle at four guards’ necks, and within moments they were asleep.
’These things are very expensive but quite effective, maybe I should get more of them in the future.’
Onest thought as he hurriedly pulled the needles and observed his surroundings.
Right now, he was right behind the treasury where the statue was kept.
Vritra had also instructed him later on to not steal from the front but through the back, and leave absolutely no traces of himself.
Just going from the front would have been a lot easier than this, but Onest was always ready for the challenges.
Walking close to the wall, he pressed his ear against it and closed his eyes. Using his ability, he began to cut the wall in a specific manner.
But just after reaching a bit deeper, he encountered a problem.
The container which held the statue was made of some material that Onest couldn’t cut through with any of his skills or weapons.
’Damnit, how can I get past it, do I have to give up?’ He felt troubled; only going through the door seemed to be the only option now.
But just then the shadow under his feet moved. A hand popped out holding a flimsy and old knife.
’Doesn’t this thing belong to that Psycho? Did he send it here to help me?’ Onest thought but he didn’t waste any time, taking the knife he once again got to work.
On the other side, Ziggy pulled up his slipping black outfit as he made his way into the temple.
When entering a door, his body almost got stuck but thankfully, he had oiled up his body in advance.
"Hah, this will be a piece of cake."
Putting a mask over his face, the pig demon kept throwing glyph after glyph that put the guards to sleep and made his adventure a lot easier.
With the proper planning of his father’s underling, he just entered through the front door and walked into the treasury.
The third thief, our great Divine Demonic Dragon, entered from behind.
Vritra just entered his disappearing state and passed through the walls, but unlike the two other thieves his motive wasn’t the statue.
He headed towards the potion treasury of the temple; he needed to get the soul potions for Yasmine after all.
"Hehe we are back to business, we couldn’t steal in the White Kingdom, I almost forgot how fun it is." Yasmine chuckled, enjoying the venture.
"Not stealing, we are just strategically transporting few potions to an alternate location, just helping a temple in need."
Vritra corrected her, and he found the treasury quite easily.
Glancing at the guards guarding them, he directly teleported the whole treasury to the dimensional book, without alerting the carefree guards.
"Sigh, it has been days since I last went home; thankfully the temple provided my family with enough food." One of the guards muttered, looking worried.
"Well I am happy to be away from all that nagging, I felt I would go crazy but this curfew came at the right time." Another guard spoke.
But while the group of ten guards were chatting, a figure suddenly appeared in front of them.
It was a fatty man with his face and body completely covered.
"Who are you?" The guards were suddenly alarmed but the fat guy threw a glyph and it froze them all in place.
"Haha, I am the great Ziggy, now just watch as I steal away all your potions, haha."
Vritra used Misty Essence to play this whole scene, while he was already inside the treasury.
"Damn, such a huge inventory!!" Vritra just looked around. At the hundreds of thousands of potions, there didn’t seem to be an end to it.
He located the soul potions quickly and flew towards them.
With a wave of his hand, all the potions flew into his inventory.
After gazing around, he didn’t find anything of interest so he decided to leave them after taking a few others.
Then the whole place returned back to reality, out of the dimensional book.
’It was so easy because of all the ongoing chaos and Shitless.’
Vritra thought, as he flew out of the temple and disappeared, it was time for him to play his second role.
Ziggy lazily walked into the treasury. Using the glyphs he easily bypassed any sort of defenses; nothing could stop him.
"Haha Very soon, I will be able to marry Maeve, just you wait bastard, I will let my father boil you in lava and watch as you beg for my mercy.
Kekeke Now everyone will be under me, when I marry that powerful and beautiful woman!" Ziggy laughed out loud, already torturing Vritra in his mind.
Finally, he stopped in front of a big metal door, which seemed to be the last obstruction between him and the marriage.
"Hmm Quite solid." Tapping on the door, Ziggy knew he wouldn’t be able to break it with his own strength.
Then he pulled out another glyph, which had just a bit of his father’s power and threw it at the door, running away in haste.
BOOOOM!
He had already covered the whole place with a sound barrier so no one was able to hear anything.
"Haha finally it is over!" Ziggy rushed in, ready to get the statue and escape, then get rid of Vritra for good and marry Maeve.
He felt giddy while thinking about his plan, he will soon be the most successful Pig demon.
As the smoke cleared, the pig demon looked around inside the big room but aside from a stone table, there was nothing.
"Huh? Where is the statue? What’s going on?" he looked around carefully, but there really was nothing.
Even his fat brain was able to understand something within a few seconds.
"I have been set up! This was a trap!" Ziggy’s body trembled. He tried to send a signal back to his father but it didn’t work.
Fear crept into his heart as he turned and tried to escape.
"Stop right there, I am arresting you for stealing the statue of the true God and thousands of potions from the treasury!
I am Daddy V from the Golden Moon, move and I will blast your head apart."
Suddenly a person charged into the treasury, along with guards.

Fear crept into his heart as he turned and tried to escape.
"Stop right there, I am arresting you for stealing the statue of the true God and thousands of potions from the treasury!
I am Daddy V from the Golden Moon, move and I will blast your head apart."
Suddenly a person charged into the treasury, along with guards.

chapters.title: Chapter 417: The Brilliant Plan
paragraphs: Ziggy was completely baffled as several men charged into the treasury.
He hurriedly tried to pull out glyphs but he couldn’t access his inventory.
"Don’t move, or I will blast your head apart! This is Daddy V from the Golden Moon." Vritra along with the guards of the temple rushed inside.
Half of his face was covered by a mask, and he was now in the appearance of a tall buffed-out young man.
This was the main part of his plan. He could only hope nothing goes wrong.
"I- I am innocent, I Oink Oink didn’t steal anything. R- Really, I was sleeping in Oink Oink in my room and somehow ended up here." Ziggy spoke in panic.
He understood that this must be the plan of that demon to put him in trouble.
’Why can’t I use any of my treasures? What is happening? These guards or even the Golden Moon shouldn’t be so fast...’ The pig demon thought.
He had been in such situations many times but he could easily escape using his treasures.
After all, which men would take so many precautions, locking space and all other routes, without even knowing the other party?
"Hah, this bastard is lying. I saw his fat body earlier in the potion treasury! His name was Piggy... Pig... Ah right, Ziggy, he threatened us and stole thousands of highest grade potions."
One of the guards who had been guarding the potion inventory spoke in haste.
"Now, what else do you have to say, innocent guy?" Vritra took a step forward and questioned. Everything was perfect so far.
"Y- You have to believe me, this is a setup. My father is a good guy, he is a Oink Oink Oink merchant. Let’s get out of here and I will—"
Ziggy was searching for some escape but just then Vritra tapped over his head.
BOOOOM
Ziggy’s body instantly smashed back into the wall, creating a giant hole of his exact figure.
"Bring him outside." Vritra ordered the shocked guards. No wonder everyone feared the Golden Moon so much.
"Huh? O- Outside? But currently, there is a curfew going on—" Coming to their senses, one of the guards said.
"It will be fine, just follow me."
Vritra said and started walking towards the entrance of the temple, while the guards tiredly looked at the fat body of Ziggy.
Just as Vritra had ordered, the guards followed behind him and brought Ziggy’s body outside.
Seeing that the work was over, Monk Shitless ran away for his life; he could no longer take on the disgusting voices of those horny men.
"Alright Hubby, now there is one more hurdle and that is to sway Darius to allow all this." Yasmine spoke, nonetheless she was quite excited.
’Hmm, the atmosphere is even more tense after the incidents last night, so I think it won’t be too hard.’
Vritra asked the guards to throw Ziggy’s unconscious body beside him.
And instantly, several of the warriors patrolling the streets noticed.
They had received strict orders from the emperor to capture anyone who is seen walking outside.
But seeing that it was someone from the temple they didn’t immediately make any decisions.
There were at least ten or so men around that area.
They got closer and one among them questioned:
"Why are you outside? And what’s up with him? Is there some emergency?"
"Yeah, there is indeed an emergency." Vritra stepped forward and took out his Golden Moon’s emblem and presented it to them.
"I am Daddy V, an Agent from the Golden Moon. And this is really important; I need to send a message to the emperor."
While speaking he flashed the emblem and put it away before they could even clearly see it.
"Huh, Dadd- what? Anyway, what’s so urgent?" They instantly became more respectful after knowing his status.
"Are you sure you are qualified to know that? Just pass this scroll to the emperor or someone in a high position." Vritra said and passed on the scroll.
"Uh... Okay, we will do that, D- Daddy V." One of the soldiers said in embarrassment, without wasting any time one of them headed off.
"..." Vritra just took a comfortable sofa chair from his inventory and sat back, even pulling out some food as he began to eat it with relish.
Darius was standing in a room on one side of a big rectangular table, along with a couple dozen men who were all ministers, advisors and so on.
"There are a lot of problems but none of you have any solution?" Darius glanced at all of them angrily.
What was the point of giving them such high salaries if they can’t even give a single advice?
"H- How about... we evacuate everyone out of the continent and do a thorough search for Vritra and other dangerous organizations?"
One of the ministers with an obese body like most others in the room wiped his forehead and spoke nervously.
"Dang that’s what I am talking about, a truly brilliant plan, what a genius we have among us. And where exactly do we evacuate? Into the house your father made after his death?
And how are you going to separate the normal citizens from those said evil organizations?" Darius’s veins bulged as he screamed in rage.
"Guards!" Just as the emperor gave a call, dozens of strong men rushed into the room, as he gave an order while pointing towards the frightened minister.
"Take this excuse for a minister and throw him into the prison for 1 wee- no one whole month and beat his ass up until he had painted the entire prison room with this brush."
After speaking he threw a tiny brush towards the minister.
"F- Forgive me emperorrrrrrr- Give me one more chance, how about we make the whole continent explode then-"
Just like that one of the ministers was dragged away, along with his brush.
Releasing a long breath, Darius tried to calm himself then he looked at the other frightened people and spoke:
"Let’s take one thing at a time. Haa How is the search for Griffith’s murderer going?"
Han Gratt standing behind him suddenly jolted, he was busy with his own thoughts.
"W- We are still searching. We did find demonic traces and it seems to be a demon lord, very soon, we will be able to catch the murderer."
"Good, any news on Yennefer?" He asked further.
"No, she is still missing." Han said, his expression turning sad.
"...Sigh After those two explosions last night, things have turned even more chaotic.
My subjects will completely lose all their faith in me at this rate, I can’t keep suppressing them using forceful ways. Is there-"
KNOCK KNOCK
Suddenly the emperor got interrupted by the light knocks, massaging his forehead he asked in anger:
"Who. Is. It? Don’t you know there is an important meeting going on right here?"
"Uhm F- Forgive me, emperor, but this is something important and I think you should have a look at it. This might just solve a few of your problems."
It was a commander who had come in a hurry.
The soldier didn’t have enough authority to come here, so he presented the scroll to his commander.
"...Enter." Darius nodded, and took the scroll. After opening it, he read the content as a surprised expression appeared on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 418: The Perfect Home
paragraphs: Vritra sat lazily on the comfortable chair, eating and drinking without a care in the world, only if the others knew that he was the centre of all the chaos.
’It should be about time.’ As he finished eating, Vritra stood up and put the chair away before stretching his body.
"Sir, at what strength level are you at?" One of the soldiers looked at Vritra with shiny eyes and questioned; it was his dream to join the Golden Moon.
"At the general rank." Vritra replied, while chatting with Yasmine.
"Oh! Thank you for answering." After bowing, he went back towards his group, looking excited and downcast at the same time.
Few more minutes passed and finally several figures became visible in the sky. Within moments, nearly twenty figures landed in front of the temple.
The temple guards and soldiers all bowed, their hearts trembling in nervousness as the human emperor appeared in front of them.
This was the first time any of them were seeing him from so up close; it was like a dream.
Even Vritra was meeting the emperor for the first time, so he too observed Darius.
The emperor’s presence really put a huge pressure on everyone there; without even doing anything, his strength was even higher than Red, most probably.
"..." Darius glanced around.
After looking at Ziggy, his gaze got fixed on Vritra. He observed the Golden Moon’s agent for a few moments then questioned: "You were the one to send me this?"
"Yes." Vritra had a faint smile on his face, though he really wished to smash that annoying face of the emperor, but now was not the right time.
Darius was quite shocked after reading the content of the scroll, since Vritra had made some big promises, something that no one in his entire palace could do.
"You said you can help me calm the public and make the situation better? You would even help me kill Raelion? And you might even succeed in finding Red?"
Darius questioned, his tone still filled with doubts.
Vritra looked as calm as ever. He ignored the sin points messages and nodded.
Normally he wouldn’t have said all that but with his status, even the emperor wouldn’t kill him for no reason.
"Yes, I can do all that, if you could fulfil a few small requests like providing me with a place that could fit a vast amount of people.
You should order as many people as possible to come there, and just remove the curfew." He spoke confidently.

"Haha Those are some wild claims and well, I can agree to those requests but what if you fail? Even if you are an agent from the Golden Moon, I can’t just trust anyone, this might just lead us into more chaos."
Darius said, but at this point, he would agree to any kind of suggestion, except that minister’s ones.
"If I fail then my knife and your throat- no wait, your throat and my knife- and I will personally ask the Golden Moon to interfere with the continent’s situation.
I am sure that will be of great help, right?" Vritra spoke, he didn’t seem affected even while talking to the emperor directly.
Darius ignored his joke, after thinking for a moment, he asked: "Show me your emblem, why would you be going out of your way to help the continent?
Aren’t you also from the Golden Moon, do they even know you are helping us?"
Vritra tossed his emblem and said: "Sigh My mother and I used to live in this continent, then I had to leave and she was left alone here. And when I returned she..."
"I am sorry to hear that." Han consoled him, looking at him with warmth.
"Shut up, she is alive. When I returned, she asked me to do something about this stupid curfew." Vritra added.
Emperor shook his head. He already understood this Agent’s personality and knew just how to control him.
He gave the emblem back and glanced back at his ministers and advisors, then gesturing them, they flew high into the sky.
They talked for a few minutes and then returned.
"Alright, I agree to your requests but there is too much going on here currently in the Ghazi city so I will have the people here evacuate to nearby city, the Cloud city. You can try it there."
Darius spoke, he had his own plans behind this arrangement.
Vritra took a few moments to think then nodded:
"Sure that is fine by me, it would be great if this is done by today, so I can start tomorrow. And I promise, I will have another great surprise for you."
"Okay, you better not disappoint me." Darius nodded and flew away along with all the others.
If Vritra could really do the things he had promised then many of his problems could truly be solved.
’Maybe Raelion’s death could finally attract Yennefer’s attention, sigh just how come everything is breaking apart all of a sudden?’ He thought.
The emperor didn’t have too much confidence in Vritra.
But even if he failed, he would be able to get the Golden Moon’s help, so he really won’t be making a loss here.
Vritra moved the pig into one of his Dimensional book’s pages then he glanced back and said: "I will return your treasures after getting them from him, don’t worry."
"Thank you, sir!" The guards nodded, as Vritra flew away.
First he went to meet with Maeve; he needed to deliver this news to her after all.
Then he planned to go meet Diana and Fiona since he might not be visiting them for a while.
After flying for a while, he teleported directly inside the hotel room where the fox demon was lying on the bed and reading some book with full focus.
"Foxie," Vritra called out, as Maeve’s body jerked and then the book fell onto her face. She hurriedly put it away and looked at him with a smile.
"M- M- Master, you are back! Did you succeed?" She asked, hoping that Vritra hadn’t seen what the book was about.
"Yeah, I have captured Ziggy. But there is a slight change, we will be moving to the Cloud city tonight, be ready." Vritra replied.
"Okay master~" Maeve nodded, feeling relieved since his normal behaviour.
"I will return in a while, and you don’t need to learn those sort of things from a book, just ask me and I can personally teach you." Vritra said with a chuckle as he turned and disappeared.
"H- He saw it?!!" Maeve buried her face into the pillow, feeling really embarrassed. But his words also gave her dirty mind a lot to imagine.
It didn’t take Vritra long to arrive at the city of Charms.
If possible he would have loved to bring Fiona, Diana and his mother along but this place was the safest for them now.

"This place isn’t too bad to settle down, wherever I look, it is so full of greenery, right wifey?" Vritra asked, heading towards Diana’s lab.
"Yes yes, so much greenery, it will help you breathe in better oxygen. But try asking others, if they like this oxygen hehe" Yasmine played along.

chapters.title: Chapter 419: The Cloud City
paragraphs: After walking into Diana’s lab, he found three women inside—Fiona, Layla, and one more succubus. Diana had gone out to get some things from home.
"Oh, you are Vritra? The one from those announcements?" the third succubus asked; she seemed to be in her twenties.
"Yeah." Vritra answered, then after some small talk, the other two ladies left, leaving only Vritra and Fiona alone.
"Hah Darling, this time you came to stay or deliver some news?" Fiona asked. She sat over Vritra’s lap, her head comfortably resting on his shoulder.
"Well, let’s wait for Diana." Vritra said, combing through her smooth long red hair with his fingers.
"I guess it is the latter then. So where are you leaving off to this time?" Fiona questioned, missing the time they could stay together all the time.
"Dear, I just sensed your presence, so I came back running." Diana finally returned and gave Vritra a kiss on his lips.
"Yeah, so I will be going to another city, it’s called the Cloud City, for a few days, but I will come to visit soon." Vritra began to explain, as the two’s mood dampened.
After a long talk and some promises, the three went for a walk around the city and then headed into a good hotel to eat together.
Leaving the City of Charms, Vritra flew towards the hotel room. Just as Darius had promised, he had already given his order and the roads were no longer empty.
The people were slowly being evacuated to the other cities, while he also spread the order for as many people as possible to gather at the biggest arena.
Vritra was quite satisfied with the whole outcome. Not only would he be able to earn lots of sin points but also use Darius to kill a few of his targets.
Soon arriving back near Maeve, he entered the hotel room.
"When will we be leaving?" the fox questioned, sitting beside him on the bed, looking a bit tamed for some reason.
"In the night. Let’s go out and train a bit for now, and I also want you to tell me more about that Voromir Kingdom and the life flame’s matter of yours." Vritra spoke.
He couldn’t leave her life flame there; otherwise, they could easily control Maeve and indirectly him too.
At least, this realm wasn’t as dangerous as the Dragon Kingdom.
"Okay, master~ let’s go!" Maeve took his hand and got up excitedly. The two flew back towards the forest outside of the continent.
And after travelling far enough, the one-sided beating started.
The Charged Fist was gradually rising, and Vritra hoped that this thing didn’t disappoint him, or all of this would be a waste.
He also needed to increase his comprehension of his Fields, and maybe finally get some new skills.
It had been too long since he drew anything, and for that, he needed to increase his luck even more.
Vritra and Maeve took a few breaks in the middle of their training and only stopped once the sky had started to turn dark.
By now, nearly the entire Ghazi City had been emptied.
As the two flew back towards the continent, at the boundary they paused and sensed that something was wrong.
"I think the emperor might be setting up some large-scale barrier. He sure is spending a lot of resources, so it might have something to do with you, master." Maeve said solemnly.
The barrier was in its initial phase, and it would soon be covering most of the continent.
"So this thing will make it impossible for me to leave this continent?" Vritra mumbled, sensing the faint energy. It was so negligible that he almost missed it.
"I think that might be the case, plus it could also have some other functions. So hubby, this just might be your chance to escape." Yasmine spoke in a serious tone.
"Yeah." Maeve also agreed.
’Leave or stay? Heh, as if I have a choice. After that announcement, no place is safe for me, not to mention mom is here too.’ Vritra sighed.
Who knows what sort of abilities his opponent might be using to track him?
If even someone like Shitless could tell parts of the future, then there just might be some prophet or something on the other side.
After a few minutes of pondering, the two flew into Ghazi City, but then Vritra paused and questioned:
"Foxie, how are we going to enter the Voromir Kingdom?"
"The entrance is present inside the continent, so that’s not a problem. But let’s worry about my life flame later, we already have so much to think about." Maeve said with a slight shake of her head.
They hadn’t left anything back in the hotel, so the two directly flew towards the Cloud City, with Maeve leading the way.
"So how is this new city? And is there a reason behind that name?" Vritra questioned while flying. The city was truly quiet now.
"Yes, there is indeed a reason — and you will know it soon enough. This city is a little shady, but mostly fine, though not many prefer to live there." Maeve answered, making Vritra frown.
"What? Don’t tell me very few people live there?" he questioned. That would just disrupt his plans.
"No, there are still a lot, just not as many as other cities." Maeve replied, wondering why he wanted to gather such a large crowd.
It certainly didn’t seem to be just for fun.
Sighing, the two continued to fly, and it wasn’t long before they arrived close to the said Cloud City.
"There it is, master." Maeve said, pointing into the distance.
"Oh!" Vritra was a bit surprised, since it seemed a big cloud had descended on the ground — the mist was just that thick in the air.
"Sigh, I just hope enough people come to the arena." Vritra sighed again; in such fog it would be impossible to see one’s own hand.
As they entered, with their senses everything was still perfectly fine. But for normal people or low-level warriors, such a fog would make it impossible to see the act Vritra had planned.
"Let’s just rest for now, we will worry about it tomorrow." Cursing the emperor in his mind, Vritra and Maeve soon found a nice hotel.
Though all the rooms were booked and most hotels were completely filled, thankfully after looking around for a bit, the two found a place.
"We want to book a room." Vritra said; the two had hidden their appearance well.
"For how long?" The man sitting on the other side of the desk seemed to be in his fifties and had several cut marks over his face.
"A month." Vritra answered, ignoring the other person’s strange behaviour.
The mist wasn’t as thick inside the hotel, thankfully.
"Hmm, that would be twenty gold coins." The manager said, gazing at their reaction.
’No wonder this hotel still had vacant rooms. They are bandits most probably.’ Vritra thought.
If they appeared rich, then these people would kill them in their sleep.
"Just 20? Here." Vritra nodded and threw twenty gold coins on the table.
"Oh, h- here you go, sir, this is the key to your room. Let a servant guide you there. Do you have any luggage? Do you need any meals?" The manager instantly turned friendly.
Vritra shook his head and took the key, then taking Maeve’s hand, the two headed towards their room.

chapters.title: Chapter 420: Lesson One~
paragraphs: "Are you sure?" a man with tattoos covering his entire body sitting over a bamboo spoke.
"Yeah, he threw 20 gold coins like it’s nothing. I am sure he must be very rich, and there was even a woman with them.
Although I didn’t see her face, she appeared hot." The manager spoke, scratching the scars on his face.
"Should we strike tonight? The atmosphere here is quite serious—even though the curfew has ended, the security is still very tight." another man added.
Over fifty men were gathered in a small field behind their hotel and, in the thick mist, they couldn’t even see each other’s faces.
"Yes, who’s gonna know about it anyway. I am sure they must be some rich merchant or something from Ghazi city, unaware of this hotel’s reputation." someone from the crowd added.
"But I still think we should be more careful during this period of time—" the tattooed man said. He seemed to be the leader of the bunch.
"Are you stupid? When are we getting such a golden opportunity? Let’s hurry up and once we get the gold, we can lay low for a while." The same encouraging voice from before sounded.
"Alright, then let’s go." Finally, they all spoke excitedly.
Onest smiled from within the crowd. He had just met up with Vritra and, for some reason, he’d been given the task to motivate this bunch of thieves.
Soon the whole group made their way into the hotel, making sure to not leave any way to escape.
Vritra and Maeve lay on the bed, talking about the events of the next day. It was unexpected, but the addition of these bandits was a nice thing.
"They are here already." Vritra mumbled.
KNOCK KNOCK
"Sir, I have brought food for you, don’t worry this will be on the house."
A feminine voice sounded from outside, as over fifty men stood surrounding the room from all sides.
"..." Vritra didn’t move. With just a thought, he simply teleported them all into the dimensional book and stopped the time for them.
"Have a good rest, a good show will be starting from tomorrow. I just hope there will be enough audience." Vritra thought as he closed his eyes.
Maeve cleared her throat and spoke a bit shyly, but sounding mischievous.
"Cough, Master, about that thing you were telling to teach me, can we start now? You know, I need all the knowledge and practice for my future husband."
"Oh, future husband, huh? Do you have anyone in mind? As a lord, it should be someone special, right?" Turning to face her, he questioned, his lips curving up slightly.
"Of course, I have already made my choice. There could only ever be one man for me, my lovely master~"
Maeve said, hugging Vritra. Although she had already told him about her feelings, saying it like this made her feel a bit shy; her tail was swinging from side to side like a snake.
"Ah, so it is your master. What a lucky man sigh." Vritra said in a downcast tone as if she was talking about someone else.
"!!!" Maeve was a bit surprised, wondering if her words weren’t clear enough. She pulled back, but seeing his smile she calmed down.
’I love it when he teases me like this, I missed this side of him so much. And I would do anything so he could keep smiling at me like that...’ Maeve thought, her gaze filled with determination.
"Hmm, so about your training, let’s start from the beginning. From a kiss, tell me how much you learned from that book of yours."
Vritra said as he sat back; being this close to this demoness and not doing anything was truly torture.
"Uh... Like pressing our lips, something with tongue. It was too vague, master, please enlighten me." Maeve said seriously.
"Alright, just follow my lead and take it slow." Vritra said, and before Maeve could reply, he pushed her down, lying on top of her.
Her soft body pressed into his, the two feeling each other’s warmth. Their faces were so close that their noses were touching; Vritra pinned both her arms above her head.
"Just relax..." whispering lightly, Vritra leaned down, capturing her juicy pink lips in a soft, melting kiss.
Maeve’s heartbeat increased and her body felt like burning.
All her life it had just been survival, so she was really happy to be able to experience something so lovely with the person she loved so much.
Their lips slowly rubbed; Maeve observed Vritra’s movements and then copied. He took her lower lip into his mouth, sucking on it lightly and pulling it.
Then tilting his head, Vritra gently began to caress and suck her soft, luscious lips, loving her taste.
Foxie repeated after him, though her movements were still a bit rough.
Her lips were so creamy and tender that Vritra felt like he was literally eating something very delicious.
And her scent—it made him forget everything, just her warmth and her tasty lips.
Vritra opened his mouth slightly and moved his tongue forward, pressing it against her lips, giving a light lick before trying to enter.
There was no need for further instructions; Maeve’s fists were clenched and a surreal pleasure filled her being.
Feeling his tongue press against her lips, she slowly parted her lips and felt it move inside.
’Mmm, it really feels like he is devouring me. I never thought a kiss could be so intoxicating. I am gonna need at least 100 kisses from master daily now.’
Maeve thought, but this was just the start.
Vritra’s tongue exploringly moved deeper into her mouth, going past her pearl-white teeth and gently licking around.
A shiver ran through her body as his tongue touched her own; it was such a strange feeling. Maeve’s tongue moved a bit back at the first contact.
But once again, Vritra went forward and directly entangled with Maeve’s tongue, as the two tasted each other.
"Mmmm~" Maeve let out a muffled moan as the intensity of the kiss increased suddenly.
Their lips were completely sealed as the two tongues rubbed and intertwined in a wet dance, the two exchanging saliva.
Vritra sucked into her mouth, pulling her tongue and nibbling on it as the two swallowed each other’s saliva.
Maeve was really overwhelmed by such an intimate kiss, but she was now even more in love with his kisses, and even a hundred a day seemed too less.
She moved her arms and wrapped them around his neck, pressing her mouth against him even harder.
Then she replicated his movements, sucking harder as her cheeks hollowed out and getting more of his saliva.
Wrapping her tongue around his, Foxie gently pulled him into her mouth, sucking on it with relish.
"Hmmm~ Mmphh~ SLURP GULP~ GULP~" as the passionate and wet kiss continued, seconds turned to minutes, nearly twenty minutes passed as the two practiced.
Following Vritra’s lead, Maeve felt like she was really getting better at it.
She bit his tongue, desperately sucking for more of his sweet saliva, feeling as if her body was melting into his.
After a few more minutes, Vritra finally pulled back his mouth from the grasp of the thirsty fox.

chapters.title: Chapter 421: The Game of Good and Evil
paragraphs: After a few more minutes, Vritra finally pulled back his mouth from the grasp of the thirsty fox.
She still didn’t seem content and looked at him with puppy eyes for more.
"Master, can we continue to practice a bit longer? Please? Rawr~" she added pitifully while acting cute.
"No, that will be all for now. There will be a lot of things happening tomorrow, so just rest for now."
Vritra said, secretly moving his hand as he gripped her soft tail and gave it a light squeeze.
"Ahhh~ M- Master..." Maeve shivered, her face turning red; her tail was really sensitive.
After playing around for a bit longer, the two laid down, embracing one another as they soon fell asleep.
’Ughh, how long have I OINK OINK been out for? Just what happened?’ Ziggy’s thoughts were a mess; as he woke up, his head hurt.
Then he remembered how he had fallen into a trap and how an agent from the Golden Moon blasted him away with a single tap.
’Fuck Oink, I have to contact Father. Oink, that demon and that Daddy V, they are all going to die!’
Filled with rage, Ziggy tried moving his body but failed.
Then he remembered that he was yet to save Maeve — the poor woman might still be waiting for him — and he wanted to marry her no matter what.
If not, he would end up becoming the biggest joke in his father’s realm.
He was already the thinnest among all his siblings, and now he would lose any bit of respect.
His father was certainly the fattest pig, and he dreamed of being just like his father one day.
As he came back to his senses, Ziggy felt that his body seemed to be tied with something.
’So I got captured by the Golden Moon? Well, as long as Father gets to know about it, I’m sure he will do something.’ Ziggy relaxed a bit.
If he had been captured by that demon, he would have been more afraid.
But then he heard distant noises, as if a lot of people were shouting and screaming at the same time.
"W- What’s going on OINK OINK?" Ziggy muttered, but then a big door opened with a loud bang and light hit his face.
In the next moment, his body was suddenly pulled out by something.
Waking up early, Vritra came to visit the biggest arena of Cloud City.
Thankfully, it was big enough to seat a large crowd, but it too was full of mist, and seeing anything seemed impossible.
This mist had become such a problem recently that people had started to leave the city and most businesses failed here.
"First, I need to take care of this mist." Vritra mumbled, and with Yasmine’s guidance, he began to create a barrier around the entire arena.
It used a lot of energy, but withSuck! Suck! Suck! it wasn’t a problem.
While Vritra was taking care of the mist, Onest and Shitless were arranging things for the planned events just as Vritra had instructed.
Meanwhile, Maeve was responsible for bringing more people, since lots of people just got lost while searching for this place.
Vritra was in his burly man’s disguise, half his face covered by a mask.
"Hoo, and it’s done." After the barrier was created, he pushed all the mist out, and finally, the arena cleared up.
Looking over at the seats, nearly seven hundred people had already arrived. It was not bad, but nowhere near enough.
But as minutes passed by, more and more people were coming.
Not only was this event announced by the emperor, but they had also heard some intriguing rumors about it.
By ten, around nine thousand people had already gathered. More were slowly coming, but for now this would do.
’It’s time to start the show. As the reputation and news of this spread, I’m sure more people will be coming.’ He thought.
Previously, in the White Kingdom, he had used money and religion as a way to earn Sin Points, and this time, he had similar plans.
Using the concepts of gods, religion, money, good, and evil — this was bound to attract more people when they just wanted to cling to some hope.
They were terrorized by all the things happening, and even their trust in the emperor had diminished, so Vritra would just become their pillar.
And slowly, he would pull out the evil side of them all.
"More people are coming; I have put a few people to work, so finding this place would no longer be a problem for anyone." Maeve flew closer and spoke.
Vritra patted her head, caressing her felt really nice.
"Good job, now you can enjoy the show in the crowd. I will call you if and when I need you." He said.
Right now, he needed to be the main focus, and Vritra didn’t want someone else to get the limelight, losing lots of Sin Points.
"Hehe okay, master~" Maeve enjoyed his caressing for a while and then flew away, disappearing into the crowd.
’Haa, now it is time to start.’
"Hubby, let’s do it — this is going to be so fun." Yasmine’s cheerful voice sounded.
Gazing around at the whole arena, Vritra slowly descended to the center.
"Well, hello participants, I welcome you all to this wonderful game of good and evil." He started his words with a powerful tone and paused for a moment.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +9382}
{Sin Point Gained: Confused +9024}
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +8243}
Instantly, lots of sin points flooded in and Vritra just enjoyed the moment. It had been so long since he’d seen such large numbers, and it was only going to grow.
Hearing his words, all the people began to discuss in confusion. They hadn’t heard about any game or anything — weren’t they here just to watch some show?
A few even became paranoid.

"I am Daddy V, an agent from the Golden Moon. And yes, we will be playing a game — a game of good and evil, humanity and demons, a game that could make you rich and punish the wrongdoers." Vritra spoke, taking in the expressions of the crowd.
"Of course, it is up to you to not participate, but I can guarantee that you are going to love every second spent here." Vritra glanced back and nodded towards Onest, who was disguised as well.
"Now, let’s bring out our first test subject!"
DRRRRRRR...
With a loud dragging sound, a heavy stone door began to open, and in the next moment, the sound of a bull’s roar resounded.
"W- What’s going on? Did I hear that right? It sounded like a bull but... more dangerous."
"I don’t have any idea what’s happening here. Why did the emperor tell us to come here? Is this really alright?"
People became even more unsure — and then a bull charged out.
It looked several times stronger than an average bull, its height and muscles looking terrifying, even its eyes glowing with a bright red light.
"B- Bullo? Is that really Bullo? What happened to him?" Monk Shitless, who wore a wig as a form of disguise, was shocked to see his bull.
And then the sound of a pig being butchered came from behind as Bullo pulled along a heavy man, dragging him out through the door.
