Just what happened?’ Ziggy’s thoughts were a mess; as he woke up, his head hurt.
Then he remembered how he had fallen into a trap and how an agent from the Golden Moon blasted him away with a single tap.
’Fuck Oink, I have to contact Father.
Oink, that demon and that Daddy V, they are all going to die!’
Filled with rage, Ziggy tried moving his body but failed.
Then he remembered that he was yet to save Maeve — the poor woman might still be waiting for him — and he wanted to marry her no matter what.
If not, he would end up becoming the biggest joke in his father’s realm.
He was already the thinnest among all his siblings, and now he would lose any bit of respect.
His father was certainly the fattest pig, and he dreamed of being just like his father one day.
As he came back to his senses, Ziggy felt that his body seemed to be tied with something.
’So I got captured by the Golden Moon?
Well, as long as Father gets to know about it, I’m sure he will do something.’ Ziggy relaxed a bit.
If he had been captured by that demon, he would have been more afraid.
But then he heard distant noises, as if a lot of people were shouting and screaming at the same time.
"W- What’s going on OINK OINK?" Ziggy muttered, but then a big door opened with a loud bang and light hit his face.
In the next moment, his body was suddenly pulled out by something.
Waking up early, Vritra came to visit the biggest arena of Cloud City.
Thankfully, it was big enough to seat a large crowd, but it too was full of mist, and seeing anything seemed impossible.
This mist had become such a problem recently that people had started to leave the city and most businesses failed here.
"First, I need to take care of this mist." Vritra mumbled, and with Yasmine’s guidance, he began to create a barrier around the entire arena.
It used a lot of energy, but withSuck!
Suck!
Suck! it wasn’t a problem.
While Vritra was taking care of the mist, Onest and Shitless were arranging things for the planned events just as Vritra had instructed.
Meanwhile, Maeve was responsible for bringing more people, since lots of people just got lost while searching for this place.
Vritra was in his burly man’s disguise, half his face covered by a mask.
"Hoo, and it’s done." After the barrier was created, he pushed all the mist out, and finally, the arena cleared up.
Looking over at the seats, nearly seven hundred people had already arrived.
It was not bad, but nowhere near enough.
But as minutes passed by, more and more people were coming.
Not only was this event announced by the emperor, but they had also heard some intriguing rumors about it.
By ten, around nine thousand people had already gathered.
More were slowly coming, but for now this would do.
’It’s time to start the show.
As the reputation and news of this spread, I’m sure more people will be coming.’ He thought.
Previously, in the White Kingdom, he had used money and religion as a way to earn Sin Points, and this time, he had similar plans.
Using the concepts of gods, religion, money, good, and evil — this was bound to attract more people when they just wanted to cling to some hope.
They were terrorized by all the things happening, and even their trust in the emperor had diminished, so Vritra would just become their pillar.
And slowly, he would pull out the evil side of them all.
"More people are coming; I have put a few people to work, so finding this place would no longer be a problem for anyone." Maeve flew closer and spoke.
Vritra patted her head, caressing her felt really nice.
"Good job, now you can enjoy the show in the crowd.
I will call you if and when I need you." He said.
Right now, he needed to be the main focus, and Vritra didn’t want someone else to get the limelight, losing lots of Sin Points.
"Hehe okay, master~" Maeve enjoyed his caressing for a while and then flew away, disappearing into the crowd.
’Haa, now it is time to start.’
"Hubby, let’s do it — this is going to be so fun." Yasmine’s cheerful voice sounded.
Gazing around at the whole arena, Vritra slowly descended to the center.
"Well, hello participants, I welcome you all to this wonderful game of good and evil." He started his words with a powerful tone and paused for a moment.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +9382}
{Sin Point Gained: Confused +9024}
{Sin Point Gained: Surprised +8243}
Instantly, lots of sin points flooded in and Vritra just enjoyed the moment.
It had been so long since he’d seen such large numbers, and it was only going to grow.
Hearing his words, all the people began to discuss in confusion.
They hadn’t heard about any game or anything — weren’t they here just to watch some show?
A few even became paranoid.
"I am Daddy V, an agent from the Golden Moon.
And yes, we will be playing a game — a game of good and evil, humanity and demons, a game that could make you rich and punish the wrongdoers." Vritra spoke, taking in the expressions of the crowd.
"Of course, it is up to you to not participate, but I can guarantee that you are going to love every second spent here." Vritra glanced back and nodded towards Onest, who was disguised as well.
"Now, let’s bring out our first test subject!"
DRRRRRRR...
With a loud dragging sound, a heavy stone door began to open, and in the next moment, the sound of a bull’s roar resounded.
"W- What’s going on?
Did I hear that right?
It sounded like a bull but... more dangerous."
"I don’t have any idea what’s happening here.
Why did the emperor tell us to come here?
Is this really alright?"
People became even more unsure — and then a bull charged out.
It looked several times stronger than an average bull, its height and muscles looking terrifying, even its eyes glowing with a bright red light.
"B- Bullo?
Is that really Bullo?
What happened to him?" Monk Shitless, who wore a wig as a form of disguise, was shocked to see his bull.
And then the sound of a pig being butchered came from behind as Bullo pulled along a heavy man, dragging him out through the door.

chapters.title: Chapter 422: Test Subjects
paragraphs: "Let me ask you, how many of you believe in Gods?" Vritra questioned, and slowly the number of people was increasing.
All the people seated in the arena raised their hands, feeling confused about everything that was happening.
"You must all be aware that there rests a statue of the True God, a sacred statue. In the legends, it is said that just touching it once will give you a lifetime of fortune."
Vritra continued to speak as Bullo dragged Ziggy to the middle of the field.
The large bull stopped right beside Vritra, becoming meek as Vritra patted it.
"Uwaaaaaah! Stop! Stop! Oink Oink Ughh damnit stoppppp!" Ziggy’s body finally came to a stop.

"This fat pig right here dared to steal the same statue you all revere so much! Not only that, he spat on that statue and even pissed on it! What do you think should be done to him?" Vritra shouted, pointing towards the baffled Ziggy.
The poor demon pig hadn’t done any of that.
"W- What? Stole? Spat? A- And pissed? Kill that bastard!!"
"Skin him alive, throw him into fire, kill him!"
All the people instantly became enraged. The belief of people in God is a really dangerous weapon.
If a person received bread from someone, he would be thankful but might forget him soon.
But if he received a stone to pray from him, then the second person would just become the messenger of God.
"Right, right, I understand—and what we are going to do is thousands of times more cruel than what he did to our God." Vritra shouted, then he paused and continued.

"Recently, I sneaked into a Bone Blood Cult base and coincidentally found a shocking scene. Those murderers had killed thousands of families for some psychotic ritual—infants, children, old, women, men, none were spared.
They relished in the fear, the helplessness, the begging of those pitiful families. It is because of those psychos that none of you are safe now.
Because of them, our emperor had to start the curfew. What do you think should be done to them?"
"KILL! KILL! KILL! KILL!"
"BURN THEM! BURN THEM!"

Hearing each word from Vritra, the people were becoming more and more enraged, since they could easily imagine themselves in such a situation—and thinking of their families getting killed obviously made them mad.
"Good, now lastly, I came to this city and booked a room in a hotel. And there, I found a bunch of murderers who had been secretly killing families and robbing them.
Had it been someone among you, what do you think would have happened to your children, your loved ones? WHAT SHOULD BE DONE TO ALL THESE CRIMINALS?"

Vritra enjoyed the constantly rising sin points and also the satisfaction of being able to torture all these murderers. He really hated people like them—and what better way to send them off than this?
By now, over ten thousand people were present. More than half were from the Cloud City, but the rest had come from outside the city to watch this.
They too had booked hotels here, and just imagining someone murdering their families in their sleep filled all of them with endless rage.
Vritra paused for a minute. He had finally riled all the people up.
He just needed to continue shifting the audience’s feelings to receive sin points.
"Yes, and that’s what we will be doing—but not in such a simple way.
None of these people deserve an easy death, and this game will make them beg for death."
Vritra cut off the rope tying Ziggy to Bullo. Vritra knew that this bull wasn’t a normal beast—it was a creature that could grow into a myriad one.
He had fed it the meat of some powerful demons, and not only did it survive, it also got stronger.
"Let’s begin our game!" With a snap of Vritra’s finger, everything became dark, then a bright light descended only upon the large field, the seats still remaining dark.
"Let’s welcome our second batch of subjects, the Greedy Bandits!!" Several red lights descended from the sky as over fifty men suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
All of them were still holding weapons and looked ready to attack. They had been frozen inside the dimensional book with Vritra’s time field, so for them not even a second had passed.
"Look at these murderers! They look as if they are just about to commit a murder. So disgusting. Daddy V, kill them!"
"Kill them, Daddy... V!!"
Finally, those bandits came to their senses, and suddenly finding themselves in the center of this place instead of the hotel confused them all.

"Now, let’s welcome the final test subject for today—the Zombie Cultists!" As Vritra spoke, he snapped his fingers again, and this time hundreds upon hundreds of men appeared in the area out of nowhere.
There were nearly a thousand men, all in a really bloody state—flesh torn and stretched, even their bodies seemed to be rotting.
Some of them had died, but Vritra had kept most alive for this event.
"Z- Zombies? I have heard of them in stories, but zombies really exist? Bone Blood Cult is a zombie cult? They are cannibals?"
The people were filled with even more disgust. They could imagine those bloody figures devouring innocent people, the blood and flesh still covering the mouths of many.
"Now, here comes the game. It is very simple—there will be three sides. Test Subject A, the God Pisser, Fat Ziggy. Test Subject B, the Murderer Bandits.
And lastly, Test Subject C, the Zombie Cultists." Vritra began to explain the game to the enraged and overly excited crowd.
In the Quartz Continent, there exist even glyphs that people could use to talk over large distances like a mobile— and many people here had them.
They began to call others to this place, really glad that they didn’t miss it.
"Our great Bullo right here will be hunting the zombies, so Subjects C, make sure to protect yourselves.

Then these zombies will be hunting the Subjects B, the bandits. And finally, the bandits will be hunting the pig. If any of you succeed in your task, then you won’t receive punishment and will be sent into a prison.
Of course, the game won’t be that simple." Vritra said, and hearing the arrangement, people became even more excited.
In their entire lives, they had never witnessed anything like this.
{Sin Point Gained: Cheered +10,256}
{Sin Point Gained: Urged +10,005}
{Sin Point Gained: Excited +10,234}
{Sin Point Gained: Bloodthirsty +10,203}
Vritra wasted no time. Using the Dust ability, the interior of the arena began to change instantly.
Countless dust soldiers holding arrows and spears appeared over the walls, making the whole arena seem like a giant puzzle.
Vritra created all sorts of traps, various monsters, and a lot more. This was going to be one hell of a game for the participants and the test subjects.
"Now finally, you all must be wondering why I called you participants in this. You all are free to place your bets on the people you want to die first.

You could win lots of money, and for every bit of money spent, you will receive these mystery glyphs that you could throw in to get someone killed faster." Vritra said, then in a loud voice, he announced:
"LET’S GET THE GAME STARTED!"

chapters.title: Chapter 423: The winner takes it all!
paragraphs: [D-Day 14]
Suddenly the whole arena was filled with lights and various people spread across the seats—there were Onest, Shitless, Xi, and many other demons whom Maeve had called.
The people were crazily betting money and getting different types of glyphs.
Vritra wasn’t low on money; he only added this part to attract more and make it more fun.
The number of people was increasing gradually, and the news of the event had already started to spread.
"Haa, that was a bit tough but we managed to do it. But I think we would have to call for more people as the crowd increases." Maeve landed beside Vritra and spoke.
She already knew the details but was just as excited as others.
Once everything was settled, Vritra flew higher into the sky as everything darkened once again, and then light fell towards the fighting area.
"Be ready, the game has started!"
Right after saying so, Vritra and Maeve disappeared, and now only the people in the arena remained—they stood frozen and consumed with terror.
All three subjects were terrified. Although the zombies didn’t have full control over their bodies, they could feel everything, and their bodies kept urging them to eat more flesh and organs.
The bandits were terrified too, unable to understand anything.
They were just about to make the biggest heist of their lives and then suddenly appeared here.
ROOAAAARRRRRRRR!
It was Bullo’s roar that brought everyone to their senses. The large bull charged toward the zombies, pointing its large and dangerous horns at them.
All the zombies moved in haste and rushed toward the bandits—eating them alive seemed the best idea right now.
And lastly, the bandits attacked the fat pig demon. Vritra had lowered Ziggy’s defenses and strength with his Forbidden Skill.
Countless dust statues rose all over the area and began to launch arrows and spears toward everyone.
"Kekeke, take this attack, asshole, and die!!" someone in the public shouted like a maniac, and then threw a glyph at a zombie.
WHOOSH
The zombie barely dodged the glyph as it hit the area behind him, but then with a loud boom, a thin stem of a flower appeared that charged straight into the zombie’s body from below.
"Whoa, I hit it! Keke, now let’s see what this thing is going to do. Hurry, kill him!"
The stem continued to grow, all eyes focused on it, and then it pierced through the zombie’s brain before blossoming into a beautiful flower that made his head explode.
Of course, Vritra wouldn’t lose such free experience points. He had arranged a few of his soul wraiths to kill them and swallow their souls.
"WHOAAA! I WON! I FUCKING WON! I KILLED A DAMNED Bone Blood Cult ZOMBIE!" The man cheered loudly, jumping on his seat.
In a few moments, a man flew closer and threw at him five times the amount he had spent, making him regret that he hadn’t used more coins.
"Me! Me! Give me those glyphs too! Take all my money, I need to erase them from this earth too!"
"Ughhh, I didn’t bring much money—can I borrow some? I will repay by winning. I can’t miss this moment, I have to kill those bastards at any cost!"
All the people began to shout, and the sales of the glyphs rose instantly.
If they could kill the zombies, their money would be 5x, 10x for bandits, and 30x for the pig demon who was rushing all over the arena, dodging the attacks.
"OINK OINK Let me goooo! My father OINK OINK is going to butcher you all—he is dem—cough—he is a lord!" Ziggy shouted.
"Haha! Look at the fatty, lying through his teeth! If your father is a lord, then my father is the lord fucker!! Keke, take this fatso, let me just pierce that delicate body of yours!"
Someone in the crowd shouted, who had placed his bet on Ziggy for bigger rewards.
Only after the first person was killed did Vritra reappear, and instantly thousands of sin points flooded in. They all looked at him with respect and reverence.
The number had already increased to over 11k.
ROOAAARRRRR!!
Bullo let out a terrifying scream and pierced each of his horns through a zombie, running at full speed and attacking them.
Vritra had promised more meat for more kills.
{Sin Point Gained: Called out +11,634}
{Sin Point Gained: Respected +11,340}
{Sin Point Gained: Begged for money +4,354}
Vritra flew across the arena, getting as many reactions as possible.
After thirty or so minutes had passed, he snapped his finger, and everyone stopped.
"Now, let’s make it more interesting." Instantly, a large dust giant rose high into the sky, its body large enough to crush the subjects with one stomp.
"Now, the three subjects will be killing this giant thing. The one with the last hit will be the winner. As for our participants, the rules are still the same."
Vritra said, and after a loud clap, the giant came to life, astonishing everyone.
It was just getting better and better.
Terrified, all the subjects hurriedly attacked the giant, but even their combined attacks could barely do any damage, making them feel despair and hopelessness.
"T- This... how are we supposed to OINK OINK kill it?" Ziggy kept jumping away as a few of the zombies got killed by the giant.
"See! At its forehead, there is a stone. I think we need to destroy it!" The tattooed bandit shouted, using Piggy’s body as a shield.
"I see, Oink Oink, so that’s how it is. This makes things Oink a lot easier. Everyone! Boost me up; after jumping that high, I will destroy it." Ziggy shouted, his fat body jiggling.
"No, I will be the one going up, you are too heavy." The leader of the bandits jumped away and shouted.
"I will be able to deal more damage, OINK OINK. Hurry up, this is no time to fight!" Ziggy shouted, and the leader reluctantly agreed.
"At three... two... one!!" All of them got closer and threw Ziggy toward the head of the giant with their full strength.
WHOOSH
Right at that moment, a glyph flew and hit Ziggy in the face. Instantly, his body got wrapped by a metallic ring, and he was thrown off course.
"Fuck, I knew it! Let’s not waste the momentum—throw me up!"
The tattooed man shouted, and then his body was thrown up.
Several glyphs flew towards him too, but he barely dodged them all, and with all his might, he broke the stone.
BANG!
"Yaaayyyyy! We did it! Finally, I can spend my entire life in a prison—you fuckers can rot here and eat one another." The leader shouted, shocking all the subjects.
The large giant instantly began to crumble. The people were unhappy that they wouldn’t be able to kill that inhumane scum.
But just then, the dust that spread onto the ground turned into tiny dust ants—millions of them at least.
"W-What? T-Take me out! I won! Keep your promise!" The leader shouted in panic. Aside from the ants, even the other men were looking at him with murderous gazes.
"Heh, why should I? What makes you think I give a damn about your life, but..." Vritra suddenly paused dramatically.

Only after the first person was killed did Vritra reappear, and instantly thousands of sin points flooded in.
They all looked at him with respect and reverence.
The number had already increased to over 11k.
ROOAAARRRRR!!
Bullo let out a terrifying scream and pierced each of his horns through a zombie, running at full speed and attacking them.
Vritra had promised more meat for more kills.
{Sin Point Gained: Called out +11,634}
{Sin Point Gained: Respected +11,340}
{Sin Point Gained: Begged for money +4,354}
Vritra flew across the arena, getting as many reactions as possible.
After thirty or so minutes had passed, he snapped his finger, and everyone stopped.
"Now, let’s make it more interesting." Instantly, a large dust giant rose high into the sky, its body large enough to crush the subjects with one stomp.
"Now, the three subjects will be killing this giant thing.
The one with the last hit will be the winner.
As for our participants, the rules are still the same."
Vritra said, and after a loud clap, the giant came to life, astonishing everyone.
It was just getting better and better.
Terrified, all the subjects hurriedly attacked the giant, but even their combined attacks could barely do any damage, making them feel despair and hopelessness.
"T- This... how are we supposed to OINK OINK kill it?" Ziggy kept jumping away as a few of the zombies got killed by the giant.
"See!
At its forehead, there is a stone.
I think we need to destroy it!" The tattooed bandit shouted, using Piggy’s body as a shield.
"I see, Oink Oink, so that’s how it is.
This makes things Oink a lot easier.
Everyone!
Boost me up; after jumping that high, I will destroy it." Ziggy shouted, his fat body jiggling.
"No, I will be the one going up, you are too heavy." The leader of the bandits jumped away and shouted.
"I will be able to deal more damage, OINK OINK.
Hurry up, this is no time to fight!" Ziggy shouted, and the leader reluctantly agreed.
"At three... two... one!!" All of them got closer and threw Ziggy toward the head of the giant with their full strength.
WHOOSH
Right at that moment, a glyph flew and hit Ziggy in the face.
Instantly, his body got wrapped by a metallic ring, and he was thrown off course.
"Fuck, I knew it!
Let’s not waste the momentum—throw me up!"
The tattooed man shouted, and then his body was thrown up.
Several glyphs flew towards him too, but he barely dodged them all, and with all his might, he broke the stone.
BANG!
"Yaaayyyyy!
We did it!
Finally, I can spend my entire life in a prison—you fuckers can rot here and eat one another." The leader shouted, shocking all the subjects.
The large giant instantly began to crumble.
The people were unhappy that they wouldn’t be able to kill that inhumane scum.
But just then, the dust that spread onto the ground turned into tiny dust ants—millions of them at least.
"W-What?
T-Take me out!
I won!
Keep your promise!" The leader shouted in panic.
Aside from the ants, even the other men were looking at him with murderous gazes.
"Heh, why should I?
What makes you think I give a damn about your life, but..." Vritra suddenly paused dramatically.

chapters.title: Chapter 424: Absurd Twists
paragraphs: Vritra paused and added: "Had you not turned your back against your brothers, I would have let you go. So whoever kills the leader first will get his privilege." Vritra announced.
Once again, the shouts of the crowd began to ring out; they were even more bloodthirsty and wanted to see each and every single one of them die the most horrible death.
"N- No, I am sorry, I must have gone mad, p- please forgive m-" but before he could finish, a glyph hit his face, scaring the shit out of him.
{Sin Point Gained: Appreciated +12,024}
{Sin Point Gained: Liked +11,953}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +11,623}
{Sin Point Gained: Idolized +11,108}
"Kuku, he has weakened, let’s kill this son of a bitch. He once stole my girl and I can’t do anything but watch the whole thing, brothers, let me kill this fucker with my hand to avenge her."
One of the bandits shouted and rushed forward with a spear in hand.
But instead of harming the leader, the glyph began to wrap around his body as countless thick vines came out of it.
His size grew, and soon he rose over twenty meters, completely in control of the giant body.
"Huh? W- What? I can... control it? Whoa..." the leader tried jumping around and attacking; each attack was really powerful.
"Haha, now which son of a bitch did you want to kill, motherfucker? Not only did I fuck your girl, but even your mother—and she agreed just for a few gold coins hahahaha..."
The leader let out a loud laugh, finally in control, and now no one can hurt him.
"Fuck, there are even glyphs that could boost their strengths?" The person who had thrown the glyph to kill the leader sighed in disappointment.
"Now I am going to kill everyone here and spend my life peacefully in prison." He laughed even harder.
"L- Leader, you mistook my words, of course I had brought her solely for you. I hadn’t even touched her. As for my mother, of course you can do..."
But before any of them could make a move, millions of ants rushed towards the giant and within seconds they devoured the entire giant vine-like body.
THUD
The leader fell to the ground, several wounds on his body as the ants continued to bite and devour him.
"Ah haha I- I was just joking. How dare haa haa I ever ughhh damnit it hurts, t- touch your mother, it was your girl who seduced me, I swear I at least didn’t enter her bac--"
The leader almost pissed in his clothes as he jerked the ants off his body.
"Of course you cannot touch my mother, you asshole. Brothers, give me one chance to kill this bastard to take revenge." The same bandit shouted and rushed forward.
The people in the crowd were going crazy at the twists and turns; it was all so worth it.
"Damnit I am going to die of laughter, just look at their expressions. Daddy... V make them regret ever hurting anyone!" someone shouted.
"Now participants, all of you will be receiving one free glyph from me and if any of you could kill anyone then you will win large sums of money."
Vritra announced, loving the rain of sin points as the number of people kept increasing.
Onest and the others quickly spread the glyphs to almost thirteen thousand people; some of them were fake and few actually worked.
"Throw!!" All of them threw their glyphs at the same time, and most just disappeared but some exploded in the sky and a strange juice rained down.
At first the subjects were afraid that it might be acidic or poisonous, but quickly they realized that it was a fragrant and sweet fluid.
"Is it to let us relax?" Ziggy questioned, happy that the leader had taken his place.
He hadn’t even eaten anything in an entire day, so the smell made him mad and he began to devour it hungrily.
"H- Huh? Are we feeding them now? Just what is going on, Daddy uh... V?" people questioned.
Zombies also began to drink the fluid, though most bandits remained cautious, trying to shield themselves from the fluid.
Not even a couple of minutes had passed when all of a sudden the ground began to shake; disgusting, grotesque, small and large insects covered in blood and dirty gu came out of the ground.
Ziggy and the zombies paused, having a really bad feeling about it.
And just as they expected, the ants and those small creatures rushed towards the smell of the fluid.
"Uwaaaaah! Get t- this off me OINK OINk F- Fatherrrrr save me, your son is being tortured here!" Ziggy shouted while making a run for his life.
The insects instantly began to cut through their bodies and eat their skins, while also tearing their bodies apart to eat all the fluid they had swallowed.
While the public looked at all this in awe and amazement, Vritra just watched the tens of thousands of sin points flooding.
Normally, most of these people would vomit seeing a scene even a tenth as bloody as this, but here they were cheering and throwing glyphs to kill them faster.
"Attention everyone, I have good news for you all!" Vritra shouted as all eyes pointed towards him and the game on the ground paused.
"We have an honorable member of our emperor’s army, a general so selfless that he would even sacrifice anything for the public. General Sirius!"
Vritra said and then pointed towards the sky, where a man had been secretly watching it all.
He had been sent here by the emperor along with a few others to keep an eye on Vritra and everything else, and though the method was questionable, it seemed to be going pretty well.
"Let’s welcome Our General Sirius... He had spent a vast fortune of his own to build an entire town and helped countless people."
Vritra announced, as all gazes shifted towards the sky, and Sirius finally became visible.
He was rather surprised; this was his first mission after the rest.
"Anyway, the good news is while I raided the base of those inhumane zombies, I was able to save some of the people.
The rest were already devoured by them when I got there." A sand platform appeared in the sky, and in the next instant, hundreds of people who had almost died appeared.
"Y- You saved them all? Thank you very much, Sir Daddy—uh, Daddy Sir... sir agent." The general added, happiness clearly visible on his face.
’This guy is so much better than that ungrateful bastard.
If I see him again, I am going to repay him several times over.’ Sirius thought, impressed by Vritra.
"Although it is a lot to ask, but for now can you take care of them? I will gladly help with any capital or anything." Vritra said, tilting his head upwards in pride.
And this act reflected on his sin points—the messages began to flash even faster; people seemed to have more faith in Vritra than even the emperor now.
"..." All the people were allowed to get a seat in the arena and watch the whole show so they could get over their trauma and become normal.
But it further increased his sin points.

chapters.title: Chapter 425: Exposed!
paragraphs: "Now, let’s not waste any more time and continue with the game. Kill those demons in human skin, these fucking monsters!!" Vritra said loudly as the place once again got filled with cheers and screams.
The game continued for hours, and by the end of the day, the number of people had reached nearly twenty thousand.
There were a few breaks in the midst, and Vritra kept adding more twists to keep the public entertained.
As the sky started to turn dark, Vritra finally ended the game for the day. The public didn’t seem to want to leave yet, but knowing that it would continue the next day, all of them left excitedly.
Over a hundred zombies had been killed, some bandits were killed too, many received injuries, so the stock of the subjects had gone down.
And to make it more interesting for the next day, Vritra needed more of the subjects.
"Make sure to come again tomorrow, it will be even more fun with more subjects and more money!!" Vritra announced as the crowd had just started to move.
"Hoo, that was really fun and a bit tiring." Maeve said as she slumped onto Vritra’s back, hugging him tightly.
"You did great today, and those demons of yours too, but for tomorrow’s game, I need more subjects."
Caressing her hands, Vritra mumbled while the others packed up things and cleaned off everything.
He had already stored the subjects inside his books of dimensions, slowing their bodies greatly so time would actually pass faster outside, but they would have some time to rest.
"Oh, so we need to find more subjects, well that’s not a problem."
Maeve let go as Vritra turned to face her, then she took out a glyph from her inventory.
"That’s a communication glyph." Yasmine said.
Recently, she hadn’t been able to spend more time with Vritra, she really wanted to come out.
’Is that a one-time use item?’ he questioned.
"No, it can be used for a long time." Yasmine answered.
"And who do you plan to contact with that?" Vritra’s gaze finally moved from the glyph to Maeve.
"Crow." After speaking, she lightly squeezed the glyph and inserted her energy.
After a few moments, the annoyed face of Crow became visible like a holographic projection.
"You again, what do you want to ask now?" Crow questioned, glancing at Vritra and Maeve.
"We are in the Cloud City, tell us the location of the bases of dark organizations around here." She questioned.
"Ughh, you are making me lose so much money, any outsider would need to pay a lot to get such information, tch..."
After venting his anger, Crow finally began to tell the locations.
Just inside the Cloud City, there were various bases from the Nine Pacts, Bone Blood Cult, and many other organizations.
"Alright, thanks." Right after getting the info, she cut the communication and put the glyph away.
"If you had that, then why did you bring me there the last time?" Vritra asked curiously.
"Crow is stubborn, but now seeing you with me the last time, he won’t sell any information about you, and you could also get any information from him."
Maeve explained, not to mention he also got to see the base of the World Information Centre.
"I see, anyway, let’s go do some hunting. It will also help me clear up some trash." Vritra said as the two disappeared.
After collecting enough sin points, the first thing he planned to do was to increase his Field comprehension. Only after that would he think of doing anything else.
The sky had turned completely dark.
Two figures appeared inside a few bases of the dark organizations, and without letting anyone even make a sound, all the people disappeared completely.
One base of Nine Pacts, one base of Bone Blood Cult, and two bases of other dark organizations were completely emptied and destroyed.
Vritra kept them all in his dimensional book, freezing the time for them all. When waking up, they all would find themselves inside the arena.
After doing the whole work, Vritra and Maeve flew back towards their hotel. Since even the owner of the hotel was captured, several rooms became empty there.
Stopping in the middle, they ate food together and finally came back into the rooms.
"Master, I know this game and torture is fun and all, but is there a reason behind putting on this show? Are you planning to do something big? Destroy the entire continent?"
Maeve asked, gently carding her fingers through Vritra’s hair as his head rested on her lap.
"Yeah, there is indeed a reason, something I will tell you very soon. But I can tell you that if I get more attention, then I could grow faster." Vritra answered vaguely.
"Hmm..." Maeve knew that Vritra was still reluctant to be completely open with her, but she was happy just knowing that he was giving her a chance.
This was by far the happiest period of her life, and throwing it all away, she wanted to be his bride and stay at home with him.
At the thought of something so dreamlike, the demoness felt a flutter in her stomach, making her feel oddly light and giddy.
"Oh right, you have a way to contact your brother, right?" Vritra questioned, gazing up at her face.
"Yeah, I do. Do you want to talk to him?"
Maeve replied, leaning her head forward as her smooth long hair fell onto his face, spreading a sweet fragrance.
"No. Anyway, Foxie, how is your relationship with your brother?" Vritra questioned, gently tugging her hair behind her ear.
"Well, I would say pretty bad, why? Do you wish to use him in your plans somehow?" Maeve said. She could somewhat understand why he could be asking.
"Yeah, he might die, so..."
"It’s fine, we might have grown up together, but if you want to kill him, then it is okay. We aren’t all that close anyway. Anything for you, master~"
Maeve said as she leaned down and gave a soft kiss onto Vritra’s lips.
After a moment, she pulled back and asked softly, "Can we practice it again, master? I think I need more lessons on kissing..."
Smiling, Vritra got up and pushed the fox demon down as he began to devour her lips, the two losing themselves in the passion.
Vritra had started to trust Maeve quite a lot already; after all, the sin messages wouldn’t lie, and all the feelings she displayed were true.
On the contrary, her feelings seemed even stronger than what she actually showed.
Whenever Maeve was around, the sin point messages like ’Stared at’, ’Watched’, and such would keep on popping.
The fox demon was really ready to throw everything, even her status, strength, and loyalty, just so she could be with him.
Vritra hugged her tightly as the two lovingly and passionately kissed, their lips overlapping and their tongues intertwined. Moving from one mouth to another, their bodies pressed tightly.
Despite the love brewing, Vritra still didn’t go all the way with her because of a few reasons.
After he was done with the trouble and the deaths of some people in the Voromir Kingdom, could he truly welcome her properly into his family.
[D-Day 13]
As the sky brightened and the new day started, various changes happened across different places.
Darius was quite pleased with the outcome and Vritra’s planning. It had solved a big problem for him, and now he could safely focus on other things.
The people had finally calmed down, knowing that everything wasn’t lost. The Golden Moon was still protecting them, and the evil was being punished.
The news had spread far and wide through dozens of cities on the continent.
As more and more people began to move towards the Cloud City to witness it all and participate—some for money, some for entertainment, and some for the sense of justice.
If he had some free time, then he might have gone to that arena himself.
On the other hand, Yennefer, who had been searching for Vritra, was sure that if there was such a thing happening, then Vritra would definitely be a part of it.
So, she too rushed towards the Cloud City. She wanted to be a part of his life once again at any cost and also warn him of the extreme dangers.
Inside the arena, Vritra stood at the center of the fighting area and just gazed at the crowd. He was quite surprised.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +72,452}
{Sin Point Gained: Urged +72,452}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +72,439}
The number of people right at the start was already so high; this excited Vritra greatly. His show was a hit, it seemed.
Though it was no surprise, he had added every flavor the public loved to the extreme.
"Master, I have called for more demons, so don’t you worry, we will handle the crowd properly. And I have already gotten all the glyphs exactly as you wanted them to be."
Maeve reported through the communication glyph.
"Good job, now just sit and enjoy the show, this will be even more spectacular than yesterday." Vritra spoke, then a figure appeared beside him.
It was none other than Ziggy, the fat demon pig who had already healed from the previous day’s injuries and exhaustion.
"Yo, Ziggy, how are you doing?" Vritra asked, his lips curling up, and before the pig demon could start his usual begging, he added,
"Be ready, since today’s challenges are going to be even more dangerous."
Unbeknownst to the public, a great exposure of someone’s true identity was about to unfold in the arena within minutes, one that would fill them all with immense rage.

After a moment, she pulled back and asked softly, "Can we practice it again, master?
I think I need more lessons on kissing..."
Smiling, Vritra got up and pushed the fox demon down as he began to devour her lips, the two losing themselves in the passion.
Vritra had started to trust Maeve quite a lot already; after all, the sin messages wouldn’t lie, and all the feelings she displayed were true.
On the contrary, her feelings seemed even stronger than what she actually showed.
Whenever Maeve was around, the sin point messages like ’Stared at’, ’Watched’, and such would keep on popping.
The fox demon was really ready to throw everything, even her status, strength, and loyalty, just so she could be with him.
Vritra hugged her tightly as the two lovingly and passionately kissed, their lips overlapping and their tongues intertwined.
Moving from one mouth to another, their bodies pressed tightly.
Despite the love brewing, Vritra still didn’t go all the way with her because of a few reasons.
After he was done with the trouble and the deaths of some people in the Voromir Kingdom, could he truly welcome her properly into his family.
[D-Day 13]
As the sky brightened and the new day started, various changes happened across different places.
Darius was quite pleased with the outcome and Vritra’s planning.
It had solved a big problem for him, and now he could safely focus on other things.
The people had finally calmed down, knowing that everything wasn’t lost.
The Golden Moon was still protecting them, and the evil was being punished.
The news had spread far and wide through dozens of cities on the continent.
As more and more people began to move towards the Cloud City to witness it all and participate—some for money, some for entertainment, and some for the sense of justice.
If he had some free time, then he might have gone to that arena himself.
On the other hand, Yennefer, who had been searching for Vritra, was sure that if there was such a thing happening, then Vritra would definitely be a part of it.
So, she too rushed towards the Cloud City.
She wanted to be a part of his life once again at any cost and also warn him of the extreme dangers.
Inside the arena, Vritra stood at the center of the fighting area and just gazed at the crowd.
He was quite surprised.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +72,452}
{Sin Point Gained: Urged +72,452}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +72,439}
The number of people right at the start was already so high; this excited Vritra greatly.
His show was a hit, it seemed.
Though it was no surprise, he had added every flavor the public loved to the extreme.
"Master, I have called for more demons, so don’t you worry, we will handle the crowd properly.
And I have already gotten all the glyphs exactly as you wanted them to be."
Maeve reported through the communication glyph.
"Good job, now just sit and enjoy the show, this will be even more spectacular than yesterday." Vritra spoke, then a figure appeared beside him.
It was none other than Ziggy, the fat demon pig who had already healed from the previous day’s injuries and exhaustion.
"Yo, Ziggy, how are you doing?" Vritra asked, his lips curling up, and before the pig demon could start his usual begging, he added,
"Be ready, since today’s challenges are going to be even more dangerous."
Unbeknownst to the public, a great exposure of someone’s true identity was about to unfold in the arena within minutes, one that would fill them all with immense rage.

chapters.title: Chapter 426: The Pig’s Trauma
paragraphs: Gazing at the vast crowd, Vritra could feel tens of thousands of sin points pouring in just by standing there.
It was going to be such a good day, and in this place, his earnings might even surpass what he earned in the White Kingdom.
After the public had settled down, it was finally time to start the show.
He slowly began to rise higher into the air, all the people excitedly and impatiently waiting.
"Hello, I am Daddy V, an agent from the Golden Moon. And I can see many familiar faces here today. I hope you all can win a lot of money," Vritra announced, earning even more points.
"Anyway, let’s first call out our subjects from the previous day."
Just as he finished speaking, the zombies, the bandits, and Ziggy appeared on the ground.
"Kukuku, just you wait, fatty pig. Today I am going to butcher that body of yours, you are all mine today!"
"No one is allowed to kill that leader of the bandits, I will be the one to kill him!"
Instantly, people began to threaten them. These were the same people who had been present the previous day too.
"Huh? What is wrong with these people? It seems they have gone mad." The people who had come for the first time were rather confused.
After a pause, Vritra continued, "I don’t think I need to give any intro for these people.
If you don’t know, then just ask someone beside you. Now let’s bring out more test subjects, more evil creatures."
Then he pulled out nearly two thousand people, all of whom were completely confused, wondering how they even ended up there.
"This bunch of people is the utter trash of society, the members of Nine Pacts, the people who skinned countless like you just in the name of experiments.
They planned to kill the god you pray to, they want to kill all your children and turn them into mindless chimeras and use them to devour their own family, just for their experiments!!"
Vritra said in a thundering voice, filling everyone in the crowd with rage.
"And we, the humans who have to protect our loved ones and our homes, would never let these sadistic bastards succeed in their plans.
So, I destroyed their bases and brought them here to be punished openly. This continent will soon be a place where you won’t have to fear anything. Let’s eradicate this evil together!!"
"YEAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!! KILLLL THEEEMMMMM!!"
"YOU ARE GOD!!"
"PLEASE START THE GAME, THOSE DEMONS NEED TO BE PUNISHED!!"
Vritra floated silently in the sky, taking in the strong reaction of the public.

Using just a few points, it was actually quite easy to distract and manipulate the public, and Vritra had long seen such things back on Earth where politicians always had a way to distract the public with some scandals.
"Alright, the rules will be the same as yesterday. The betting is still allowed.
The new subjects will be a part of the zombie group but won’t be spared by them, so zombies make sure to bite them and properly add them to your team."
Vritra said, and quickly the bets were placed, and they received various glyphs. This time people made sure to bring a lot of money.
After all the stuff was done, Vritra finally announced,
"The Game Begins!!"
Instantly the seats darkened, and light remained only in the inner part of the arena.
"F- Fuck! Not this again, OINK OINK, h-how long are we going to be tortured?" Ziggy rubbed his head and felt his heart tremble. This time the crowd was even bigger, and he could see a lot of glyphs.
All of the subjects were shivering, but they could do nothing but pitifully struggle to survive, just to go through the same torture the next day.
They had already started to regret ever choosing the dark organization.
No one was even coming to save them.
But the game had started and instantly...
ROOAAAARRRRRRR!!
Bullo seemed even more terrifying today. Right as Vritra announced, it charged into the group and began to tear them apart, giving deadly injuries.
And just like that, another day of the game started. Vritra made sure to add twists and turns to make it more interesting and watched as the number of people kept increasing.
After around five hours had passed and a break had just ended, Vritra was announcing the continuation when he suddenly paused.
"Let’s continue the ga—wait, what?" Suddenly he turned around, holding a communication glyph, shock on his face.
"Oh god, so something like that was going on behind our backs?" he spoke in a loud voice, acting as if he did so accidentally.
{Sin Point Gained: Confused +82,234}
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +82,353}
{Sin Point Gained: Urged +82,031}
"Dear participants, I have big news for you all!" Vritra said, his voice full of shock.
"But before that, I need to confirm something." After saying so, he landed on the ground and walked closer to Ziggy, who was lying flat on the ground, his body covered in wounds.
Instantly the public’s view was blocked. Ziggy looked at Vritra with fear, dragging his heavy body back.
"W-What do you want from me now? Oink Oink, p-please, I can give you whatever you want, just let me go, OINK OINK..." he begged, tears flowing down his cheeks.
"Haha, Ziggy, my friend, did you not recognize me? We met before, right?" Just after speaking, Vritra’s appearance changed, and his mask disappeared.
And Ziggy recognized him as the same demon who had kidnapped Maeve and was in control of her life force.
"Wh... so you were behind it from the beginning? How dare you do this to me?!! My father will find you from anywhere and give you the most terrifying death! Release me now! Where is Maeve?"
Ziggy’s fear instantly turned into rage; he was so angry.
Vritra snapped his finger, and the wall shifted, as Maeve, who was tied to a chair, appeared in view.
Vritra had disappeared; all of this was just an illusion now.
"Z-Ziggy?! Are you alright? What has he done to you, sob? You shouldn’t have tried to save me..." the fake Maeve spoke as tears filled her eyes.
"I-I have no regrets, if it is for you, I am ready to experience any tortu—" but before he could finish, the fake Vritra walked closer to Maeve and kissed her.
"Nooooo! You bastard, get away from her, I am going to kill you!!" Ziggy tried to move, but his body was held down by dust.
With Vritra’s back facing the pig, the two fake figures continued to kiss for a whole minute as the pig demon felt his very being burn in rage.
He had never been this angry; his future wife was just forcefully kissed by another demon. He wanted to destroy the entire continent.
"Heh, what about it?" Finally, the scene ended, the images disappeared, and the real Vritra stepped forward. All of it was very smooth.
Without wasting a moment, he removed the walls surrounding them as the public once again saw them.
"Sigh, just now I received big news. You should just look at it yourself."
After saying so, Vritra projected a video in the sky through a glyph that he had recorded previously.
In the video, Ziggy turned from his human form to the demonic one; it was at the moment when he had just met Vritra.

chapters.title: Chapter 427: The Voromir Realm
paragraphs: "H- He was a demon all along? That pig is actually a pig demon!"
All the people were shocked at first, and then all of it turned into anger; they really wanted to tear him apart.
"You bastard, don’t believe him! He is the real demon, he is fooling you all! He has even kidnapped my fiancée! He is the rea—"
SMASH
An egg landed straight on Ziggy’s face as people became even more enraged.
"How dare you call him a demon, he is the direct messenger of the god, the god’s hand who has come here to pass judgment!"
"Don’t you dare say anything about him! I will cut you apart myself!"
Vritra just relaxed, enjoying getting so many sin points. The numbers were really becoming absurd as the messages kept flashing in front of him again and again.
"Alright, game starts, hurry and kill those bastards. Especially that demon bastard!"
Vritra said quickly as he remained in the air, just to get sin points while enjoying the good show.
What happened after that was just too comedic; all the people targeted Piggy, and no matter how he said the truth, no one believed him.
Vritra wouldn’t let the game become boring no matter what, but this day, as nearly six hundred of them had died, he ended the event a bit early.
Since there were two things he planned to do—to get even more audience and make it even grander.
At around four, the game ended. Ziggy, of course, survived; Vritra wasn’t going to let him die just yet.
Putting the test subjects into his dimensional book, he watched as all the audience left, giving him sin points until the moment they had walked a bit far.
"Alright foxie, now it is time to go to your home and beat your brother’s ass up, and while we are at it, we can also put your stepmother in her place."
Vritra spoke, as Maeve obediently stood beside him, enjoying his gentle caress on her head.
"Yes master~" she said, almost purring like a cute cat, then returning to her senses, she added, "But if I go there, that fat mother of Raelion will sense my presence."
"Not when you are with me," Vritra said, as if this was a small matter, the fox demon gazing at him with a dreamy look.
After thinking for a moment, he looked into the empty sky and flew higher, removing the barrier from around them.
General Sirius was still lingering around.
"Hello General, thank you for being here. You might not know, but your presence gives me a sense of security," Vritra said, shaking hands with the general.
"Haha, as if. I can tell you just might be stronger than me, but it is quite rare to find such a well-mannered kid nowadays despite being so strong," Sirius laughed heartily, then added,
"About those people, you don’t have to worry about them. They were returned to their homes and given enough money and other resources.
The emperor even put several guards to patrol around their homes. Oh also, the emperor is really happy with your work."
Vritra nodded, quite impressed by the general’s righteousness. In this world, he just might be the only man who was so selfless and thought of others before himself.
"General, if it’s no burden to you, can you please deliver this to the emperor? I am sure he will be thrilled after reading this." Vritra said as he handed him the scroll.
"Alright, I can do that. You are doing a great job—though your methods might be a bit strange—but you are a good man."
Sirius nodded before turning around and flying away.
Now only Vritra and Maeve were left there. Onest had gone on a small mission given by Vritra along with Bullo and Shitless.
"Now tell me, which door is it that leads to that realm?" Vritra turned and questioned.
This might be his first serious fight against someone powerful, and he was going to get the most out of it.
"Let me lead you there, master~" Maeve nodded, and without wasting a moment, the two flew away.
Vritra used Forbidden to erase any sort of her presence; not even the queen of the Voromir Kingdom, who had Maeve’s life flame, would be able to sense her.
"This right here is the door." Maeve flew a vast distance from the Ghazi City and the City of the Clouds.
After crossing many cities, they arrived over a vast forest that spread over nearly a thousand miles at least.
Somewhere deep in the forest, there was a big pond, and somewhere inside it was the door of the realm.
"Oh, do we have to get in the pond?" Vritra asked. He tried to sense it, but without Nether Eye, he couldn’t do it.
"No need, I have the key," Maeve said and pulled a fist-sized white stone from her inventory. It had strange patterns drawn all over it.
As she pointed it towards the pond and filled it with her mana, it began to glow, and within moments, a big door emerged out of the pond.
"Oh, not bad." Vritra nodded.
The two jumped closer to the door, standing over the surface of the water.
As she pressed the stone against it, the door opened.
And the two entered the Voromir Kingdom.
Yennefer finally arrived inside the Cloud Realm.
She would have come sooner had it not been to get more info related to Vritra’s matter from the Golden Moon.
But upon arriving in the arena, she didn’t find anyone; there was no program going on as she had heard.
"Did it end already?" she wondered and confirmed her doubts with some passerby.
"Sigh, I was too late, I hope he is fine. I can only wait until tomorrow, I guess." Feeling disappointed, she flew away.
Each moment away from Vritra now was like torture; she was desperate to be with him, to feel him, and to get his love again.
"..." Vritra silently gazed around at this new realm; he was a bit curious about this place.
The whole place was a bit dark, with distant cries ringing at all times.
The houses were all in bad shape as if a storm had passed by there.
And quite a lot of demons were going on with their lives.
There were all sorts of demons; some were far away even from the imagination.
"Well, it is quite similar to how I expected it," Vritra mumbled; both of their presences were completely hidden.
"Who are you?" There were a few guards stationed near the door who hurriedly charged towards them.
"Let’s go straight to meet your mother first. You know the location of your life flame?" Vritra questioned, ignoring the guards.

"Not exactly, but I know she has kept it very close to her. Will we really be fine? This is their place, and who knows what sort of traps and other things they have set up here," Maeve asked worriedly.
She was worried that her mother might use others to hurt Vritra, but after thinking, it was actually quite hard to hurt him.
"Hubby, don’t you worry, I will do my best to let you know of any trap in advance. Hide me, I want to come out too," Yasmine spoke.
She was so bored not being able to come out at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 428: Sweet Home Alabama?
paragraphs: ’Alright wifey, sorry I have been too busy collecting sin points right now.’
Vritra said, and with the use of Forbidden and his dimensional book, Yasmine could move around freely without anyone noticing her.
"Haa, it is fine hubby, anyway, let’s focus on this task for now. Staying here for too long might not be good, the demons are too unpredictable and dangerous.
Raelion alone might not be a threat but never underestimate the unknown." Yasmine warned.
’Hmm...’ Vritra nodded, and so Maeve led them forward, leaving behind the guards frozen and confused about what they were doing.
Yasmine transformed into her human-like form and, like Maeve, she slumped over his back, wrapping her arms around his neck and gently laying her head over his shoulder.
’Sigh, if only breaking into the dragon kingdom was as easy. After collecting sin points, I will definitely try going there too. I want her to be happy.’ Vritra thought, gently holding her hand.
Even though she didn’t say it, he was sure that she must very badly want to get her body and be happy like the other women in his family.
She always kept that happy and playful front, but Vritra knew how much she had been through.
Vritra and Maeve were walking side by side as she kept pointing at different things or people and explaining them to him.

After nearly forty minutes, she pointed towards three people and spoke, "And those three are the only generals left behind from my father’s generation, and honestly, those three might be the only ones I could trust completely here aside from Xi."
Vritra glanced and saw Thaddeus, Morvik, and Silquor.
The three of them were sitting together and discussing something right outside a barely standing house.
"Shouldn’t we go greet them then?" Vritra asked, his lips curling slightly.
"Uh... sure, that is fine." Maeve nodded, wondering what her beloved master was planning now.
Getting closer, Vritra and Maeve increased the size of the barrier that had surrounded them, and upon sensing the change, the three generals were alerted.
"Who dares— huh? Little Maeve, it is you, and oh lord, you are finally here!"
The three first looked at Maeve and then their gazes moved to Vritra. The three instantly knelt down on the ground.
"Ah, how did you already know?" Maeve asked, acting shy.
"Of course we know that, since our lord told us himself, but when did you get to know?" Silquor asked. He was happy to see the lord being so happy and close with his daughter.
’Such love...’ the three’s hearts instantly melted at the sweetness.

"Huh? What sort of question is that? Haha, we are both in love and in a very, very close relation with each other." Maeve said, a big smile spreading across her beautiful face. She looked really happy.
Thaddeus, Silquor, and Morvik: "..."
BOOM
Something in their minds exploded, and they couldn’t say anything for a couple of minutes.
’Such love...?’ Their hearts that had just melted evaporated into thin air. This scene wasn’t sweet but fiery.
"H- H- Huh? Y- You mean to say you both are in that sort of relation? Like lovers?" Morvik asked, the most chilled guy among the three couldn’t keep his composure.
"Yes, what’s wrong with you three? Do you know him by any chance?" Maeve felt confused at their strange reaction.
Judging from her reaction, the three generals concluded that Maeve was unaware that it was not just any demon but her father.
Then they looked at Vritra with questioning gazes.
"L- Lord, you know her, right?" Thaddeus questioned.
"Yes, of course, she is Maeve." Vritra said with a shrug, enjoying their intense reactions.
The three glanced at one another, mumbling, "Who is going to tell them?"
"Anyway, we have some other work to do. Wait, and don’t tell anyone that we are already here."
Vritra said as he took Maeve’s hand and walked away.
Yasmine was floating around Vritra, laughing hard at her husband’s act and the generals’ reactions. It was all too funny.
As Vritra and Maeve walked away, the three generals were left there frozen, unable to mutter a single word.
This was a problem too big. Their lord was in a relation with his own daughter—what would others say about this?
But on second thought, demons didn’t really follow any rules. Still, that was his own daughter.
The three generals were torn.
"Haha, before I met those three, I had lied to them that I am Voromir Zuke after absorbing his core, and those idiots believed me rather easily. After that..."
Vritra explained the whole incident to Maeve, and she finally understood.
"Huff, so those three are thinking we are...? Haha, no wonder. Anyway, let them think about this for now, we can tell them about it later." Maeve laughed upon knowing the truth too.

Finally, they arrived in front of a large building that seemed like a castle straight out of a horror movie. It was entirely black, and brownish fungus was spreading across the walls, filling the cracks.
Demons kept entering and leaving the building; there were a lot of guards.
"Where do you think Raelion must be at this time?" Vritra questioned. Before getting into a fight with him, he had to secure the life flame.
"He usually goes around to play with women, so I don’t think he would be here right now.
You know his mother has been preparing her body so that she could marry that demon lord Sloth, the fattest being alive on this entire planet." Maeve said.
This was the reason even Raelion didn’t like his mother all that much.
She had gotten so fat that she couldn’t take one step off the bed now. Aside from that slothful obsession, she had taken many other bad habits.
"Well, that’s good, let’s go, and you should just stay out of the room." Vritra said as they made their way into the dark castle.
As the two walked inside, Vritra stared in amazement at the magical things. Even the walls seemed to come to life as they kept eating bugs.
There were a lot of things he was seeing, and the castle was a lot bigger inside than it appeared. It surely was a magical thing.
And probably a gift from the Demon Lord Skumbo, Voromir Zuke’s friend, just like the entire realm.
After taking various twists and turns in the maze-like place, they finally arrived in front of a room whose door was at least three times as big as the entrance of the castle itself.
"Is this where your stepmother lives?" Vritra questioned. He hadn’t seen her, but based on the door alone, he could imagine her.
"Yeah, be careful inside. Her strength might not be very high, but she has gathered a lot of trump cards over the years, and she is disgusting, so master, be really, really careful." Maeve warned.
"Any hints about the life flame?" Vritra asked as he stepped closer to the door.
"Hmm, when you get closer to it, you will be able to sense me, although very faintly." Maeve said as she nervously stood there.
Vritra nodded, and without wasting a moment, he went into his disappearing state before stepping into the room.
Though there were various restrictions, they couldn’t stop him.
Right as he entered, Vritra was startled as two completely different sorts of sounds entered his ears.
One was the painful scream of a man, and another was a terrifying roar-like moan.

chapters.title: Chapter 429: The Handsome Demon
paragraphs: Right as Vritra passed through the door in his disappearing state, he paused, hearing the strange noises.
It was like several enormous aliens were releasing those broken noises, and there was also a faint painful voice of a man.
’What the hell is going on here? Was that... a woman’s moan?’ Vritra was baffled just by the noises, even before he could register the sight inside.
BOOOM BOOOOM
Constant tremors went through the entire room, it was surprising that the bed and walls were still holding on.
Vritra shook his head and saw what seemed to be a big lump of fat, as if a human-shaped balloon had too much air and might burst at any moment.
Each of her fingers was as thick as Vritra’s arm.
The enormous queen was fatter than Vritra had expected; she seemed to weigh at least a few tons.
Her waist alone seemed extremely thick, her body wouldn’t fit in an average room.
And below that terrifying creature lay a man who seemed to have lost his soul, his body was getting thinner by the second.
"Oh, the old method of strength and life force draining. Well, the succubus race used to do that before, but their method was less cruel and dangerous." Yasmine spoke, still floating around him.
The queen’s skin was covered by long lines that seemed to have come from her body stretching too much, and her long hair spread across the large bed.
Her arms were stretched to both sides, because of too much fat she couldn’t even put them down. And on the top, there was no neck, her head looking too small compared to her body.
The sight was just absurd.
The demon lying under the queen seemed to be on his last breath, only skin and bones were left, and with each explosive sound, a few of his bones broke.
Vritra looked beside the bed and saw at least a few dozen men lying there, they were all dead and their bodies extremely thin.
"So she is stealing the life force of all these demons, no wonder despite two new lords in this place, it hasn’t grown much."
Vritra pondered, but his first task was to get Maeve’s life force.
Looking around, he found that the room was way too big, it was like another house built inside the ghost castle.
"Where am I supposed to find it now? Has she kept it close to her or in some secret storage?" Vritra mumbled, he tried to sense Maeve’s presence, but he couldn’t.
"Well, even your disappearing state might not keep you completely hidden here, be careful, there are a lot of traps and sensors."
Yasmine warned. It actually wasn’t very new to use a different dimension to trespass, but it was very difficult and rare.
And as usual, Vritra could only depend on his wise and beautiful waifu.
"Wifey, any suggestion?" he asked, keeping his eyes away from the disgusting sight happening on the bed.

The queen’s body was something that could cause lingering nightmares; even to bounce over the bed, she had tied her body to chains since, except for her fingers, she couldn’t really move all that much.
"Hehe my dear husband, I do have several suggestions. Now that we are actually here, then let’s take advantage of this place as much as we can, your strength needs to be increased after all.
As for the life flame, we will find it too." Yasmine said in her playful tone.
"Uh... What evil plan are you brewing up now, wifey? Are we looting the treasury again or something?" Vritra said, getting excited.
"Well, that’s the bare minimum since the queen has formed with a powerful demon lord’s family, so they must have quite a few treasures, but we are gonna take more than that."
As she spoke, Yasmine’s cunning gaze drifted towards the queen’s body.
"Huh? What do you mean?" Vritra felt confused, but with full trust in his wife, he decided to start just as she instructed.
Outside the queen’s room, Maeve stood with a worried look. The queen might be weak, but this place still wasn’t safe.
"Master..." if she found that Vritra was in any danger, then without worrying about her life flame, killing that queen was the first thing she would do.
Even if she might die along, only now she understood that there are actually things that you come to cherish more than your own life.
Although their relationship was still building, Vritra was here taking such a big risk just for her, and it meant a lot for Maeve.
When had anyone ever cared so much for her? While she was deep in thought, she remembered that her pact with Vritra was still not canceled.
And being here, the queen could easily kill her, so without wasting any time she began to sever that connection; just in case if she died, she wouldn’t want Vritra to die for no reason.
Yasmine explained the plan, and Vritra felt proud that his wife had learned so much from him.
Otherwise, how could the Queen of Dragons make such plans?
"Alright wifey, let me continue from here, just sit back and rest." Vritra spoke.
Yasmine had some knowledge of the queen, and they got to know more about her from Maeve, so their plan was just perfect.
"Be careful hubby." After speaking, Yasmine finally disappeared, returning to his body.
Taking a deep breath, Vritra focused on his goals. After going over the entire plan, he nodded, then he scanned the room once more.
’Let’s start with the treasury, maybe I might just find the life flame there.’
After a thought, he took a step forward but instantly felt as if he had stepped over something intangible.
"Uh oh..."
Instantly, alarms went off in the room, and hundreds of thin ropes wrapped around his body, entering the page of his dimensional book.
"GRRRRR- WHO IS THERE?"
In the midst of her moans, the queen paused and turned, her tiny eyes wide open with rage. She was so close to orgasm after absorbing all the energy of another demon.
But now the fun had suddenly ended, the demon died, and she lost the peak of pleasure.
The culprit got caught in one of the traps, and with a light tug of her finger, several glyphs became active, and the small realm Vritra was hidden in was destroyed.
His real body instantly became visible, wrapped by thin strands of energy ropes, making it impossible for him to move at all.
"OH." With the use of chains holding up her body, she rotated herself to see the person she was going to kill.
But seeing the person in question, she froze in shock.
After all, it was such a handsome demon, tall, strong, and just perfect in every aspect, with two horns on his head looking like his crown.
"Well hello, sorry to have disturbed you, miss. Please continue with your business, I was just passing through." Vritra said, appearing as if he was trying to hide his nervousness.
From Maeve, they had found that handsome demons are the biggest weakness of the queen; she just goes mad upon seeing one.
And it was the first time for her to see someone like Vritra, her mind exploded.
"G- Gagaga." For a few seconds, she couldn’t say anything, but then she sensed such pure and strong energy from Vritra, and she knew she had just found the perfect target.
And she wasn’t planning to just use him like others; she planned to keep him for herself for a very, very long time.
"Oh intruder, you came at just the right time, the meals offered to me had just ended, so won’t you replace them?" Even the queen’s voice sounded so strange, as if a bear was trying to speak.
"Hmm, you look younger, I heard young guys now like older women, so would you like to come near mommy?" She questioned.
Vritra almost vomited at the disgusting offer and sight.
But there was a script he needed to follow, and this was where the misty essence was going to come in full use.
From under his feet, Psyche flew and left the room silently, everything was under control so far.
Vritra was confident that even with all her gadgets, she wouldn’t be able to kill or capture him.
"No thank you, what would I even gain from all that?" Vritra said as if he was seriously considering.
The queen held back the urge to force him. If he came on his own wishes, then she would get the perfect doll; she could keep such a handsome pet and suck him dry slowly.
Chuckling evilly inside, she decided to lure him with treasures.
"Of course, you will get everything that I own. I am the queen, and you might become my king, of course, if you are obedient."
The queen spoke, all her reasoning had failed the moment she had seen the most handsome demon.
If not for obtaining support and strength from the demon lord Sloth, then she might really have taken this young demon as her husband.
But it didn’t matter as long as she could keep him for herself, the faint energy around his body felt so pure and inviting.
"Hmm? I can get what? Your treasures? Your slaves? I am a cautious person, and I don’t trust anyone until you have proven yourself worthy of my trust.
And if you can, then I will definitely surrender myself to you." Vritra spoke, forcefully stopping his lips from curling since something really fun and evil was about to happen here soon.
