And if you can, then I will definitely surrender myself to you." Vritra spoke, forcefully stopping his lips from curling since something really fun and evil was about to happen here soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 430: The Taste of Taboo
paragraphs: "..." The queen fell silent and thought for a couple of minutes.
And she came to the conclusion that even if Vritra saw some of her treasures now, it wouldn’t matter, since the moment he surrendered, she would turn him into her slave for the rest of his life.
She could do anything to get that man.
The queen had forgotten to question why he was here or how he entered; it clearly seemed like a trap.
But Vritra himself was her biggest weakness.
"Sigh fine, let me show you everything that you can obtain if you accept me. Your life will only be filled with pleasure, treasures, and happiness."
In her monstrous voice, the queen laughed and gave a gentle squeeze to the chains holding her body.
And soon, several doors appeared on the previously empty walls. Each door was very large and held lots of treasures.
"..." Vritra’s lips finally curled up as he got ready to steal everything he could in the next two minutes, after all, that is the time that Raelion would probably last.
Some distance away inside the Voromir kingdom, in a tall building.
Raelion was lying on the bed, several demon women spread across the room.
Ever since returning from the Ghazi city, he had been in a really good mood even though he was chased and beaten like a dog.
And the reason behind his happiness was obviously Yennefer’s announcement. He really wanted to see Darius’s face at that moment.

Looking at the women in the room, he sighed; none of them could even match one percent of Yennefer. She had just that special aura, that superior air around her that could make any sort of man fall for her.
"Haa but how do I get her..." he sighed, his mood dampening as he remembered Yennefer’s words.
Maybe she made this announcement specifically because she already has a man. This filled Raelion with rage, only if he knew who it was.
Yennefer was certainly one of his biggest weaknesses; at least he had something in common with that mother of his that he hated so much.
Ever since his father’s death, she had turned into something disgusting, and to please the Demon Lord Sloth she got so fat, starting to sleep with so many men every day.
He truly felt ashamed to have her as his mother.
BANG
Just while he was deep in thought, something flew into his room from the window and hit the wall.
Alerted, he instantly jumped up and covered himself in a barrier, but upon looking closely he found that it was a stone with paper wrapped around it.
"Hmm? What is this?" Glancing outside, he sensed a shadow flying towards the castle, then he picked up the stone.
Unwrapping the paper, he threw it aside and observed the stone but couldn’t find anything strange.
Then glancing down, he saw something written on the paper.
"My lord, if you want to know Yennefer’s whereabouts, then come to the castle, your mother is going to kill me!" Even by the writing, he could feel the urgency.
And knowing his mother, he was sure if her batch of men ended, she would pick someone randomly from the kingdom.
"Damnit, did she kidnap one of my men now?" Raelion felt angry. Without wasting a moment, he flew away.
Before his mother was done with it, he had to go and save that man and get info about Yennefer.
WHOOSH
"Look closely, all those potions, treasures, everything will belong to you. You just need to say a simple yes."
The queen planned to take Vritra’s life flame first so he would never be able to escape.
She couldn’t do it forcefully like Maeve; it needed to be agreed upon from both sides.
Vritra observed the treasuries, and indeed there was a lot. He would become quite rich with all that, not to mention so many potions.
Even the land of a fallen lord wasn’t poor.
’Good, this will do.’ Vritra smiled, slowly the Misty Essence Flame began to surround the whole room.
It was a top-grade treasure that could make even a god hallucinate, so what was this fat, weak woman who had no countermeasures for it?
"Hurry up and tell me!" The queen’s voice got a bit louder as Vritra just stood there silently, observing the treasures in a trance.
"Hmm but before that, why don’t you show me if you are worthy? Let me see what sort of pleasure you would be giving me."
Vritra said, as Misty Essence finally took control of the situation and the third participant of the play broke into the room.
Just as Raelion burst into the room, Vritra’s figure disappeared and the pair of mother and son fell into an illusion.
Finally getting Vritra’s permission, the queen went mad and like a crazy bitch in heat, she pulled him closer and smashed him onto the bed.
Then her heavy body fell onto the person she believed was Vritra.
On the other hand, Raelion, who had just burst into this room, found himself back in his own room with several beautiful demonesses waiting for him.
He scratched his head in confusion, feeling as if it was déjà vu, as if he had traveled a few hours back in time.
But throwing it away, he got ready to enjoy his time with all the demon women.
Several of them pulled him and smashed him onto the bed, and then all of them fell on top of him.
"So wild today, haha I love it." Raelion spoke, trying to hug the big lump of fat on top of him but it was just impossible.
His clothes were torn, and then began the bone-breaking act, as the fat queen’s body began to bounce over her simp son, squeezing the literal life out of him.
Vritra glanced back, seeing that both were drowned in pleasure; he didn’t disturb them.
"Wifey, you are awesome, and now everyone is watching this sight outside the castle." Psyche had used a special glyph to project the scenes from inside the room into the sky.
Maeve was unaware of the things happening inside, but all the other demons were watching the shocking and taboo scene, many even began to vomit at the sight.
"Anyway, let’s start our heist." Vritra wasted no time as he turned and began to empty one treasury after another.
He had obtained so many life potions, it would definitely increase Yasmine’s strength by a lot.
Potions, gold, and whatever was there were stolen by him. In a bit over a minute, he had emptied all the treasuries.
But unfortunately, he couldn’t find Maeve’s life flame inside any of them.
"Since it is not here, do you think the queen might be hiding more treasuries, or maybe she has kept it closer after all?"
He wondered, and there was just one way to find it out, which was also the next phase of Vritra’s plan.
The fat queen had gathered a vast amount of demonic energy; she had been accumulating it over so many years, and demonic energy would be a great gain to Vritra.
It would strengthen his Evil Veyll God Essence Core, directly increasing his strength.
Making up his mind, he walked behind the large fat ball and took out a knife.
The effect of the Misty Essence was so terrifying that the pair of mother and son wouldn’t even notice any pain or passage of time.
"It will work, right?" Vritra asked, slowly bringing the tip of the knife closer to her back.
"Yes, certainly. Just make sure to guide the energy properly and keep the two busy as long as possible," Yasmine said, chuckling at the show.
"..." Vritra looked at Raelion and the queen, and the two were fucking like rabbits; they wouldn’t be stopping at least for the next five or so minutes.
He pushed the knife into the queen’s flesh, burying half of it, then Yasmine flew out and took on her human form.
Using her strength, she began to manipulate the blood, slowly breaking it down back into its original form—the demonic energy.
After which she pushed the energy into Vritra’s body, who focused solely on redirecting the large energy into the Essence Core.
Although the energy wasn’t as pure as his own, the amount was huge.
He felt so much demonic energy rushing into his body as the Essence Core happily absorbed it all.
It was like a dam had been opened. Yasmine struggled a bit at first, but Vritra took out some life potions which helped her replenish her energy faster.
Thus began the double cycle.
The queen was still absorbing the life force and demonic energy of her son; since she had gone mad, she wasn’t really holding back.
While Vritra was constantly absorbing vast amounts of energy, it was such an unexpected gain. If not for Yasmine, he would never have thought of it.
The dragon waifu frowned and asked, "Hubby, can you handle more energy? We need to hurry up."
Vritra gritted his teeth and pushed himself to his limits as he nodded. This amount of energy could easily explode the bodies of several generals.
And the queen was only using it as fat in her body; it was all to please the Demon Lord Sloth so she could marry him and offer herself.
Yasmine increased the amount by several times, and Vritra’s entire body got swallowed by the demonic energy as it rushed into him.
If not for his physique, he would have already exploded. The two hearts in his body thumped wildly, absorbing energy at a crazy rate as purple veins bulged all over his body.
He even used the Null ability to slow down time for the pair of mother and son while increasing the absorption rate further.
His strength was increasing at a terrifying rate.

chapters.title: Chapter 431: Murder in the kingdom
paragraphs: The three generals were seated outside on a round stone bench, still shocked at the fact that their lord and his daughter were in a relation.
Maeve didn’t seem to know the truth but the lord was definitely aware that it was his daughter, then why would he?
Thaddeus, Morvik and Silquor were still depressed over that matter when suddenly, clouds covered the entire sky.
In the next moment, a clear image of the queen’s bedroom appeared over the clouds.
Everyone was aware of how big of a slut the queen has become but the thing they saw now baffled them all.
"I- Is that Young lord Raelion? H- He is with... with his mother? What the hell is going on? What sort of family love is this?" the three generals almost went mad upon seeing that.
Even though Raelion’s body was buried under that large fat body but there was a small painful smile on his face, as if he was still enjoying it.
"Oh lord, what has become of this land? So these two were in that relation?" Silquor’s back straightened, as he fell back in shock.
Every demon present inside the Voromir kingdom was watching the whole act, of course Vritra wasn’t visible in it.
"But why are they displaying it all over the kingdom?" Morvik questioned.
"Sigh you don’t know, some people has some special kink, this one is called exhibitionism.
This is low even for us demons." Thaddeus spoke, shaking his bull like face.
Back inside the room, while the mother son pair were busy, Vritra continued to absorb the large demonic energy.
Yasmine was working hard to convert it, as the queen’s body slowly began to become thinner.
Under the influence of misty essence and null, the pair didn’t notice a thing as both of them had even their life energy sucked.
"Wifey, stop whenever it get huff too much... for you." Vritra said with difficulty, the Essence core in his body was rapidly expanding and growing.
"Don’t worry hubby, with all these... soul potions, I am fine." Yasmine replied.
As minutes ticked by, the size of the queen’s body reduced at a visible rate.
Within just 2-3 minutes, her body had reduced by more than half, yet they hadn’t noticed anything.
The whole process continued to be carried out and in a short period of time, the queen’s weight had been reduced to less than fifty from a few tons.
Nearly all the demonic energy from her body had been taken away, that she had spent so many years to gather.
Finally, Yasmine stopped as she returned to Vritra’s body, feeling exhausted. After this she would just focus on resting and absorbing soul potion for a while.
Vritra took several long breaths, the soul essence was happily devouring every bit of the demonic energy.
Then he stopped Null and misty essence, ready to get the main show started.
Raelion who had been having the time of his life with so many beautiful women, releasing his essence non stop, gradually felt the weight decrease.
In the end, when he opened his eyes, his body froze in shock; his eyes almost popping out at the sight in front of him.
Sitting on top of him was a woman he could still recognize, it was his mother after all, though unbelievably thinner.
The queen also felt that something was wrong, her body felt so lighter, as if she was in heaven.

’Is this how it feels to have a handsome demon? Sigh I feel so light, but I didn’t accidentally kill him right?’ the queen thought with worry and finally opened her eyes, then she froze in terror as well.
"R- R- Raelion?!! Wha- What are you doing here?!!" the queen’s body shivered, the handsome demon was nowhere in sight and she was actually on top of her son.
Then she noticed her own body, so thin, only skins and bones.
"!!!" both of them were completely baffled, unable to speak a word at everything that has happened suddenly, their world has turned upside down.
"Whoaaa! Would you look at that? Raelion, you truly love your mother huh, but how did you manage to reduce her size so much?" suddenly Vritra’s voice sounded from behind them.
The pair was feeling quite tired, especially the queen, she felt like a deflated balloon.
"Y- You demonic bastard, so it was your doing!!" Raelion cursed, something in his mind broke, he couldn’t accept reality.
How could he be with his slut of a mother, disgust crept into him and he vomited, only for the liquid to fell over his own face.
The queen finally returned to her senses and got even more shocked to see her size reduced so much.
She had worked hard for years, fucking hundreds of men every day and sucking them dry literally.
And now it was all gone because of her own son? She went mad, screaming like a maniac she clutched Raelion’s throat and tried to kill him.
"You u- ungrateful brat, huff huff I am going to k- kill you!" she screamed, and tried to strangle Raelion despite being so weak.
On the other hand, Raelion only became angrier and in his rage he slapped his mother.
BANG
Her weak body instantly exploded, throwing pieces of meat and bones all over the place.
Though it was only her upper body that had exploded while her lower body remained positioned over her son.
Vritra even sensed that somewhere in that bloody mess were several life flames and one felt really familiar so he suddenly teleported and picked a tiny bead which contained Maeve’s life flame.
[You life pact has been broken.]
Suddenly a message popped in front of Vritra, and he could feel that the blood pact maeve had formed with him has been broken.
In the moment, Maeve burst into the room, she had sensed the loud explosion just now but instantly she was frozen in shock.
First she glanced at the bed, where Raelion was lying back with only the lower half of a woman’s body on top of him and Vritra was standing not far away from the bed.
He looked completely clean, unlike the rest of the room.
Without anyone noticing, Psyche devoured the soul of the queen that was trying to escape, and so the Queen has been successfully killed.
Outside, everyone saw that it was Raelion who had killed the queen right after the sex, of course not before devouring all her energy.
"H- He killed his own mother..." the demons were all just as shocked, even though demons did not trust one another, but it was different for Raelion and the queen.
They all have to trust them, and now the queen was killed.
Raelion was immensely shocked himself, he couldn’t understand anything until a few moment had been passed.
"I- I killed her?" but then seeing her lower body, he jumped away from the bed, throwing his mother off and wearing his clothes.
"It’s all because of you, you killed her. You planned all of this, y- you bastard, you even made me sleep with that... that disgusting thing. I am going to tear you apart!"
Raelion was even more enraged than the time when he saw the love bite on Yennefer’s neck.
He simply went mad at all the absurd things that had just taken place.
Vritra stored away the life flame bead then he looked at Maeve with a questioning gaze but this was not the time, so grabbing her arm he flew out.
"Haha what a loser, did you like the taste of that big fat body of your mother?
Just imagine, how many diseases you might have caught, how many people have been there before you, how disgusting..." he didn’t forget to pass a comment before rushing outside.
"Aaaaaaaaah You are going to dieeeeee!" Raelion screamed, he tore his own cheeks in madness, eyes turning blood red.
"What’s going on?" Maeve asked, she couldn’t understand anything.
"Wait for me, I will explain it all to you soon."
After saying he teleported Maeve into his dimensional book. The whole play was yet to end, there was still some more he needed to do.
As the two flew out into the open sky, Raelion who was charging forward like a mad bull, froze once again in shock.
He looked up at the sky and couldn’t believe his eyes.
Just now thousands of demons have seen the whole act, from him fucking his mother, then absorbing all her demonic energy and in the end, killing her viciously.
The same video was repeating again and again in the sky.
"W- What? This... You scheming bastard, what have I ever done to you? Why did you do this to me?" Raelion truly broke at this moment, going absolutely crazy.
"Hmm Well nothing personal, but you seemed to have bullied my woman a lot, its just a small payback.
Oh right, I heard you love Yennefer, haha have you heard she broke her engagement with the emperor? That’s only because of me, you see she is also one of my women." Vritra said.
"UWAAAAAAAH!!" like a beast, Raelion let out a deafening roar, rushing towards Vritra to kill him, all these blows were too much for him.
’There is still some time before the scheduled time, let’s keep him busy here for a while.’
Vritra thought and just used misty essence to make Raelion fly in circles all over the realm.
He landed on the ground and brought Maeve out, and before she could speak, he asked:
"So you removed that pact huh? Why now of all times?"

chapters.title: Chapter 435: Run away?
paragraphs: {Sin Points Gained: Cheered +3}
A message flashed in front of Vritra. Upon glancing down, he saw the three demon generals cheering for him.
Ignoring them, he stopped in front of the confused Raelion.
The poor demon lord had been fighting against Vritra the whole night but only now found out that he was stuck in an illusion all along.
"Yo, how are you doing, Raelion?"
Vritra smiled and asked, before adding, "I see you are quite energetic this early in the morning. You really must have loved your time with your mother yesterday."
"What’s happening? Who even are you? Aaaaaaaaah! I am going crazy!!" Raelion pulled a handful of his hair as he let out a wild scream.
He was so happy just the previous night, but all of a sudden everything had turned into a mess.
The memory of doing it with his slutty mother made Raelion shiver with disgust.
And Vritra kept giving him one psychological blow after another; his mind was completely cooked by now.
The whole night he had to go through all that again and again — sleeping with his mother and then getting beaten by Vritra.
"Don’t run, fight me!" Raelion shouted, energy dangerously swirling around him.
Vritra let out a chuckle, his voice full of ridicule. "Run away? Who is running? Run where?"
[Switch Activated.]
[Switch: Demonification (70%)]
The entirety of the realm was instantly swallowed by a purple energy.
The houses cracked under the pressure; all the demons were pushed against the ground until they were prostrating.
Even Raelion’s body was thrown back.
This energy was extremely destructive and domineering — they all felt as if they were being choked.
The three generals were especially shocked; just the energy was way stronger than what they remembered of their lord.
Raelion stabilized his body. Although he was surprised, he was completely consumed with madness.
The only thought that revolved in his mind was to kill Vritra — no matter the cost, and in the most painful way possible.
Vritra wanted to check out his strength a bit before heading back.
With all the demonic energy he had absorbed from the queen’s body, his strength had certainly grown overall.
Raelion’s body flashed, moving at his fastest speed as the demon appeared before Vritra in less than a second, then tried to grab his neck.
’Not bad, I can actually keep track of his movements. Sigh, Foxie took too much time waking up. If I wasn’t getting late, then I would have humored him a bit.’
Vritra thought as he teleported exactly behind Raelion and grabbed his neck before dragging him away.
"L-Lord subdued him so easily! He has recovered all his strength," Morvik shouted in joy. They were really happy that they no longer had to listen to Raelion.
Vritra pushed himself to his limits and moved incredibly fast, even using all his skills to subdue the demon in his grasp for a few seconds.
Darius had received a message from Vritra through General Sirius’s hands, who couldn’t get tired of praising him.
And the content of the message was about none other than Raelion.
He was doubtful at first that the weak Daddy V could actually capture a demon lord.
But the next day he still went to check. High in the sky, some distance away from the Cloud City, he paused in the air and waited.
"Emperor, we found that the Emp— cough, Yennefer Aven has been spotted inside the Cloud City," Han Gratt reported. He seemed rather happy that the two had broken up.
"I see. Soon I will present her with the demon lord Raelion and ask what mistake I have made. Sigh, I need her back no matter what," the emperor said in a firm tone.
"How long are we going to wait?" one of the protectors asked. Among the king’s three protectors, he was the most arrogant and secretive.

"Uh... I don’t think he would lie to me and the emperor. If Daddy— uh, Sir V from Golden Moon said so, then I am sure it will happen," Sirius spoke. For some reason, he had built blind trust in Vritra.
"..." Darius waited patiently, and just a couple of minutes later, they actually heard a beast-like voice.
As if some unknown creature was letting out mad screams. And not long after, Raelion actually appeared in front of them.
His eyes were red and veins popping all over his body; it appeared as if he was running behind someone.
Seeing the several men, he looked at them and then turned casually to continue looking for Vritra, acting as if nothing was wrong.
"Uh..." Sirius cleared his throat.
All the others just looked at the demon and didn’t react; the whole act seemed so casual, as if someone had lost their way and they were just watching him leave.
"What are you doing? Catch him!" Vritra’s voice suddenly sounded from the midst of the group, bringing them to their senses.
"Oh, stop!" Darius finally made a move. He poured a large amount of energy into the trap he had prepared in advance.
And Raelion came to his senses and realized that he was trapped. Even though he wanted to kill Vritra, saving his life was still the priority.
He could always get a second chance at killing him, though all the things that Vritra had done to him still made him mad.
’I need to get out of here first. Damnit, I will be beaten like a dog again,’ he thought before deploying his special technique that he always used to escape in the most desperate times.
’Forbid: a body divided in particles will turn into a strong magnet and could never separate.’
[Forbidden activated.]
Vritra hadn’t just used the Misty Essence to waste time; he also used it to see various of Raelion’s tricks and abilities.
"I will kill you all later! Don’t think just you bunch will be enough to catch me, hmph!" he harrumphed and used his ability as his body began to disintegrate.
Han and the other protector attacked him instantly to disrupt the ability, but even as their punches landed, they could do nothing.
"Hahahaha! Why waste my time with such pitiful attacks? There is no way any of you— huh?" But just as his body broke into particles, it was pulled back with a strong force.
His body instantly returned to normal. He tried the same skill again, and it didn’t work.
"W-What have you done?" he looked around at the several men and, for the first time, felt afraid for his life. But killing a demon lord wasn’t so easy — he had gathered a lot of ways to escape.
But each time he tried anything, Vritra or someone else already had a way to counter it.
In the end, as several minutes passed, Raelion’s body was shaking as cold sweat dripped down his face.
"Emperor, as you promised, please beat him up a bit.
First, I need him as a subject in my show to attract more audience, then you could do as you wish with him," Vritra spoke, back in his burly man disguise.
"..." Darius glanced back before fixing his gaze on Raelion, making the demon lord cower in terror.
"T-This whole thing is a misunderstanding! I am being framed! I don’t even want Yennefer! I-I can help—" Raelion began to try any way to survive the situation.

Nearly all the people were very sad, but they waited in hope, praying for the game to start as soon as possible.
Onest, Shitless, Xi, and the others calmed down the people, but even they didn’t know exactly when Vritra would arrive.
BANG
Something fell at the center of the arena all of a sudden, startling the crowd, but the center of the arena was covered with dust, so no one could see it.
"Sorry participants for making you all wait all this while." Just then, the familiar voice of their host sounded, and a wave of happiness spread across the crowd.
Some even began to cry.

Instantly, lots of messages flashed in front of Vritra, the speed of messages refreshing was extremely fast.
He got a bit late just for this reason, all these people really loved him, their happiness was truly contagious.
"Yes yes, the game will be continuing and it will be even grander than any of the previous ones." Vritra said, his voice exciting the crowd even more.

"We have a really special guest with us today, someone who had terrorized the people of this continent for a long time, someone really dangerous who had always managed to escape and no one could catch him."
Vritra increased the hype as people began to guess.
"Our newest subject is..." after a dramatic pause he added:
"None. Other. Than RAELION ZUKE!!"
For a few seconds, there was complete silence as the dust cleared and Raelion’s true demonic form came into everyone’s view.
The people were just shocked, then loud screams filled the arena, almost making it seem like an earthquake.
Raelion had caused quite a lot of trouble across the continent in the past, they all knew about him and hated him, yet not even the emperor could catch him.
But now, this man had done it.
"Daddy, you are God, a God I say!!"
"A- A demon lord?!! W- We will be punishing a True Demon Lord?!!"
"I- Is it really Raelion? Whoa, it’s the first time I am seeing a lord so closely, kekeke I am going to kill him."
"Daddy- uh Sir V, please marry my daughter."
All the people were saying different things, Vritra even felt that General Sirius had also said something at the end, but he couldn’t hear it clearly.
"Yes, this is the real demon lord Raelion, and today you all will be able to beat the shit out of him." Vritra said, then several glyphs floated in front of him.

"There is one additional change. These new glyphs will be added: Ball Bursting Glyph, Eyes Popping Glyph, Spine Twisting Glyph, Ass Flower Glyph, and if you could hit Raelion with any of them, then you will have hit the jackpot."
Just as Vritra announced, another wave of cheers sounded, and lots of sin points flooded in.
Then began the process of selling the glyphs and betting, and for that, Maeve’s team was doing a great job.
Vritra brought out all the other subjects and Maeve, who decided to watch the show and took a seat among the crowd.
"Ughh..." Raelion was drifting in and out of consciousness, but he had heard whatever Vritra had said. Gathering some strength, he was finally able to get to his feet.
"L- Let me out of here, I am going to cough kill you all!" Raelion threatened, but it only made the crowd more enraged, as they all got ready with the new glyphs.
"Alright participants, let’s start the game!" With a snap, the seats got covered by darkness, and all the traps and other dust soldiers appeared in the fighting area.
MUOOOOOOO!!
Bullo appeared and set his target on Ziggy and Raelion, the two demons were extremely terrified, they were completely powerless.
And in the next moment, the chaos began.
Raelion jumped in fright and barely dodged a glyph that flew between his legs. But hiding behind him, the fat Ziggy wasn’t as lucky as the glyph struck his crotch.
Vritra was just floating there and getting thousands of sin points with barely any participation, but then he sensed someone flying closer.
Before he could even think properly, the figure of a woman appeared before him, her long blue hair fluttering in the air.

"I- I can tell you the way back into the Voromir realm, I can help you find my sister, I c- can do anything just let me leave.
I can even help you find Yennefer!
I have never tried to harm you-"

Ughhh aren’t you the righteous one?
Cough STOP!

chapters.title: Chapter 437: Clingy Like a Glue
paragraphs: Yennefer flew towards the arena after finding that the game had started.
Knowing Vritra, she had a feeling that he was certainly somehow involved in this.
Within moments she arrived close to the arena, and despite the mist outside, she could clearly see everyone present inside.
But even after scanning it twice, she didn’t find Vritra anywhere. Then her gaze locked onto the burly man floating in the air.
He didn’t look anything like Vritra, nor could she sense any sort of familiarity, but for some reason, she felt that it was him.
"H- Husband?" she called out softly, her heart pounding in anticipation. She had wanted to see him so badly.
But what if he wasn’t actually Vritra? What if he was but pretended? Yennefer didn’t have answers for any of that.
She wanted to forget everything and just embrace him, disappear from the world if she had to, and make him her entire world.
Just like how Yennefer’s emotions were boiling over, Vritra’s emotions were in chaos, quite similar to the subjects’ condition down in the arena.
"Hubby, are you okay?" Yasmine asked in worry, aware of how down Vritra had been after their breakup.
’Yeah, I am fine,’ Vritra replied, taking a long breath. Then he fixed his firm gaze onto Yennefer.
He had the choice to either pretend and run away from the situation, but that was just pointless.
"I am not your husband, and what do you want now?" Vritra questioned, his gaze and tone emotionless.
They got covered by a barrier, stopping anyone from seeing the two as Vritra returned to his original appearance, of course except the horns.
Yennefer’s eyes widened.
How badly had she wanted to see him all this time? She couldn’t stop herself from rushing in his direction and giving him a tight hug.
But right before she could touch him, Vritra teleported away, a frown appearing on his face. It was hard for him to maintain the tough appearance; he too had missed her a lot.
"What is it?" he questioned, maintaining a safe distance, stopping her fragrance from reaching him.
It just might get him drunk over her.
"..." Yennefer clenched her fists as she turned. Knowing how stubborn Vritra was, she knew getting back into his life wouldn’t be an easy task.
But no matter what it takes, she was going to fit herself into his life and in his heart.
"Husband, I understand that I made a mistake, and I was stupid not to pay attention to your words before. Please just forgive me this once. I even ended that fake engagement—"
Yennefer didn’t know how to make him happy again, but she had to start somehow.
But Vritra remembered the pain he had felt when seeing her with Darius. He couldn’t bring himself to just forgive her.
"There is no need for further explanations. We are already over. You should continue with your life—hunt demons, marry the emperor, don’t let me limit you.
After all, I am the very thing that you hate the most," Vritra said. Then he calmed himself and added, "You should just leave."
"No." Yennefer once again tried to get close to him, but Vritra teleported away again.
"You have to forgive me, Husband. If you want, I can even stop killing demons. I left everything behind. I need and want only you.
Please, I don’t want a life where you aren’t with me," Yennefer spoke, desperation evident in her voice.
For the third time, she made her move, flashing before Vritra.
But just like before, he disappeared—except this time, Yennefer’s figure disappeared along with him.
She appeared right in front of the space where Vritra had teleported, taking him by surprise.
"Heh, I have Null ability too." Without giving him a chance, Yennefer wrapped her arms around him, pressing her body against him really, really tightly.
"Please, just tell me what you want, I— I..." Yennefer said. She felt every cell in her body fill with joy as she got to embrace her love again.
She took a deep breath, inhaling his scent that she missed so much, feeling his warmth, his muscles.
"Stop it. This relation just isn’t possible. You know there are already other women in my life, and there are things you don’t know.
It would be better for both of us to end it this early." Vritra tried to get free, but he couldn’t. Her scent flooded into his senses, her softness enveloping him completely.
"I will make it possible. Now nothing can be a barrier to our love.
No matter what, I don’t want to be apart from you," Yennefer spoke, hugging him even tighter.
Vritra was helpless and torn. He too wanted to be with her just as badly, but there were many things to consider now. Things might never be as they were before.
No matter what he said, Yennefer just wouldn’t stop or separate from him.
"Sigh, fine. I will think about it." After a long conversation, Vritra had no choice but to give in, though not completely.
"..." Yennefer remained silent, just loving the feeling of his embrace.
This was the place she had accidentally thrown away and what she longed for, and even if it cost Yennefer her life, she would never give up.
After a few more minutes had passed, Yennefer reluctantly let go, but she held the corner of his sleeve and muttered in a low voice, "Until you have accepted me, I am going to follow you around."

"Sigh..." Vritra looked at the gorgeous woman. Her fiery gaze stirred deep emotions within him. It was extremely difficult to keep his gaze away from her—from the juicy red lips, her crystal-like blue eyes, her voluptuous figure.
Shaking his head, Vritra turned around. After all, he still needed to collect sin points.
"..." He said nothing further to her and removed the barrier. For both their sakes, Yennefer changed her appearance as well.
But just in case, Vritra used Misty Essence so that no one could see her for now.
As he appeared back in the sky in his disguised form, sin points continued to flow.
Yennefer stood exactly behind him, her eyes set on him and him only, as she held onto the corner of his clothes so he could not disappear from her life once again.

The game continued on; the number of people had crossed the previous records. Vritra would show his presence every once in a while, but within the crowd, Maeve noticed that there was a change in his behavior.
She decided to go and check on him later while continuing to help manage the game.
Raelion proved to be an excellent subject, especially with all the new glyphs.
People were really enthusiastic to burst the balls of a demon lord—most of them had purchased the ball-bursting glyphs.
Several hours passed quickly, and it was already evening as the game came to an end for the day.
The audience left happily, and one of them had finally managed to burst one of Raelion’s balls and won a jackpot.
The game was a massive hit.
{Sin Point Gained: Thanked 185,234}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered 179,095}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised 184,697}
Vritra watched the whole audience leave as he put away all the remaining subjects. Of course, Raelion and Ziggy had survived yet another day.
And Yennefer stuck to Vritra all the time like the most powerful glue.

chapters.title: Chapter 438: Professional Love Coach
paragraphs: The long game finally ended. Vritra stood in the center of the arena as he stored away all the subjects in his dimensional book.
"Pitiful one, haa I am tired so I will be leaving now."
Monk Shitless yawned as he lay sprawled over Bullo’s back. Today was a really hectic day.
All the people kept calling him to buy the new glyphs; they were all in special demand.
"Huff, that was fun, but I still wonder why we are doing this..." Onest mumbled, but since he was following Vritra, he didn’t really mind.
They couldn’t see the beautiful lady standing right beside Vritra, holding onto the hem of his sleeve.
With one of his eyes closed, Shitless raised his head and looked at Vritra before lazily muttering, "Make sure to use the ’Time’ properly."
"Huh, what?" Vritra questioned. He no longer took all of Shitless’s words as nonsense; every once in a while, the evil monk would warn him of danger.
"That’s all, haa anyway I am leaving." Patting Bullo’s back, they left the arena.
Onest also left together with Shitless. Xi and the other demons also took their leave. Now only three people remained in the arena.
’Sigh, what should I do to get his forgiveness now?’ Yennefer thought. This really seemed like an impossible task.
Maeve landed before Vritra and asked, "Master, is something wrong?"
"???" Yennefer finally saw the demoness, but since she was disguised too, she didn’t recognize her.
’D- Did another woman enter his life while I was away?’ Her grip on his clothes tightened, an uncomfortable feeling settling over her heart.
Sensing that everyone had left the place, Vritra finally removed the disguise of the misty essence as he appeared in his real appearance, and Yennefer also became visible.
"Huh? Who is she?" Maeve asked, wondering if this was someone from his family.
Yennefer stared at Maeve with an intense gaze, trying to see through her disguise, but she failed. She appeared in her real form.
"Empress?!" Maeve was quite shocked as her gaze moved between the two.
He had only told her about three women, and Yennefer was certainly not one of them.
"Sigh, let’s leave. We will talk back at the hotel," Vritra said as they flew away, Yennefer still sticking close to him.
It wasn’t long before they were back in the hotel room.
Vritra sat on a sofa chair with Yennefer beside him, and Maeve sat in front of them.
"We are no longer in a relation. We broke a few days earlier," Vritra said with a frown, his words still making Yennefer regret her choices.
"..." Maeve stayed silent for a few seconds, then something clicked in her mind. "Ah, so it was all because of her."
No wonder her master was so sad and seemed to have changed greatly—barely talking and even stopping calling her Foxie. It was all because of this ex-empress.
"So what do you want now?" Maeve questioned, her gaze turning unfriendly.

She didn’t oppose Vritra having other women in his life, but she hated the person who hurt him so much. Judging from Yennefer’s reaction, it was certainly her fault, and she seemed to be regretting it.
"That has nothing to do with you," Yennefer said. Internally, she was seething with jealousy.
It was like some other woman had taken her place, as if this woman had taken advantage of her momentary weakness to steal what should have been hers.
"He is my master, and I am his woman, so it has everything to do with me. And I don’t want you hurting my master again, so why don’t you leave and play house-house with that Darius?"
Maeve said, getting up and settling on Vritra’s right, hugging his arm possessively before sticking out her tongue towards Yennefer.
"You—who even are you? You don’t even know anything about us! We are already husband and wife, so you should leave!"
Yennefer said, clinging to Vritra as if her life depended on it.
"M-Master, are you?" Maeve turned to Vritra instantly.
"We are not!" Vritra said firmly.
"Heh, you heard that. Now why don’t you leave us alone? You see, master is teaching me something very personal and intimate~"
Maeve said in a coy tone, shyly pushing her face against his arm.
"Tch, back in the abandoned city, we have already done it so many times that you still can’t count that high—"
Yennefer retorted, but Vritra interrupted the fight.
As entertaining as their clash was, Vritra really wasn’t in the mood to hear more of it. He wasn’t even sure if Yennefer’s return was a good thing or not.
"Enough. I need rest, just stop it," he said and got up before moving towards the bed and lying back, closing his eyes to relax his mind.
"..." Maeve glanced at Vritra, then at Yennefer, who had already gotten up and was heading towards the bed.
The cunning fox knew if fighting doesn’t work, then she needed to get emotional, after all, she had little knowledge about the other party.
And what if the two were very close before? Then wouldn’t she be the losing one? She hadn’t even gone all the way with her master.
’Less challenge is always better, especially since she is someone who hurt master,’ Maeve thought as she got up and spoke, "Can we talk?"
Yennefer, who was about to climb onto the bed, paused and looked back. After a moment, she nodded, and both moved out of the room to not disturb Vritra.
After getting out, several layers of barriers covered them.
"What do you want to say now?" Yennefer questioned, ready for another round of fight. She was sure she could defeat the other woman.
"Oh god, I can’t believe I am right in front of the empress—I mean, ex-empress. Anyway, I have always seen you as my role model, my ideal.
Please don’t mind my words earlier, I only said those words so master doesn’t throw you out in his anger," Maeve said in an enthusiastic tone, shocking Yennefer greatly at the sudden change.
"Uh... Alright." Although Maeve could be cunning, Yennefer wasn’t stupid either, so she didn’t really trust her at all.
"Sigh, actually, after you two broke up, master got very, very sad. It was like his complete personality had changed. He got so silent, he even stopped eating or doing anything.
He would just keep staring, looking so broken. Getting away from you had hurt him a lot," Maeve said, exaggerating the facts a bit in a dramatic tone.
"..." Yennefer fell silent, her expression becoming dull. She was fully aware of how much she had hurt him. Her words directly pierced through her heart, making her feel even more pain.
"It was only recently that master had started to get a bit better, but if you suddenly make an entry in his life, of course, it is going to ruin everything.
This is not the correct way to get his forgiveness," Maeve continued in a sympathetic tone.
"Hmm, then what do you suggest?" Yennefer asked in a low voice, looking seriously invested in her words.
"Sigh, just keep following my advice and I will help you get back with master, believe me," Maeve said as an innocent smile spread across her face.
’Yeah yeah, sure.’ Yennefer rolled her eyes but played along.

sentences.text: The long game finally ended.
Vritra stood in the center of the arena as he stored away all the subjects in his dimensional book.
"Pitiful one, haa I am tired so I will be leaving now."
Monk Shitless yawned as he lay sprawled over Bullo’s back.
Today was a really hectic day.
All the people kept calling him to buy the new glyphs; they were all in special demand.
"Huff, that was fun, but I still wonder why we are doing this..." Onest mumbled, but since he was following Vritra, he didn’t really mind.
They couldn’t see the beautiful lady standing right beside Vritra, holding onto the hem of his sleeve.
With one of his eyes closed, Shitless raised his head and looked at Vritra before lazily muttering, "Make sure to use the ’Time’ properly."
"Huh, what?" Vritra questioned.
He no longer took all of Shitless’s words as nonsense; every once in a while, the evil monk would warn him of danger.
"That’s all, haa anyway I am leaving." Patting Bullo’s back, they left the arena.
Onest also left together with Shitless.
Xi and the other demons also took their leave.
Now only three people remained in the arena.
’Sigh, what should I do to get his forgiveness now?’ Yennefer thought.
This really seemed like an impossible task.
Maeve landed before Vritra and asked, "Master, is something wrong?"
"???" Yennefer finally saw the demoness, but since she was disguised too, she didn’t recognize her.
’D- Did another woman enter his life while I was away?’ Her grip on his clothes tightened, an uncomfortable feeling settling over her heart.
Sensing that everyone had left the place, Vritra finally removed the disguise of the misty essence as he appeared in his real appearance, and Yennefer also became visible.
"Huh?
Who is she?" Maeve asked, wondering if this was someone from his family.
Yennefer stared at Maeve with an intense gaze, trying to see through her disguise, but she failed.
She appeared in her real form.
"Empress?!" Maeve was quite shocked as her gaze moved between the two.
He had only told her about three women, and Yennefer was certainly not one of them.
"Sigh, let’s leave.
We will talk back at the hotel," Vritra said as they flew away, Yennefer still sticking close to him.
It wasn’t long before they were back in the hotel room.
Vritra sat on a sofa chair with Yennefer beside him, and Maeve sat in front of them.
"We are no longer in a relation.
We broke a few days earlier," Vritra said with a frown, his words still making Yennefer regret her choices.
"..." Maeve stayed silent for a few seconds, then something clicked in her mind.
"Ah, so it was all because of her."
No wonder her master was so sad and seemed to have changed greatly—barely talking and even stopping calling her Foxie.
It was all because of this ex-empress.
"So what do you want now?" Maeve questioned, her gaze turning unfriendly.
She didn’t oppose Vritra having other women in his life, but she hated the person who hurt him so much.
Judging from Yennefer’s reaction, it was certainly her fault, and she seemed to be regretting it.
"That has nothing to do with you," Yennefer said.
Internally, she was seething with jealousy.
It was like some other woman had taken her place, as if this woman had taken advantage of her momentary weakness to steal what should have been hers.
"He is my master, and I am his woman, so it has everything to do with me.
And I don’t want you hurting my master again, so why don’t you leave and play house-house with that Darius?"
Maeve said, getting up and settling on Vritra’s right, hugging his arm possessively before sticking out her tongue towards Yennefer.
"You—who even are you?
You don’t even know anything about us!
We are already husband and wife, so you should leave!"
Yennefer said, clinging to Vritra as if her life depended on it.
"M-Master, are you?" Maeve turned to Vritra instantly.
"We are not!" Vritra said firmly.
"Heh, you heard that.
Now why don’t you leave us alone?
You see, master is teaching me something very personal and intimate~"
Maeve said in a coy tone, shyly pushing her face against his arm.
"Tch, back in the abandoned city, we have already done it so many times that you still can’t count that high—"
Yennefer retorted, but Vritra interrupted the fight.
As entertaining as their clash was, Vritra really wasn’t in the mood to hear more of it.
He wasn’t even sure if Yennefer’s return was a good thing or not.
"Enough.
I need rest, just stop it," he said and got up before moving towards the bed and lying back, closing his eyes to relax his mind.
"..." Maeve glanced at Vritra, then at Yennefer, who had already gotten up and was heading towards the bed.
The cunning fox knew if fighting doesn’t work, then she needed to get emotional, after all, she had little knowledge about the other party.
And what if the two were very close before?
Then wouldn’t she be the losing one?
She hadn’t even gone all the way with her master.
’Less challenge is always better, especially since she is someone who hurt master,’ Maeve thought as she got up and spoke, "Can we talk?"
Yennefer, who was about to climb onto the bed, paused and looked back.
After a moment, she nodded, and both moved out of the room to not disturb Vritra.
After getting out, several layers of barriers covered them.
"What do you want to say now?" Yennefer questioned, ready for another round of fight.
She was sure she could defeat the other woman.

This is not the correct way to get his forgiveness," Maeve continued in a sympathetic tone.
"Hmm, then what do you suggest?" Yennefer asked in a low voice, looking seriously invested in her words.
"Sigh, just keep following my advice and I will help you get back with master, believe me," Maeve said as an innocent smile spread across her face.
’Yeah yeah, sure.’ Yennefer rolled her eyes but played along.

chapters.title: Chapter 439: The Secrets
paragraphs: "Alright, so for starters, you should stay away from master. If you do that, he will start missing you and will accept your apology, then it will be really easy for you to get back with him.
Meanwhile, I will also do my best to beg for his forgiveness for your sake." Maeve said, giving a short friendly smile.
"Oh! I didn’t know you were so nice, then I will trust you. I will come visit you in the arena tomorrow." Yennefer said, before turning and flying away.
’That... was a lot easier than I expected, I didn’t think the ex-empress was this stupid.’ Maeve herself was surprised that such a simple trick worked.
But since it worked, so be it. She shrugged her shoulders and removed the barriers before turning back to go into the room.
’Sigh, seems like I won’t be able to get a lesson from master today, all because of her.
Only if she hadn’t visited.’ Maeve thought, though she was still happy to have Vritra all to herself.
"Masterrrr~" she opened the door and entered, but froze upon seeing Yennefer seated on the bed.
"Tsk, why are you still here?" she asked in a whispering tone, not wanting to interrupt Vritra, who was already asleep.
"You don’t need to know."
Yennefer said, before lying by Vritra’s side, hugging him intimately.
"..." Maeve glared at her for a few seconds, but Yennefer was also Vritra’s woman, though they might be in conflict now.
So she could only allow Yennefer to do as she wished for now, yet she still felt jealous.
She climbed onto the bed and laid on Vritra’s left, clinging to him even tighter, showing her closeness.
After a long staring contest and a silent fight over Vritra, the two of them finally fell asleep, both feeling extremely joyous to be sleeping with their man.
[D-Day 11]
As dawn broke, Vritra woke up, feeling refreshed.
The previous night he had fallen asleep while talking with Yasmine; he didn’t know what the two women had talked about.
"..." He opened his eyes and found himself in the familiar hotel room. Softness had completely covered him from both sides.
Glancing down, Vritra found the two women tightly entwined with him, their bodies coiled around him like serpents.
’Sigh, things can’t continue like this. I guess it is time to just tell her, then she can decide if she still has the same feelings for me.’
Vritra thought, as he tried getting out of their embrace.
And his movements woke the two up; they just yawned and hugged him tighter.
"Get up, we need to talk." Vritra finally gave up, since getting out of their arms was impossible without using force.
The two finally came to their senses; their eyes opened as they sat back, looking at Vritra with full concentration.
He sat up and took a long breath before settling his gaze onto Yennefer, who was nervously waiting for his next words.
She was ready to follow behind him for her entire life and wait for his forgiveness. Yennefer just didn’t want to imagine a life without him.
But she was still afraid of rejection; it was true that breaking things is easier, but making up was extremely difficult.
"Haa, there are a few things that you aren’t aware of yet, and before you make any further decisions, you should know them." Vritra began in a serious tone.
Maeve raised her defences; she could guess what secrets Vritra was about to share, and knowing Yennefer’s hatred for demons, she was afraid that they both might be attacked.
"You already know there are other women in my life. Aside from Maeve, there are four others." He added, shocking both women.
"F-Four? Shouldn’t there be only three others?" they both questioned at the same time.
"That is not important right now. You just need to focus on the point that I have other women in my life, so if you don’t like my relations, you can leave." Vritra said and paused.
"...I-I am fine with it." Yennefer bit her lip before muttering, though just the thought burned her heart with jealousy.
"Then, look at her." Vritra pointed towards Maeve and spoke. "She is a demon, the one you have been searching for, Maeve."
"H-Huh?" Yennefer’s brows shot up in surprise as she tried to digest his words.
Maeve nodded and appeared in her real demonic form, her tail swinging behind her back.
"And... I am a demon too."
As Vritra spoke, he stopped using Misty Essence, and horns appeared on his head along with a purplish demonic energy that was naturally present around him.
"W-What?!!" Yennefer’s eyes opened even wider, this shock thousands of times more impactful than the previous one.
For a moment she even wondered if Vritra only said it to push her away, that he just lied to her. But that energy, the seriousness—it definitely was no lie.
And his words once again rang in her head.
’I am the exact thing you hate the most. Such a relation just isn’t possible between us. When you end up slaughtering all the demons, I would no longer be there with you...’
And it finally clicked in her mind. Her expressions changed several times as she tried to register this news.
Just the word demon was enough to make her go mad; she hated them all to the core.
She was quite young when she had pledged to kill all demons, but now the person she loved the most was, in reality, a demon.
What a joke of fate this was. She remained silent, her thoughts becoming a mess.
She knew for sure that Vritra was someone who had been brought here from the real world—shouldn’t he be a human?
Didn’t he also possess the dragon’s bloodline already?
None of it was making sense.
"A-Are you really even Vritra? H-How did this happen?" she questioned, looking at him with complicated emotions.
"Yes, I am Vritra, brought to this chaotic world from Earth."
Vritra said but did not give any further explanations. If things were to truly end between them, then it was better to be completely clear.
He wanted to know how she would react to this news. He hadn’t told her this before because he was afraid of losing her, but this was just the perfect chance.
"So, do you want to kill me now? Erase the evil, start with the demon right in front of you." Vritra spoke, his tone emotionless as he spread his arms defenselessly.
He was wondering if she was going to attack and leave, or just leave.
"Uh..." Yennefer drank some water to calm herself.
This wasn’t really what she had expected. She knew there were many secrets of his that she wasn’t aware of yet, but this was really too shocking for her.
"Aren’t you Divine’s successor?" she questioned after a moment.
"Indeed I am. Well, we have some time before today’s game starts, so if you want to try to kill me, this is your chance."
Vritra urged her, though acting emotionless, he very much wanted to see her next actions.
This just might be the point where they truly go their separate ways.
Before Yennefer could have spoken anything, a message flashed before Vritra, surprising him.

chapters.title: Chapter 440: Her past
paragraphs: [Quest: Catch the Arthal Plague Rats.]
[Reward: Aurora of the Betrayed.]
Along with the short messages, a scroll appeared inside Vritra’s inventory. He decided to check it out later.
There was already one quest going on, though that was from the Sin System and just needed something very casual to be completed.
His death and a sacrifice — at least this one seemed better.
’I wonder what that treasure is, guess I will ask wifey about it later.’
For now, he shifted the matter of the quest to the back of his mind and focused on Yennefer, who looked like a lost puppy.
The air of confidence and supremacy that was always present around her seemed to have broken into a thousand pieces as she lost her composure.
Only a minute had passed, though it seemed like she had been silent for an hour. The choice was simple but still so hard.
"Can... Can you give me a minute?" Yennefer finally looked into Vritra’s blood-red eyes and asked.
"Well, that’s some progression. Unlike I expected, she didn’t attack you immediately, hubby."
Yasmine spoke; she just hoped whatever might be the outcome of this, her hubby doesn’t get upset.
"...Alright." Vritra shrugged, and instantly Yennefer vanished from there. She moved at her fastest speed, travelling hundreds of kilometres within moments.
"Sigh, was that an excuse?" Vritra wondered. Now he was confused if this should be considered an end or not.
"Uhm, master, that was some new way of breaking up. Did she go back to get divorce papers or something?" Maeve asked, scratching her cheek.
"We weren’t really married. Anyway, we should get ready for the day. Why don’t you go bathe first, I will... wait here for a little." Vritra said.
"Okay, no matter what, I am here with you, master~ so don’t get all sad again because of her." Maeve said, giving a gentle kiss on his lips before heading into the bathroom.
"Hubby, are you feeling okay?" Yasmine asked in concern. She appeared outside in her human form and embraced Vritra.
"Yeah, I am..." he replied, leaning onto her. Yasmine and Vanessa were definitely two of the people who made him feel most at ease.
They didn’t speak further and just stayed silent, but soon Yasmine sensed the approaching Yennefer and mumbled, "At least she didn’t just leave with that absurd excuse. Hubby, you can do it."
After speaking, Yasmine disappeared, and in the next moment, Yennefer appeared inside the room.
She was panting lightly after pushing herself to her limits. Vritra didn’t know what, but something seemed to have changed about her — or maybe it was the glint in her eyes.
"So what have you decided?" he asked, still in his emotionless tone.
"I..." Yennefer was about to speak but noticed the fox who was eavesdropping from the bathroom, so first she covered them with a barrier.
Then she moved closer to him and gracefully settled over his lap before taking something out of her inventory.
Without saying anything, she took his right hand as Vritra continued to stare at her in confusion. Then she put a bracelet around his wrist.
It seemed to be made of some shiny white material with a beautiful blue gem at the top.
After securely placing the bracelet, she took out another exactly same-looking bracelet and handed it to Vritra, speaking, "Husband, can you help me wear it?"
"What is the meaning of this?" he asked, not even picking the bracelet.
"Haa... these belonged to my parents. They wore it at the time of their marriage; it was a symbol of eternal bond between them."
Yennefer began to explain in a sad tone, gently caressing the bracelet on his wrist.
"When I was six, our family was in a war with a few demon lords. Well, we weren’t the only ones — it was a really big war where even god-level entities were involved.
Of course, we just needed to defeat the demon lords.
At that time, our family was the strongest, with my father being the family head. We were the true rulers of this continent.
But several demon lords had targeted our family. While my father was out fighting wars, they attacked our home.
My mother was not a warrior, and I had two siblings, both younger than me.
Of course, we were no match for them, and they took control of our house while most warriors were out in the war.

My mother, my siblings, and some other family members hid our identities and pretended to be regular servants of the family to stay alive until my father returned so that we couldn’t be used for blackmailing.
But the servants’ fate was even worse. I was just little w- when I saw those demons kill my baby brothers and eat their flesh.
My mother was torn to pieces right in front of my eyes; her screams still haunt me.
Those creatures killed all of them — devouring their flesh or just killing for fun. Had my father and others not returned in time, then even I would have gone through the same fate.
But in that battle, even my father couldn’t survive. I was only left with the memories of those screams, their last words, those traumatic days..."
Yennefer finally told him about the reason behind her past obsession. Those disgusting demons were especially happy when cutting the kids.
"..." Vritra silently listened to her entire story and felt really bad for her. It was understandable that she hated demons so much.
If even a little of that had happened to him, he wouldn’t stop until all demons were killed.
Yeah, she indeed made a mistake and hurt him, but now even he felt that she deserved a second chance — of course, only if she had truly changed.
Although he could understand her obsession, he still wouldn’t like that level of obsession that could hurt her or others around her.
After a short silence, Vritra took the bracelet from her hand and placed it around her wrist.
It looked extremely beautiful on her; her milky skin seemed to increase the charm of the bracelet.
"..." The moment she felt his touch as he locked the bracelet, arrows went straight through her heart — but this time it didn’t bring pain.
Instead, she was incredibly happy. This meant a second chance, getting her place back in his heart.
"I can try to trust you, but if you break it again, you will never be able to find me." He said, moving his gaze from her wrist to her eyes.
"Thank you, husband. Never ever would I make such a mistake. Each moment away from you was such torture. Mmm~ now I just want you and nothing else."
Yennefer instantly jumped into his arms, her palms caressing his back as if she was trying to register the feel of his muscles, his warmth back into her body.
She knew getting her relationship back to exactly what it was before would take some time, but she would do it.
"Hmm." Vritra nodded. He could feel that the bracelets they were wearing weren’t normal. It really felt like he had some sort of connection with Yennefer.
"Oh right, husband, I almost forgot to mention it before. We need to leave the continent as soon as possible. Things have become just too dangerous."
Yennefer pulled herself back just a bit and spoke.

Yasmine and Vanessa were definitely two of the people who made him feel most at ease.
They didn’t speak further and just stayed silent, but soon Yasmine sensed the approaching Yennefer and mumbled, "At least she didn’t just leave with that absurd excuse.
Hubby, you can do it."
After speaking, Yasmine disappeared, and in the next moment, Yennefer appeared inside the room.
She was panting lightly after pushing herself to her limits.
Vritra didn’t know what, but something seemed to have changed about her — or maybe it was the glint in her eyes.
"So what have you decided?" he asked, still in his emotionless tone.
"I..." Yennefer was about to speak but noticed the fox who was eavesdropping from the bathroom, so first she covered them with a barrier.
Then she moved closer to him and gracefully settled over his lap before taking something out of her inventory.
Without saying anything, she took his right hand as Vritra continued to stare at her in confusion.
Then she put a bracelet around his wrist.
It seemed to be made of some shiny white material with a beautiful blue gem at the top.
After securely placing the bracelet, she took out another exactly same-looking bracelet and handed it to Vritra, speaking, "Husband, can you help me wear it?"
"What is the meaning of this?" he asked, not even picking the bracelet.
"Haa... these belonged to my parents.
They wore it at the time of their marriage; it was a symbol of eternal bond between them."
Yennefer began to explain in a sad tone, gently caressing the bracelet on his wrist.
"When I was six, our family was in a war with a few demon lords.
Well, we weren’t the only ones — it was a really big war where even god-level entities were involved.
Of course, we just needed to defeat the demon lords.
At that time, our family was the strongest, with my father being the family head.
We were the true rulers of this continent.
But several demon lords had targeted our family.
While my father was out fighting wars, they attacked our home.
My mother was not a warrior, and I had two siblings, both younger than me.
Of course, we were no match for them, and they took control of our house while most warriors were out in the war.

My mother, my siblings, and some other family members hid our identities and pretended to be regular servants of the family to stay alive until my father returned so that we couldn’t be used for blackmailing.
But the servants’ fate was even worse.
I was just little w- when I saw those demons kill my baby brothers and eat their flesh.
My mother was torn to pieces right in front of my eyes; her screams still haunt me.
Those creatures killed all of them — devouring their flesh or just killing for fun.
Had my father and others not returned in time, then even I would have gone through the same fate.
But in that battle, even my father couldn’t survive.
I was only left with the memories of those screams, their last words, those traumatic days..."
Yennefer finally told him about the reason behind her past obsession.
Those disgusting demons were especially happy when cutting the kids.
"..." Vritra silently listened to her entire story and felt really bad for her.
It was understandable that she hated demons so much.
If even a little of that had happened to him, he wouldn’t stop until all demons were killed.
Yeah, she indeed made a mistake and hurt him, but now even he felt that she deserved a second chance — of course, only if she had truly changed.
Although he could understand her obsession, he still wouldn’t like that level of obsession that could hurt her or others around her.
After a short silence, Vritra took the bracelet from her hand and placed it around her wrist.
It looked extremely beautiful on her; her milky skin seemed to increase the charm of the bracelet.
"..." The moment she felt his touch as he locked the bracelet, arrows went straight through her heart — but this time it didn’t bring pain.
Instead, she was incredibly happy.
This meant a second chance, getting her place back in his heart.
"I can try to trust you, but if you break it again, you will never be able to find me." He said, moving his gaze from her wrist to her eyes.
"Thank you, husband.
Never ever would I make such a mistake.
Each moment away from you was such torture.
Mmm~ now I just want you and nothing else."
Yennefer instantly jumped into his arms, her palms caressing his back as if she was trying to register the feel of his muscles, his warmth back into her body.
She knew getting her relationship back to exactly what it was before would take some time, but she would do it.
"Hmm." Vritra nodded.
He could feel that the bracelets they were wearing weren’t normal.
It really felt like he had some sort of connection with Yennefer.
"Oh right, husband, I almost forgot to mention it before.
We need to leave the continent as soon as possible.
Things have become just too dangerous."
Yennefer pulled herself back just a bit and spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 441: Arthal Plague Rat
paragraphs: "Yeah, I know everyone is searching for me. Did you find something else?" Vritra asked, hearing her serious warning.
"Yes, a few days ago I destroyed a base of the Nine Pacts, where I got to know that people from the Bone Blood Cult are planning something big to catch you.
Also, the Oracle from the Golden Moon has already started his preparation. Staying in this continent is just too dangerous," Yennefer explained.
"Haa, well, that’s not surprising, and I have already met Red. He wanted me to join his maniacal organization," Vritra replied.
There were zero chances of him leaving the continent currently.
"Not to mention, Darius and others have started to cover the kingdom with some sort of barrier, and I won’t leave my family here," he added.
"Mmm, then I will fight with you," Yennefer said with determination. She was ready to kill anyone for him.
An hour or so later, Vritra and the two women headed towards the arena as they flew through the heavy mist.
The two weren’t fighting like before, but they seemed to have a challenge among themselves, because of which they both kept trying to get closer to him.
While the two were flying on either side of him, Vritra asked Yasmine about the quest he got earlier.
Reading about the task and the reward, she pondered.
"Hmm, I have heard about the Arthal Plague Rat. Well, they aren’t actually rats but people.
Or rather, a failed experiment from the Nine Pacts, in which several thousand people turned into those creatures.
They have nearly the same intelligence as humans, and that’s all I know about them. I never really encountered one," Yasmine started explaining.
She paused suddenly before adding, "As for the reward, I believe it might be related to one of the Six Truths, which is directly connected to the 1st Mythic Halo."
Vritra was surprised to hear the mention of the first Mythic Halo. Very little was actually known about it, and it was said to be strong enough that even gods were afraid of it.
Even Nihil Anima, which was fearless by nature, wouldn’t go anywhere near it.
Or so the tales said.
’1st ranked Mythic Halo?!’
Vritra repeated, pausing abruptly for a moment as the two ladies, who were flying way too close to him, bumped into Vritra.
"Ah, Master, what’s wrong?" Maeve asked. The three of them were already disguised.
"Husband, are you alright?" Yennefer questioned, searching the area around but couldn’t find anyone.
"Yeah." Nodding, he continued to fly.
"Yes, sorry hubby, even I don’t know much about that Mythic Halo. Guess if we do this quest, we might encounter some secrets, so it might actually be dangerous."
Yasmine said, though which part of their life wasn’t full of danger? It was basically like oxygen to them.
If there was no danger, then Vritra certainly wouldn’t be found anywhere close.
’If I can obtain that Mythic Halo, then we just might be able to resolve this problem.
Anyway, let’s check it out during the game,’ Vritra replied, quite curious about the content of the scroll in his inventory.
It wasn’t long before they arrived in the arena.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +100,423}
{Sin Point Gained: Welcomed +100,422}
{Sin Point Gained: Urged +100,423}
The number of people already present there was above Vritra’s expectations.
He forgot about the other matters momentarily as sin points rained down on him.
"Hello participants, let’s have another great game today!" he said. Getting so many sin points was truly the way to lift his mood.
"You two should go and enjoy the show."
Vritra glanced back at the two women and spoke. Maeve nodded and flew away; she was also going to help with the arrangements.
Yennefer wanted to be close to him since she had missed him way too much, but she nodded reluctantly and took a seat among the audience.
Vritra looked at the two women for a few seconds. He felt that he should tell them about the few remaining secrets of his.
Like Yasmine, his abilities, and so on.
He already had full trust in Maeve, and by the Sin Point messages, he confirmed earlier that Yennefer really had changed.
Though he would observe her for a few more days and tell everything after letting them meet Diana and Fiona.
Without wasting any more time, he took out all the subjects from his dimensional book and got the maze ready inside the fighting area.
Bullo also took his position while Shitless, Onest, Xi, and others sold the glyphs and took the bets.
With Raelion gone, the Voromir Kingdom could be said to be in complete control of Maeve.
Since the size of the public was increasing, they had even called out the three demon generals along with many others from there.
"Alright, the game begins!"
Two lizard men slowly crawled through a big metallic pipe which seemed to be a carrier for sewage waste.
Their bodies were dirty with foul and rotten materials.
The pipe was only large enough to fit one person, so one was crawling behind the other.
Despite the disgusting smell, their breathing was really high as they were about to have a heart attack.
The two lizard men had distinct features — a long tail on their back and a lizard-like head.
Though their body structure was similar to humans, their toes and fingers were also like lizards.
Their bodies were covered with yellow scales.
They weren’t from the Quartz Continent but had come here in search of something special.
The Arthal Plague Rats — the creatures who were said to be dangerous enough to make a race extinct if given enough time.
Of course, everyone would be tempted with such a weapon, but it was only after coming into this underground city that they got to know the true horror.
"W-We haa haa were stupid to e-even think of bringing these abomination-level creatures back to our house," one of the lizard men spoke, intense pain shooting through his body.
All over his skin, under the scales, pus kept bubbling and bursting, releasing a dangerous acidic fluid.
The two lizard men were feeling unimaginable pain, and they suffered to this extent just by a slight graze from a rather weak Arthal rat.

Those things had long stopped being human; they weren’t things that should exist. Even the Nine Pacts and the Golden Moon stopped trying to eradicate them. The more they tried to fight these terrifying creatures, the more the army of the other side grew.
It really was like a plague.

"T-This is not a weapon. We were all wrong. Ughhh, cough, w-we have to haa hurry back and inform the others, cough," the other lizard man spoke, but right then he spat out a mouthful of dark viscous fluid full of wriggling bugs.
Then his bones twisted, and skin tore from the inside. His flesh began to squirm and expand as his form writhed inside the pipe.
"Damnit!" The heartbeat of the other man sped up. This was a fate worse than death.
He tried to move faster but sensed that the rapidly growing flesh would soon catch up.
The lizard man hurriedly tried to commit suicide, but even that failed as his body got devoured into the slithering flesh.
"AGGGHHHHHH-" Only a loud scream reverberated as thousands of Arthal rats charged towards the pipe.
