chapters.title: Chapter 442: A Failure
paragraphs: Inside a kitchen, the sound of continuous chopping rang out. With each chop, a splashing sound reverberated.
A person with strange, distorted features was humming and chopping his own arm over the kitchen counter, splashing his blood.
His entire body was completely disproportioned, one arm bigger than the other, while one of his legs was too fat, as if suffering from elephantiasis.
The person’s features very faintly resembled Vritra, but were also infinitely different from him.
Behind the guy, Red rubbed his brows, muttering in rage and irritation.
"Failure, failure, yet again another failure."
BOOOOM
He punched the distorted clone, pieces of flesh and organs exploding in all directions, and even the kitchen broke apart.
"Damnit, you aren’t as great of a treasure as I thought you to be. Why can’t you do just this one thing?"
Red combed his fingers through his hair, removing the tiny pieces of flesh.
The main reason for meeting Vritra before was to capture him, but he had low expectations of actually being able to do it.
So his proper goal was to make Vritra’s clone using the man wrapped in bandages, but even after so many tries, it had failed to do so.
For the first time, it was unable to form a person’s proper clone. No matter what, it couldn’t match Vritra at all.
"Fuck, this isn’t it. He was nothing like that. Even with such powerful attacks, I failed to leave a scratch on his body."
Red hoped to create Vritra’s clone with exact abilities and maybe get a new divine of his own, but he failed miserably.
"Huff, it is fine. I still have a plan that would surely force him to work for me very soon, but catching him will be tricky."
Red took a deep breath, then a smile spread across his face as he gazed at a figure not too far away from him, sitting gracefully.
She would definitely be enough to force Vritra to be his servant.
Red was still curious about who killed the clone he had sent out before to gather information — the Pink’s clone.
"Anyway, he won’t be free for too long," Red muttered before turning and disappearing.
Vritra was floating in the air, just enjoying the messages of the sin points.
With just being present there, he was earning hundreds of thousands of sin points.
Then he decided to read the proper details of the quest; very little information was given in the messages earlier.
’Hmm, what does it mean by catching those rats? Where are they? I need more info before I could even try it.’ Vritra took out the scroll from his inventory and opened it.
A few lines were written on it in big, bright letters.
[What created them, what flows through their veins, is also the most lethal poison for them. Kill and collect their brains and feed it to the little ones.]
Vritra: "..."
He was truly speechless. Not only did it not give him any significant information, but the task sounded way too strange.
’What little ones? Is it asking me to kill infants now or something? And no information about those creatures? Sigh...’
Vritra seriously pondered if he should skip this quest, but the reward was too tempting.
It just might allow him to find more about the 1st ranked Mythic Halo, but what if his greed became the reason for his own doom?
"Sigh, wifey, what do you have to say about this?" Vritra asked. Her advice had always been helpful.
"I agree it does sound really shady and dangerous, but this quest, I think it might be asking us to save the lives of the mentioned little ones somehow.

Well, let’s first get more information from that Crow guy. It will help us assess the situation better," she replied after a moment. If they could, then Yasmine would really want to save innocent lives.
"Alright, I will talk to Foxie about it." Vritra nodded, agreeing that sometimes saving lives could be more important than personal gain.
Plus, if both things align, then taking some level of danger is perfectly normal.
WHOOSH
A person threw a red-colored glyph with strange spikes drawn all over it.
The target was Ziggy, who was bounced into the air by Bullo, his fat body completely vulnerable.
The red glyph actually connected with his body. It exploded and turned into a rope that tied one of its ends to his leg, and the other got stuck on the ground.
Right beside that stuck end, a big fat spike grew out of the ground, and then the rope automatically pulled Ziggy’s body down with a strong tug.
"OIIIINNNNNKKKKKKK!!"
KIIICCCCHHHHH-
Even amongst all the noise, the clear sound of something tearing his clothes and reaching deep reverberated, along with his pain-filled scream.
Over half a meter-long spike completely disappeared inside his fat body.
Even for Ziggy, that thing was too large. His body bounced back into the air.
"I-I did it!! I was the one who skewered that pig! I won the jackpot! Hahaha, look, that spike is still inside him!" a person happily shouted, and within moments he received his reward.
After Ziggy fell to the ground again with a loud thud on his ass, he rolled on the ground for a while before trying to reach the spike, but his fat body came in the way.
Then he made use of one of the zombies, and using its arm, he successfully pulled the spike out after a few tries.
"Ughhh, w-what is he releasing along with that spike?" A few people who saw the disgusting scene instantly vomited.
Raelion had one of his balls burst the previous day, and with his healing and other abilities blocked, he could do nothing about it.
The once-feared Demon Lord was now nothing more than a joke. It was extremely humiliating for him.
He swore to kill every single one of these humans, even murdering their families, and to give the worst death to Vritra.
But seeing what happened with Piggy filled him with endless fear.
He ran all over the place with all his might, barely protecting his last ball while especially avoiding those special glyphs.
He would let himself get injured but would never want to go through that sort of humiliation.
After a few hours of the game, Vritra declared a break.
Most of the public just remained seated; some went to toilets while others went to buy some food.
The subjects were resting inside the fighting arena, still terrorized by Vritra’s evil methods. He truly was a devil.
Vritra gestured for Maeve to come, so instantly two women flew towards him from the crowd. Both were disguised.
"Yes, master~" Maeve asked, hugging his arm.
"..." Yennefer just stood close to Vritra. Even though she was back in his life, there still seemed to be a barrier between them that wasn’t there before.
She would have to slowly break it and become truly his woman again.
"Contact Crow," Vritra said.
"Alright, master." Nodding, Maeve took out the glyph and contacted the guy from the World Information Centre.

"Haa, what do you want now? How much are you going to leech off of us? I knew it, letting you be a member of this organization was a mist-" As Crow’s grumpy voice sounded, Vritra interrupted him and questioned,
"Tell me about Arthal Plague Rats."

Maeve explained, being a part of the world information centre, she also had quite a lot of inside news.
"And those plague rats only grew more dangerous with time, maybe they might erupt in the future but that would still take place in like two or three centuries ahead." Yennefer added.
"Oh I see." Vritra nodded.
"Right, husband you were telling me about how you became a demon, but I accidentally interrupted you.
So can you tell it to us now?"
Yennefer said, remembering the matter from the previous night.
"Okay." After a brief pause, Vritra began to explain once more:
"So after coming to this world, first I got thrown off into a labyrinth’s trap by one of my classmate..."
He decided to explain everything from the very beginning, but still didn’t tell them about Yasmine completely.
It wasn’t about trust, but he would tell it when all his women meet one another.
He also explained about Nihilanima, his Demonification and his fights with various entities.
How he became divine, and they knew the rest.
"Master, you have been through so much?"
Maeve muttered, stopping suddenly to cuddle into his arms, it made her sad that Vritra had suffered so much pain.
No wonder he has grown to this extent in such a short time, even she herself who had grown in a bad household hadn’t had such a life.
He always seems to be danger.
"Husband, no matter what, we will be together and I will do anything to protect you."
Yennefer spoke resolutely, hugging him comfortingly after Maeve.
"Oww, such cute ladies, hubby, you sure are good at picking the best girls." Yasmine spoke, her low strength always becomes a hinderance in face of danger.
’Yeah it seems so, all of my women surely are lovely.
Anyway wifey, I was wondering something recently, who do you think gives us these quests?
Is it god?’ he questioned.
After a short moment of embracing and comforting, the three once again continued on their journey, this time the other two were sharing their life stories.
They weren’t flying at full speed, or they would have already arrived inside the plague city.
It was better to enjoy the present, who knows what the future holds.
"Most probably, it is the gods, but we don’t really know much about all that.
Such things are hidden by the gods in the name of the six truths." Yasmine replied.
’These quests and how my life always brings me at certain points like I am just going through someone’s plan, maybe the gods are watching us at every time.’ Vritra shared.
Even when he got that quest previous where he got the Divine’s secret realm map just before getting thrown into it.
Whoever is giving him quest is strong and knows what will happen in the future.
But either they are trying to protect him or they just enjoy a more struggling person in the planet.
’Even this quest feels like it might benefit me somehow, even though none of it should be related to me at all.’ Vritra said, wondering who is controlling the strings of fate of all the people.
But there was no point in thinking about it now, who knows how much secret this planet and the world might be hiding.
Are lords truly the strongest powers on the planet?
Are gods the strongest beings in existence?
Who exactly was Divine?
There were so many questions, yet Vritra could only wait in suspense to find all the answers.
’And what was the point of summoning us all into this planet?
There are already so many power beings, and we would need a lot of time to reach that point.
Just to kill a demon lord?
Kill the demon god?
Then where are the previous heroes?’ the more he thought in this direction the more confused he became.
Everything seemed to be related but it was just impossible to see those invisible strings connecting it all.
"The heroes who were summoned before you, did kill a demon lord but they disappeared soon after completely.
Or the heroes before them and before them, they all had disappeared."
Yasmine said, though she might know more than Vritra about certain things but that only meant she had even more questions, and no way to find answers.
Her own life itself was a mystery, her parents deaths, that attack directly from the demon god...
The pair of husband and wife sighed at the same time, feeling a headache when thinking that everyone here just might be puppets dancing on someone’s wishes.
After flying for a while, they finally arrived inside the plague city, and arrived over the first temple.
This place seemed completely abandoned, there wasn’t a single person in the whole city.
The houses were broken and covered with vines and grass, it was a scene directly from some apocalypse.
"So this is the first temple, I guess it got broken during the fight." Vritra muttered, looking at the temple, half of which was in shambles.
The sky was dark and faint noise of the insects could be heard from around the place, it truly gave like one is playing a horror game.
"You two stay here and keep watch, I will go quickly and check things underground." Vritra said.
"...Okay." The two women nodded, reluctantly, they wanted to go along but had to follow his orders.
Vritra landed on the ground and walked into the broken temple, he could see rotten corpses who bodies were still covered with wriggling flesh.
’Oh it is still not completely dead even after so many years huh.’ Vritra looked at the corpse for a few moments before continuing.
Arriving inside the large hall, he found that there was a big hole in the ground near the front seats.
"Alright, here goes nothing."
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]
[Forbidden Activated.]
[Switch Activated.]
[Nether Eye Activated.]
[Shift Activated.]
After activating several of his skills, Vritra was completely prepared as he finally made the jump into the dark hole, prepared to face whatever unknown lies in there.

chapters.title: Chapter 450: The Dead Man
paragraphs: After activating several of his skills, Vritra finally made the jump into the dark hole.
If anything, this was certainly going to be one of a kind adventure for him, and if his speculation is correct then whatever he obtains here would be helpful for him in the future.
It would prove that someone is certainly sitting somewhere, putting all their focus on him and either enjoying his suffering or trying to help him.
Maeve and Yennefer stayed outside, feeling worried, but they believed Vritra would be fine no matter what.
’Sigh...’ Yennefer stared at the broken temple, aside from worry about Vritra, there was one other thought.
Even though Vritra has forgiven her, things still didn’t feel like before; he had not even called out to her gently like before.
And she didn’t know what it was going to take to right her mistake, she still longed for his love-filled gazes and tight hugs.
Vritra continued to move down into the darkness but even after several meters, there was no land, it really felt like a bottomless pit.
’The stench here, it feels like thousands of corpses have been rotting in one place.’
Vritra thought, as he held his breath and used the third eye to observe everything.
"I can’t sense any lifeform here either, maybe they shifted to some other location. Even though most of those Plague Rats have low intelligence, a few are quite intelligent."
Yasmine spoke, sensing the faint radiations in the air.
’Yeah, let’s continue the search.’ Vritra increased his speed and disappeared completely into the darkness.
After falling for some time, he finally saw ground. Vritra gently landed and looked around.
It was like a hive, there were thousands of caves built all over the place but there really was no one.
Vritra walked around, just observing things and saw strange marks, as if someone was dragging a few bodies.
In the darkness, not too far away, a pair of eyes glowed. Staring at the invader, it was only for a moment before any sign of life disappeared from its eyes.
’Hmm I just sensed something but it was too faint.’
Vritra looked in the direction of the creature in hiding, and somehow the radiations in the air seemed to have gotten stronger.
"Yeah there really was someone here, but it feels like they took their own life after a moment or something. But not before sending back a signal." Yasmine added.
Within a few seconds, a fire suddenly lit up at the centre of the enormous cave, it instantly lit up the surroundings completely.
’What a setup, before any physical attack, they target the mind of their targets. Not bad.’
Vritra nodded, most others might just get afraid of this and lose their sanity.
Then several shadows appeared on the walls, distorted and large, releasing grotesque sounds.
The air began to turn strange, as if vibrations were affecting everything and radioactive radiations began to fill the cave.
Vritra looked down at his hands, despite being in the disappearing state, he could sense how it was trying to affect his skin.
Even his clothes were already affected.
’These things could even sense my presence and affect me while in the dimensional book, and they just seem to be the patrolling team.’ Vritra was still calm, he focused over the creatures.
There were a total of ten of them, and their bodies looked so strange. It was completely distorted and ruined, and constantly emitted those dangerous radiations.
’Alright time for the hunt, let’s find if normal attacks work against them.’
[Switch: Demonification (40%)]
Vritra’s body instantly began to emit a powerful energy, pausing those creatures for a moment, and they knew it was someone really powerful.
Their usual tactics would be useless against him, so instead, all ten of them charged at Vritra directly.
Removing the disappearing state, Vritra teleported right behind the body of one of them.
Their skin was pulsating and looked disgusting, as if they had been boiled in boiling oil.
WHOOSH
Throwing a punch with all his strength, Vritra used Intra Shuffled to maintain some distance by increasing the length of his arm.
His fist actually easily punctured through its skin but inside its body there were no organs or even bones, it was only strange twisting flesh that was the source of the radiations.
Instantly Vritra felt an extremely hot sensation against his skin, trying to break through his defences, and it actually managed to affect him.
These strange radiations really had the ability to go through his defences.
Vritra instantly pulled his hand back, a faint sensation of pain spreading through his right arm.
His arm was shaking and the radiations seemed to be wreaking havoc inside his hand, spreading quickly.
Vritra instantly used his Null Field’s ability to slow down the time over his arm, greatly slowing the radiations.
’These creatures are indeed dangerous, even going through the Divine’s physique, but thankfully I have something good too.’ Vritra ignored the slight pain and rushed towards the other creatures.
"Hubby what are you doing? We need to remove those radiations first, physical attacks are just useless in front of them-"
Yasmine was just speaking but Vritra ignored her words, he began to punch and kick the ten creatures.
Tearing them apart and blasting them, within a few moments, his entire body was filled with those dangerous radiations and he was covered in a greyish colour.
While those plague rats still weren’t dead, their torn bodies wriggled and joined back, before coming back to life.
They already looked at Vritra like a target who was already dead, sending back a signal that the latest threat had been taken care of.
"Sigh Hubby, what were you planning? Are you trying to commit suicide or something?" Yasmine clearly looked worried, even after using Null, the radiations were still destroying his body.
’I am waiting.’
"Huh? Waiting for what? Don’t tell me you really were planning that, just what are you-" but she paused, as several messages flashed in front of Vritra.
[Mutamorphis Activated.]
[Observing body’s condition.]
[Calculating the risks.]
[Searching for solutions.]
[Starting procedure.]
And just as Vritra had hoped, Mutamorphis appeared at just the right time, he really missed seeing such messages.
Maybe because these Arthal Plague Rats weren’t too powerful, but despite the radioactive radiations filling his body, he wasn’t too badly affected.
[Your resistance against various radiations grows.]
[Progress: 0%]
[Progress: 0.01%]
Amidst the silence, the Arthal Plague Rats just waited for Vritra to die, they actually enjoyed the sight of their victims exploding into a mess.
While Vritra endured the pain and watched one message after another flash before his eyes.
’Haa this is not enough and far too slow, looks like I need to absorb more radiations.’
After making up his mind, he finally released the breath he was holding and calmly looked at the ten rats.
Although they seemed perfectly fine, since some of the radiation got transferred to Vritra, a slight change could be sensed in their body mass.
’I guess this will also help me kill them.’ After making up his mind, Vritra wasted no more time.
[Intra Shuffle Activated.]
Both his arms grew several meters long, and pierced through the bodies of all the Arthal rats in the next moment.
They didn’t even try to defend while staring at Vritra in confusion, wasn’t he just trying to get killed by doing this?
His arms were piercing directly through the bodies of all ten of the creatures, the flesh sticking directly to his skin as the radiations poured crazily into his body.
This much amount would have been enough to even severely injure or even kill strong warriors.
The ten were sure that Vritra was definitely being affected by their radiations, so in an attempt to kill him, they increased the amount by several times.

"Hubby, have you started to enjoy the pain or something? Why always use such ways to get stronger? If it continues like this then I wouldn’t be surprised if you suddenly even use the gods to practice."
Yasmine sighed, she didn’t like seeing him suffer pain but it was pretty normal for Vritra by now.
’Well this seems to be the easiest and fastest way, though I would also love if I can grow without going through so much trouble.’
Vritra said, feeling the pain increase slightly, but he could easily handle that much.
Minutes passed, outside, Maeve and Yennefer were starting to get worried so they could no longer stay back and charged into the temple.
Passing through the darkness, they sensed strong radiations emanating from the ground; flying at full speed they soon landed and saw the strange scene.

"Master, w-what’s going on? Are you winning or losing?" Maeve asked in confusion, the ten creatures’ bodies were hanging over Vritra’s arms, but so much radiation was charging into his body while the size of those creatures seemed to be decreasing.
"S-Should we intervene?" Yennefer asked, frowning.
"No, don’t do anything. I have got the situation under control." Vritra nodded with a reassuring look.
"Uh... B-But it looks like you are getting hurt." Maeve said, barely holding back from attacking the ten creatures.
"Just stay there and watch."
The two could only nod and watch it all helplessly. While the rats wondered what they were supposed to do in this situation, they were just hanging in the air.
And shockingly, as minutes ticked by, Vritra’s body remained the same while the Arthal Rats’ body size began to reduce.
After around thirty minutes, almost all the flesh from their bodies had disappeared, now only that rotten skin of theirs remained and the life slowly disappeared from their eyes.
And then they finally died, all the radiation was absorbed by him.
